title: HR Intern
description:
Job Description – HR Intern

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and enthusiastic **HR Intern** to support our Human Resources team across recruitment, employee engagement, HR operations, and day\-to\-day people\-related activities. This role provides hands\-on exposure to the complete employee lifecycle in a fast\-paced student housing and co\-living environment.

Key Responsibilities

* Support the HR team in **end\-to\-end recruitment activities**, including sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and candidate follow\-ups.
* Coordinate with candidates and hiring managers to schedule interviews and maintain recruitment trackers.
* Assist in preparing and maintaining employee records, HR documents, and personnel files.
* Support the onboarding and joining formalities of new employees.
* Assist with attendance, leave, and other routine HR operations.
* Help organize employee engagement activities, events, and internal initiatives.
* Maintain recruitment and HR MIS, trackers, and daily/weekly reports.
* Support HR in preparing offer letters, joining documentation, and other employee\-related documents.
* Coordinate with employees and internal teams for routine HR\-related queries.
* Assist in maintaining compliance\-related documentation and HR records.
* Support the HR team in various administrative and operational activities as required.

Candidate Profile

* Pursuing or recently completed a **Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field**.
* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good working knowledge of **MS Excel/Google Sheets and MS Office**.
* Organized, detail\-oriented, and comfortable handling multiple tasks.
* Proactive attitude with a willingness to learn.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle employee information responsibly.
* Prior internship or exposure to recruitment/HR will be an advantage.

Key Skills

**Recruitment Support \| Candidate Coordination \| HR Operations \| Employee Engagement \| HR Documentation \| MIS \& Reporting \| Communication \| MS Excel \| Coordination \| Time Management**

What You Will Gain

* Hands\-on exposure to **end\-to\-end HR and recruitment processes**.
* Practical experience in employee engagement and HR operations.
* Opportunity to work closely with business and operations teams.
* Exposure to a fast\-paced **student housing and co\-living business environment**.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹12,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

**Key Responsibilities**

**Housekeeping Operations**

* Lead and supervise daily housekeeping operations and housekeeping manpower.
* Ensure proper deployment of housekeeping staff as per operational requirements.
* Monitor attendance, grooming, discipline, productivity, and performance.
* Ensure housekeeping SOPs, checklists, and service standards are followed.
* Conduct daily, weekly, and surprise cleanliness and hygiene inspections.
* Ensure overall cleanliness and upkeep of the premises.

**Hygiene \& Audit Management**

* Conduct regular hygiene and cleanliness audits.
* Review audit scores and identify operational gaps.
* Prepare corrective action plans and ensure timely closure of gaps.
* Monitor recurring hygiene issues and implement preventive measures.

description:

**Career Opportunity with Burckhardt Compression**  

We are seeking motivated and experienced professional who can effectively contribute to the role deliverables connected with position below. In this position you can actively participate to our growth and make a significant impact in a fast\-paced environment as:  

**Position: Sr Compressor Specialist I\&C**  

**Location: Vadodara**  

**Your contributions to organisation's growth:**  

Compressor Specialist – Electrical, Instrumentation \& Control (I\&C) serves as the primary technical expert and customer contact for all compressor\-related electrical, instrumentation, control, and automation matters. The role is responsible for technical troubleshooting, warranty claim evaluation, root cause analysis, customer complaint management, technical training, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance equipment reliability, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
The additional responsibility also includes back office technical support to DPS business in India.  

**Key Responsibilities**  

**Technical Support \& Customer Interface**
* Act as the primary technical contact for customers regarding electrical, instrumentation, and control\-related compressor issues.
* Provide third\-level technical support for service cases and complex troubleshooting activities.
* Prepare the technical Quires/resolution based on the requirements by customer for DPS.
* Support Field Service Representatives (FSR), Field Service Specialists (FSS), and Sales Support teams with technical clarifications and solutions.
* Detect, diagnose, and resolve compressor and plant control system issues at customer sites.
* Advise customers on technical solutions and corrective actions to improve equipment performance and reliability.
* Preparation of IDS (Inquiry Data Sheet) contains complete information to prepare a technical quotation compliant with each customer inquiry for Digital Product \& Services (DPS).

  

**Warranty \& Claims Management**
* Analyze customer complaints, warranty claims, and non\-conformities related to compressor systems.
* Evaluate warranty applicability and recommend appropriate actions.
* Coordinate and manage warranty order execution and associated service activities.
* Ensure timely and cost\-effective resolution of contractual and warranty issues.

  

**Root Cause Analysis \& Continuous Improvement**
* Lead or actively participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations for equipment failures and operational issues.
* Collaborate with Technical Consultancy teams to prepare detailed technical reports.
* Participate in task forces to identify causes of failures and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Drive technical improvement initiatives based on field experience, customer feedback, and reliability data.
* Review of technical specifications from Customer related to Instrumentation and machine monitoring systems for technical support for DPS.

  

**Customer Complaint \& Quality Management**
* Coordinate customer complaint, claim, and non\-conformity management processes.

Interface with customers, agents, contractors, project managers, and internal stakeholders


* Transfer manufacturing\-related issues and feedback to Quality and Operations departments for corrective action.
* Collect and feedback on technical improvements to product management based on experience as well as customer service and support related topics for DPS.

  

**Knowledge Management \& Training**
* Develop technical training materials, operating guidelines, and troubleshooting documentation.
* Conduct classroom and hands\-on training programs for customers and internal employees.
* Promote knowledge management and technical knowledge sharing across the organization.
* Responsible for minimizing the time between customer inquiry and IDS submission to maximize time available for quotation preparation for DPS.
  

**Reliability \& Operational Excellence**
* Participate in verification, definition, and implementation of product and process improvements.
* Contribute to enhancing customer satisfaction through responsive technical support and effective problem resolution

  

**Education/ experience / languages:**
* Diploma/ BE with Instrument \& Control Engineering with min 10 to 12 years of relevant experience in compressor systems, rotating equipment, industrial automation, or process plant maintenance
* Previous Customer service experience in field support in Refineries, Petrochemicals! fertilizers, Industrial Gas segment with reciprocating compressors
* Beside the electrical, programming and control skills, basic mechanical know how is expected.
* Experience in troubleshooting PLC, DCS, SCADA, and compressor control systems.
* Proven experience in root cause analysis, warranty management, and customer technical support.
* Exposure to oil \& gas, petrochemical, refining, chemical, power, or industrial process industries preferred.

  

**Special Requirements:**
* Compressor Control Systems \& Machine monitoring systems (MMS \& CMS).
* PLC/DCS/SCADA Programming \& Troubleshooting
* Electrical \& Instrumentation Systems
* Rotating Equipment Diagnostics
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Industrial Communication Protocols (DCS, SCADA, PLC)
* Warranty \& Claims Evaluation
* Technical Report Preparation
* Technical Training \& Knowledge Transfer

  

**Key performance indicators (KPI’s):**
* Cases in CRM (Open; Close; Tasks)\- Case Management
* End to End completion of task,Response time to customer's technical request
* RCA preparation\- Timeline for closing the cases
* Preparation of IDS (Inquiry Data Sheet) contains with the complete information to prepare a quotation compliant with each customer inquiry.

  

**We Offer**
* We have a very free culture, inspiring employees to involve in various activities of their interests.
* Our flexible working models will allow you to combine private interests with work.
* Employee Connect, Engagement events and feedback culture enhances our reach and gives us an opportunity to continuously improve.
* Performance and appreciation awards.
* Sports activities and Klib Library to energize you.
* We proudly do encourage diversity and inclusion in thoughts and in spirit.
* A winner of GreenCo Gold and other various ISO certifications, we encourage you to inhibit the same to contribute in a much greener tomorrow!
* We do aspire to be Great Place to Work soon to provide you an enticing career with us.

Burckhardt Compression creates leading compression solutions for a sustainable energy future and the long\-term success of its customers. description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONHEAD – SUPPLY CHAIN MANAGEMENT

**Company:** Industrial Filters \& Fabrics Pvt. Ltd. (IFF)  
**Location:** Manglia, Indore, Madhya Pradesh  
**Department:** Supply Chain Management  
**Position:** Head – Supply Chain Management  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Industry:** Industrial Manufacturing / Filter Bags \& Non\-Woven Fabrics

ABOUT THE COMPANY

**I**ndustrial Filters \& Fabrics Pvt. Ltd. (IFF) is a manufacturing company specializing in industrial filtration solutions, filter bags, non\-woven fabrics and related products. We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented Head – Supply Chain Management to lead and strengthen our end\-to\-end supply chain operations.

ROLE PURPOSE

The Head – Supply Chain Management will be responsible for managing and optimizing the complete supply chain cycle, including demand planning, production planning, procurement, inventory, stores, logistics, dispatch and supplier management.

The role will focus on ensuring right material, right quantity, right quality, right cost and right time, while maintaining optimum inventory levels and supporting uninterrupted production and timely customer deliveries.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. Supply Chain Planning

* Develop and implement an integrated Supply Chain Planning process aligned with business and production requirements.
* Coordinate with Sales, Production, Purchase, Stores and Finance for demand and supply planning.
* Prepare and monitor monthly, weekly and daily material planning.
* Ensure availability of critical raw materials and consumables without excess inventory.
* Identify supply risks and develop contingency plans.

2\. Procurement \& Supplier Management

* Lead strategic procurement of raw materials, consumables, packaging materials and other production requirements.
* Develop and maintain a reliable supplier base.
* Evaluate suppliers based on quality, cost, delivery, capacity and service performance.
* Negotiate commercial terms, prices, lead times and payment conditions.
* Develop alternate sources for critical materials to minimize supply risk.
* Drive supplier performance improvement and timely corrective actions.

3\. Inventory Management

* Establish optimum inventory norms for raw materials, WIP, finished goods and consumables.
* Monitor inventory levels, ageing, slow\-moving and non\-moving inventory.
* Reduce excess inventory and improve inventory turnover.
* Implement appropriate FIFO / FEFO / batch control wherever applicable.
* Establish inventory accuracy through regular cycle counts and physical verification.

4\. Production Planning \& Coordination

* Coordinate with Production to ensure material availability as per production plans.
* Align procurement and inventory plans with production schedules.
* Monitor material shortages, production constraints and line stoppages.
* Improve planning accuracy and reduce production interruptions due to material shortages.

5\. Stores \& Warehouse Management

* Ensure systematic management of raw material, WIP, finished goods and consumables stores.
* Establish proper receiving, inspection, storage, issue and reconciliation systems.
* Improve warehouse space utilization and material identification.
* Ensure inventory records are accurate and updated in ERP/MIS.
* Implement 5S, safety and housekeeping standards across stores and warehouses.

6\. Logistics \& Dispatch

* Lead inbound and outbound logistics operations.
* Ensure timely and cost\-effective movement of materials and finished goods.
* Optimize transportation costs through route, load and transporter planning.
* Monitor dispatch schedules and customer delivery commitments.
* Develop and monitor transporter performance and service levels.

7\. Cost Optimization

* Drive continuous reduction in:
* Procurement cost
* Inventory carrying cost
* Transportation cost
* Warehousing cost
* Material handling cost
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, vendor consolidation and better commercial terms.
* Track supply\-chain cost against budgets and targets.

8\. MIS \& Performance Management

Develop and monitor key Supply Chain KPIs such as:

* Material availability %
* Supplier OTIF %
* Purchase price variance
* Inventory turnover
* Inventory days
* Stock\-out frequency
* Slow\-moving / non\-moving inventory
* Procurement lead time
* Purchase order closure
* Logistics cost
* On\-time dispatch %
* Customer delivery adherence
* Working capital blocked in inventory

Prepare regular weekly and monthly Supply Chain MIS for management review.

CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL COORDINATION

The position will work closely with:

Sales \& Marketing \| Production \| Purchase \| Quality \| Stores \| Dispatch \| Finance \| HR \| Management

to ensure seamless flow of materials, information and finished goods across the organization.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

* BE / B.Tech / MBA / PG in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics, Procurement or related field.
* 10–15 years of relevant experience, preferably in a manufacturing environment.
* Proven experience in managing end\-to\-end supply chain operations.
* Strong knowledge of procurement, inventory, logistics, warehouse and production planning.
* Experience in ERP systems and advanced MS Excel.
* Strong negotiation and vendor\-management skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong leadership and team\-management capability.
* Should have a data\-driven, process\-oriented and result\-focused approach.

PREFERRED INDUSTRY EXPERIENCE

Candidates from industrial manufacturing, engineering, textile/non\-woven, filtration, automotive, chemical, or other process/manufacturing industries will be preferred.

KEY LEADERSHIP EXPECTATIONS

Ownership \| Cost Consciousness \| Process Discipline \| Data\-Driven Decision Making \| Vendor Development \| Inventory Optimization \| Customer Focus \| Cross\-Functional Coordination

SUCCESS MEASURES

The successful candidate will be expected to deliver measurable improvement in:

✓ Material Availability  
✓ Inventory Optimization  
✓ Procurement Cost  
✓ Supplier Performance  
✓ Production Continuity  
✓ Logistics Cost  
✓ On\-Time Delivery  
✓ Working Capital Efficiency

WHY JOIN IFF?

This is a leadership opportunity to build and strengthen the Supply Chain Management function and directly contribute to operational efficiency, cost optimization, working\-capital improvement and business growth.

Interested candidates may share their updated CV with the HR Team.

**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Employment Type:** Full\-time

1\. Job Purpose

We are looking for an Electrical Engineer with hands\-on experience in **PLC programming, electrical panel design, machine automation, commissioning and troubleshooting**. The candidate will be responsible for developing, integrating and commissioning electrical and control systems for industrial automation projects.

2\. Key Responsibilities

**PLC \& Automation**

* Develop, modify and troubleshoot PLC programs for industrial machines and automation systems.
* Work with PLC platforms such as **Siemens, Mitsubishi, Omron, Allen\-Bradley, Delta** or equivalent.
* Develop HMI screens, alarms, recipes, data displays and machine\-control sequences.
* Configure and troubleshoot VFDs, servo drives, stepper drives, sensors and actuators.
* Establish communication between PLC, HMI, robots, vision systems, drives and other automation equipment.
* Develop machine sequencing, interlocks, safety logic and fault\-handling routines.
* Participate in FAT, SAT, installation and commissioning activities.

**Electrical Design**

* Prepare electrical control\-panel designs and electrical schematics.
* Select appropriate MCBs, MCCBs, contactors, relays, SMPS, PLCs, I/O modules, drives and other control components.
* Prepare I/O lists, cable schedules, terminal plans and panel layouts.
* Understand industrial control\-panel wiring, earthing and electrical safety requirements.
* Coordinate panel fabrication, wiring and testing.

**Machine Integration**

* Integrate PLCs with **SCARA/6\-axis robots, machine vision systems, screwdrivers, feeders, pneumatic systems and sensors**.
* Interface automation equipment using Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus TCP/RTU, RS\-232/485 and other industrial communication protocols.
* Support development of automated inspection, assembly, handling and process machines.

**Commissioning \& Troubleshooting**

* Install and commission machines at customer locations.
* Diagnose electrical, PLC, sensor, communication and automation\-related problems.
* Perform machine testing and validation.
* Provide technical support during production trials and customer acceptance.
* Prepare commissioning reports and technical documentation.

3\. Required Technical Skills

* Strong understanding of industrial electrical systems and control circuits.
* Hands\-on PLC programming experience.
* Knowledge of HMI programming.
* Knowledge of VFD/servo drive configuration.
* Ability to read and prepare electrical schematics.
* Knowledge of industrial sensors, solenoid valves, pneumatic systems and safety devices.
* Understanding of industrial communication protocols.
* Basic knowledge of robotics and machine vision will be an advantage.
* Familiarity with AutoCAD Electrical or equivalent electrical\-design software is preferred.
* Ability to troubleshoot independently using electrical drawings, PLC diagnostics and measuring instruments.

4\. Education \& Experience

**Qualification:**  
Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical \& Electronics Engineering, Electronics \& Instrumentation Engineering or related discipline.

**Experience:**  
2–5 years in industrial automation, machine building, system integration or manufacturing automation.

Freshers with strong practical PLC knowledge and relevant project experience may also be considered for junior positions.

description:
Job Description: **Technical Trainer** 

**Job post summary**

**Location:** Bangalore (In\-person)  
**Office Base:** Banashankari, Bangalore  
**Travel Requirement:** Travel to partner schools across Bangalore

**Job Type:** Full\-time, Permanent  
**Schedule:** Day Shift (Monday to Saturday)

**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹30,000 per month (based on experience)

**About the Role**

We are looking for passionate and enthusiastic **Robotics, AI \& STEM Trainers / STEM Teachers** to deliver engaging, hands\-on learning experiences for school students from **Grades 1 to 10**.

The role involves teaching and facilitating practical learning across **Robotics, Electronics, Coding, Artificial Intelligence, Python, AI\-assisted/vibe coding, 3D Printing, and emerging technologies**.

The trainer will travel to different partner schools across Bangalore to conduct STEM sessions, implement curriculum, guide student projects, and create an engaging environment where students can learn by building and experimenting.

**Key Responsibilities**  
1\. STEM Curriculum Development \& Delivery

* Design and deliver structured STEM lessons covering Robotics, Electronics, Coding, AI, and emerging technologies.
* Customize teaching methods according to different age groups and skill levels.
* Conduct practical and activity\-based sessions that encourage students to learn through experimentation.
* Integrate multiple technologies into project\-based learning activities.

2\. Robotics \& Electronics

* Conduct hands\-on training using robotics kits, Arduino, sensors, motors, and basic electronic components.
* Teach students fundamental concepts of circuits, sensors, automation, and robotics.
* Guide students in building and programming simple robotic systems.
* Assist students in troubleshooting hardware, wiring, and robotics\-kit issues.

3\. Coding \& Python

* Teach beginner\-friendly programming concepts using **block\-based coding and Python**.
* Introduce students to programming fundamentals such as variables, conditions, loops, functions, and basic logic.
* Help students develop small applications, games, automation projects, and robotics programs.
* Introduce age\-appropriate computational thinking and problem\-solving concepts.

4\. Artificial Intelligence \& Generative AI

* Introduce students to the **fundamental concepts of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning** in a simple and age\-appropriate manner.
* Explain concepts such as AI, data, models, computer vision, natural language processing, and generative AI at a basic level.
* Conduct beginner\-friendly AI activities and projects.
* Introduce students to responsible and ethical use of AI.
* Demonstrate how AI tools can be used for learning, creativity, research, and problem\-solving.

5\. AI\-Assisted / Vibe Coding

* Introduce students to **AI\-assisted coding and beginner\-level “vibe coding” concepts**.
* Teach students how to describe an idea clearly and use AI coding assistants to help create simple applications and prototypes.
* Help students understand, test, modify, and debug AI\-generated code rather than simply copying it.
* Encourage students to combine creativity, problem\-solving, and programming to build small functional projects.

6\. 3D Printing \& Digital Fabrication

* Introduce students to the basics of **3D printing and digital fabrication**.
* Explain the basic workflow from idea → 3D design → slicing → printing.
* Guide students through simple 3D design/CAD activities.
* Demonstrate basic 3D\-printer operation, material handling, and print troubleshooting.
* Help students create simple physical prototypes and STEM models.

7\. Project\-Based Learning

* Guide students through practical projects combining robotics, coding, AI, electronics, and 3D printing.
* Encourage students to identify real\-world problems and develop technology\-based solutions.
* Support students in building prototypes and demonstrating their projects.
* Encourage creativity, experimentation, teamwork, and innovation.

8\. Classroom Instruction \& Student Engagement

* Conduct interactive and engaging sessions for students from Grades 1–10\.
* Create a positive classroom environment that encourages curiosity and experimentation.
* Explain technical concepts in a simple and student\-friendly manner.
* Manage classrooms effectively while maintaining a hands\-on learning environment.

9\. Student Assessment \& Feedback

* Monitor student progress and maintain performance records.
* Evaluate student understanding through activities, projects, and practical assessments.
* Provide constructive feedback to help students improve their technical and problem\-solving skills.
* Identify students who require additional guidance and support.

10\. Technical Support \& Troubleshooting

* Assist students in troubleshooting robotics kits, electronics, programming, AI tools, and 3D\-printing activities.
* Diagnose basic hardware and software issues during classroom sessions.
* Ensure STEM equipment and kits are properly maintained and ready for use.

11\. Mentorship

* Inspire students to explore Robotics, AI, Coding, Electronics, and other STEM fields.
* Encourage critical thinking, creativity, problem\-solving, and independent learning.
* Help students develop confidence in building and experimenting with technology.

12\. Collaboration \& Coordination

* Work closely with school teachers, administrators, and internal academic teams.
* Coordinate schedules and ensure smooth execution of STEM sessions across multiple schools.
* Maintain effective communication with school staff regarding student activities and requirements.

13\. Professional Development

* Stay updated with developments in Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, Python, coding, 3D printing, and STEM education.
* Continuously explore new educational technologies, AI tools, project ideas, and teaching methodologies.
* Participate in internal training and upskilling programs.

Qualifications

**Education:** Diploma / BSc / BE / B.Ed / M.Sc / M.Tech in Electronics, Computer Science, Physics, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields.

Candidates from other technical or STEM backgrounds with relevant practical skills may also be considered.

Experience

* Freshers are welcome; structured training will be provided.
* 1–2 years of experience in Robotics, STEM education, coding, AI education, or related areas is preferred.
* Experience working with school students or conducting workshops is an advantage.

**Required Skills**

* Basic knowledge of **Robotics and Electronics**.
* Basic programming knowledge in **Arduino, Python, or Block\-based Coding**.
* Basic understanding of **Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI concepts**.
* Familiarity with **AI\-assisted coding / vibe coding** is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of **3D printing and digital fabrication** is an advantage.
* Strong communication and classroom\-management skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and engaging manner.
* Ability to engage and motivate students.
* Good organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Passion for STEM education, technology, and teaching.
* Willingness to travel to partner schools across Bangalore.

**Additional Benefits**

* Structured training and upskilling programs for freshers.
* Exposure to Robotics, AI, Python, 3D Printing, and emerging technologies.
* Opportunity to work with reputed schools across Bangalore.
* Hands\-on experience delivering technology education to school students.
* Opportunity to develop expertise across multiple areas of STEM education.
* Strong career growth opportunities in the **EdTech, Robotics, AI, and STEM education sectors**.

title: Business Development Manager
company: Kathputlee Arts and Films Pvt Ltd
description:
**Business Development Manager**

**HEAD OF BUSINESS**

Advertising \& Video Production \| Kathputlee Arts \& Films Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:** Hybrid \| **Type:** Full\-time \| **Reports to:** Founder

**This is not a sales job. This is the business.**

We are looking for one person who will own Kathputlee's entire business function: from the first client call to the final invoice. No team to hide behind, no leads handed over, no one checking in on your day. You build it, you run it, you answer for it.

**About Kathputlee Arts \& Films**

Kathputlee Arts \& Films is a creative production house working with leading brands and agencies on ad films, corporate films, animation, timelapse projects, branded content, and social media campaigns, alongside our own slate of original films in active development and theatrical release.

We are not a vendor selling video packages. We are a production house with real creative and film credibility. We need someone who can sell that story because they have lived it.

**The Role**

You will take complete ownership of Kathputlee's business development. Nothing about this role is shared, supervised, or handed down. You will:

■ **Build the business function from scratch**, including pipeline, pricing conversations, client relationships, and revenue.

■ **Bring in paying clients from Day 1** using your existing industry network.

■ **Run the full sales cycle independently:** prospecting, pitching, negotiation, closing, and collections.

■ **Be the single point of accountability** for business growth, reporting results to the Founder rather than daily activity.

■ Work with the creative and production teams to shape proposals and pitches that win.

■ Build long\-term, repeat client relationships with brands, agencies, and corporates.

**You will be treated as a partner in the business, and you will be measured like one: on revenue, not effort.**

**YOU OWN THE NUMBER.**

The expectation is not simply: “I generated 20 leads.”

The expectation is: “I brought business, closed projects and generated revenue.”

**Who We Are Looking For**

**Non\-negotiable**

■ **Current or recent experience at an ad film / video production house or advertising agency.** You understand production budgets, timelines, agency workflows, and how brand briefs turn into films.

■ **An active client network you can bring with you.** Brand marketing heads, agency producers, corporate communications teams: people who will take your call this month.

■ **A proven record of independently building or running a business vertical.** You have started something from zero before, whether a new client base, a service line, a regional market, or your own venture, without a support team.

■ **Closed revenue, not generated leads.** You can point to projects you personally brought in and closed.

■ **Complete self\-drive.** You don't need to be told what to do next, and you don't need to be followed up on.

· Strong understanding of how production projects are pitched, priced, negotiated and closed.

**You'll also bring**

■ Strong pitching, negotiation, and closing ability with senior decision\-makers.

■ Commercial judgement on pricing, margins, and which clients are worth pursuing.

■ The credibility to represent Kathputlee in a room with a CMO or an agency creative head.

**CRITICAL REQUIREMENT — EXISTING INDUSTRY NETWORK**

**An existing network is strongly preferred and will be a major consideration.**

The candidate should already have relationships with relevant Brands, Advertising Agencies, Media Agencies, Corporates, Marketing Heads, Brand Managers, Creative Heads, Agency Decision\-Makers and Production Buyers.

We are looking for someone who can say: “These are the clients/agencies I know, these are the relationships I can activate, these are the services I can sell, and this is the business I can realistically pursue.”

The candidate should be able to demonstrate actual business previously generated, while respecting confidentiality and contractual obligations.

**Please Do Not Apply If**

■ You are a fresher or early in your sales career.

■ Your background is outside advertising, film, or video production (IT sales, real estate, FMCG, insurance, EdTech, general B2B, etc.).

■ You are looking to "give it a try" or learn the industry on the job.

■ You need a structured team, assigned leads, or close supervision to perform.

■ Your experience is limited to lead generation, telecalling, or inside sales.

■ Candidates whose experience is primarily cold calling without closing responsibility.

■ Candidates who do not understand video production, advertising or creative services.

■ Candidates who require extensive training before approaching clients.

■ Candidates expecting a ready\-made client database or existing pipeline.

■ Candidates looking for a role where responsibilities are assigned and monitored daily.

*We say this plainly to respect your time and ours.****This is not an opportunity to learn the production business. The candidate should already know the business and be capable of operating independently.***

**What We Will Discuss in the Interview**

Come prepared to talk about:

**1\.** **Your network:** the types of brands, agencies, and decision\-makers you can approach right now.

**2\.** **Your track record:** projects and revenue you have personally brought in, with approximate deal sizes.

**3\.** **Your independent build:** a business, vertical, or client base you built from scratch.

**4\.** **Your first 30 days:** a practical business plan with a realistic revenue projection for Kathputlee.

*Please do not share confidential client information.*

**Compensation**

**Fixed monthly salary \+ performance incentive on realised revenue**

Fixed pay will be based on experience and the strength of the existing client network. Incentives are uncapped and linked directly to business closed and collected. The more you build, the more you earn.

Pay: Up to ₹1,200,000\.00 per year

title: HR Manager – People & Culture
description:
**HR Manager – People \& Culture**  
**Neo Tokyo \| Kochi, Kerala \| Full\-time, on\-site**

**About Neo Tokyo**  
Neo Tokyo is a tech infrastructure company that helps businesses scale without disruption. We build custom PCs, workstations and servers, and deliver networking, AMC and professional services to B2C, B2B and enterprise clients. We're a 24\-person team, growing fast.

**The role**  
You'll be our first dedicated HR leader, and you'll own the entire employee experience. That means hiring, onboarding, attendance, payroll inputs, performance, engagement, culture and exit. The systems exist: an ERP, greytHR, and biometric attendance. Your job is to run them well and improve them. Most of all, you'll make sure every person here feels heard, stays motivated, and works in a space that is productive *and* enjoyable. You'll do that while keeping the company's goals in view.

**What you'll own**

*People \& Culture*

* Hold monthly one\-on\-one check\-ins with every employee, and act on what you hear.
* Run a monthly employee pulse survey and a monthly all\-hands people meeting. Close the loop on every issue raised.
* Design and run a culture calendar: celebrations, team activities, recognition and festivals (Onam, Christmas and more).
* Be the first point of contact for grievances, and resolve them fairly and on time.

*Talent Acquisition*

* Hire end to end for full\-time roles and internships, from requisition to offer.
* Build intern pipelines with Kochi\-area colleges and polytechnics.
* Keep a talent bench for critical roles (technicians, sales, service).

*Onboarding \& Exit*

* Run structured onboarding: documents, appointment letter, system access, first\-week plan, 30/60/90\-day check\-ins.
* Handle exits: notice tracking, handover, asset recovery, exit interview, full\-and\-final inputs, experience letter.

*Attendance, Leave \& Overtime*

* Run biometric attendance and greytHR leave management.
* Calculate and verify overtime for the service team, and for others under the pre\-approval OT policy.
* Report absenteeism and late\-coming trends monthly.

*Payroll \& Performance*

* Prepare monthly payroll inputs (attendance, leave, OT, incentives, variable pay) and hand them to Accounts on schedule.
* Generate and distribute payslips through greytHR.
* Run the performance management cycle: goal setting, monthly reviews with department heads, quarterly appraisals.
* Administer incentive and variable pay based on approved performance data.

*Operations \& Efficiency*

* Study where time goes in our processes, using ERP ticket data, attendance data and team feedback. Find bottlenecks and propose fixes.
* Bring at least one new strategy each quarter to improve motivation, process or productivity.

*Compliance \& Records*

* Maintain complete employee files, statutory registers and compliance filings (PF, ESI, Professional Tax, and Labour Code requirements).
* Keep HR policies and the employee handbook current.

**What we're looking for**

* 4–7 years in HR, including at least 2 years as an HR generalist in an SME. You own everything, not one function.
* **Proven people management**: you've led a team, or led people through a process without formal authority.
* Hands\-on with an HRMS (greytHR preferred) and Excel/Google Sheets: VLOOKUP, pivots, basic formulas.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour law, including the new Labour Codes, PF/ESI/PT and Kerala\-specific rules.
* Fluent in Malayalam and English.
* Warm, approachable and firm. People trust you and also know you'll hold the line.
* Bonus: experience in IT services, hardware, retail tech or a technician\-heavy workforce.

**What success looks like in year one**  
Every employee file is complete. Payroll inputs are error\-free every month. Survey participation is above 85%. Regretted attrition is under 10%. Every open role is filled within 30 days.

We are looking for a responsible and experienced **HSE Officer / HSE Engineer** to ensure a safe and healthy working environment at project sites. **Key Responsibilities**

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.


**Position – Assistant Vice President.**

**Job location\- Bengaluru**

**Reporting to\- Vice President, Talent Acquisition Head**

**Job Summary:**

  

The Assistant Vice President \- Technology Recruitment is responsible for managing and delivering end\-to\-end recruitment for Technology functions. The role will partner with business leaders, hiring managers, HR Business Partners and other stakeholders to understand manpower requirements, develop appropriate sourcing strategies and ensure timely closure of positions in accordance with approved recruitment processes, service standards and governance requirements.


The role will also lead the Technology Recruitment team, monitor hiring performance, manage recruitment partners, provide market intelligence and drive continuous improvement in recruitment delivery and candidate experience.  



**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Recruitment Planning and Delivery**
-------------------------------------

* Partner with Technology hiring managers and HR Business Partners to understand approved manpower requirements, role specifications, hiring priorities and expected timelines.
* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for Technology positions, including requirement intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, selection, offer management and joining follow\-up.
* Develop recruitment plans and sourcing strategies for regular, niche, critical and leadership Technology roles.
* Ensure positions are progressed and closed within agreed service levels and approved recruitment processes.
* Monitor open positions, ageing, candidate pipelines, interview progress, pending feedback, offer status and joining risks.
* Maintain adequate candidate pipelines and backup options for priority roles to support continuity of hiring delivery.
* Escalate recruitment delays, market constraints and decision bottlenecks to the appropriate stakeholders in a timely manner.

**Sourcing and Candidate Management**
-------------------------------------

* Use appropriate sourcing channels, including direct sourcing, employee referrals, internal mobility, recruitment platforms, market mapping and approved recruitment agencies.
* Build talent pipelines for recurring and anticipated Technology skill requirements.
* Conduct initial candidate screening against the approved job description, required competencies, relevant experience, career motivation, availability and compensation expectations.
* Provide shortlisted profiles with clear screening observations and relevant candidate information to hiring managers.
* Ensure candidates receive timely, accurate and professional communication throughout the recruitment process.
* Maintain a consistent and positive candidate experience while safeguarding candidate confidentiality and personal information.

**Stakeholder Management**
--------------------------

* Develop and maintain effective working relationships with Technology leaders, hiring managers, HR Business Partners and internal support teams.
* Conduct structured intake discussions to clarify role scope, essential criteria, assessment approach, interview panel and target timelines.
* Provide regular recruitment updates covering pipeline strength, progress, ageing, risks, decisions required and proposed corrective actions.
* Provide relevant talent\-market information, including skill availability, candidate expectations and sourcing challenges, to facilitate informed hiring decisions.
* Coordinate recruitment governance reviews and proactively manage recruitment\-related concerns and escalations.

**Interview and Selection Management**
--------------------------------------

* Coordinate with hiring teams to establish appropriate interview panels and assessment criteria.
* Facilitate timely interview scheduling and follow\-up on interview feedback and selection decisions.
* Promote structured and consistent assessment against the approved role requirements.
* Monitor interview\-to\-selection conversion and identify recurring reasons for rejection, withdrawal or delay.
* Ensure selection decisions and supporting feedback are appropriately recorded in the recruitment system.

**Offer and Joining Management**
--------------------------------

* Coordinate compensation inputs, offer recommendations and required approvals in accordance with the applicable compensation and recruitment governance framework.
* Manage candidate expectations and negotiations within approved parameters.
* Track offer acceptance, notice period, joining confirmation, counter\-offer risk and potential dropouts.
* Maintain regular engagement with offered candidates until joining and escalate material joining risks.
* Analyse offer declines and joining dropouts and recommend appropriate corrective measures.

**Team Management**
-------------------

* Lead, guide and support recruiters and sourcing resources assigned to Technology hiring.
* Allocate requisitions based on business priority, workload, role complexity and recruiter capability.
* Conduct regular reviews of recruiter pipelines, productivity, quality, delivery risks and pending actions.
* Coach team members on sourcing, screening, stakeholder management, candidate engagement, process compliance and recruitment\-system usage.
* Promote collaboration, knowledge sharing, accountability and consistent service standards across the Technology Recruitment team.

**Vendor Management**
---------------------

* Engage approved recruitment agencies for relevant requirements in accordance with defined processes.
* Provide clear role briefs and submission expectations to recruitment partners.
* Monitor vendor performance based on profile relevance, candidate quality, conversion, turnaround time and service standards.
* Conduct periodic reviews with recruitment partners and address performance concerns through defined corrective actions.
* Ensure agency usage and related documentation comply with applicable commercial and governance requirements.

**Recruitment Operations, Governance and Compliance**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Ensure recruitment activities comply with approved policies, procedures, controls and authorization requirements.
* Maintain complete and accurate recruitment records, including requisition information, candidate stages, interview feedback, selection decisions, approvals and offer documentation.
* Ensure timely and accurate use of Workday Recruit and other approved recruitment tools.
* Safeguard confidential candidate, compensation, employee and business information.
* Support internal and external audits by providing required recruitment documentation and evidence.
* Identify operational risks, process gaps or data\-quality concerns and implement or recommend corrective action.

**Management Information and Continuous Improvement**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Prepare accurate recruitment reports and dashboards for Talent Acquisition leadership and Technology stakeholders.
* Monitor key recruitment indicators, including open positions, ageing, time to offer, time to fill, conversion ratios, offer acceptance, joining conversion, source mix, recruiter productivity and vendor performance.
* Analyse recruitment data to identify trends, delivery risks and improvement opportunities.
* Recommend and support improvements to sourcing, screening, interview coordination, candidate communication, reporting and recruitment governance.
* Participate in Talent Acquisition transformation, standardization, automation and process\-improvement initiatives

***Key Measures***
==================

* Delivery against approved Technology hiring requirements and agreed timelines.
* Adherence to recruitment service levels, governance requirements and data\-quality standards.
* Quality and continuity of candidate pipelines.
* Profile\-to\-interview, interview\-to\-selection, selection\-to\-offer and offer\-to\-joining conversion.
* Time to offer and time to fill.
* Offer acceptance and joining conversion.
* Recruiter productivity and team capability.
* Stakeholder and candidate service quality.
* Sourcing\-channel and recruitment\-partner effectiveness.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources or Business Administration is preferred.
* 12\+ years of experience in recruitment, substantial Talent Acquisition experience, with significant exposure to Technology recruitment.
* Demonstrated experience managing specialist, niche, volume and leadership Technology hiring.
* Experience leading recruiters or a Technology Recruitment team.
* Experience managing senior stakeholders and external recruitment partners.
* Experience using an applicant\-tracking system or enterprise recruitment platform.
* Experience in banking, financial services, a global capability centre, technology services, consulting or a comparable complex organization is preferred.
* Strong understanding of Technology recruitment markets, roles, skills and sourcing channels.
* Effective sourcing, screening, interviewing and candidate\-management capability.
* Strong stakeholder\-management, influencing and negotiation skills.
* Ability to plan and manage multiple priorities, deadlines and escalations.
* Strong analytical ability and attention to recruitment data and reporting accuracy.
* Knowledge of recruitment governance, documentation, controls and confidentiality requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to lead, coach and develop team members.
* Proficiency in applicant\-tracking systems, recruitment platforms and standard productivity tools.

title: Account Executive
description:
**GOENKA HOSPITAL**

**Job Description – Accounts Executive**

**Location:** Near Piplaj, Pethapur, Gandhinagar, Gujarat  
**Department:** Finance \& Accounts  
**Designation:** Accounts Executive  
**Reporting To:** Accounts Manager / Finance Manager / Hospital Management  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**1\. JOB PURPOSE**

The Accounts Executive will be responsible for day\-to\-day accounting operations of Goenka Hospital, including patient billing\-related accounting, receipts, payments, vendor accounts, bank reconciliation, statutory compliance support, insurance/TPA accounting, MIS and financial documentation.

The role requires close coordination with the **Billing, Front Office, Pharmacy, Stores, Purchase, HR, Administration, Insurance/TPA and Hospital Operations teams**.

**2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Day\-to\-Day Accounting**

* Record and maintain day\-to\-day financial transactions.
* Pass accounting entries for receipts, payments, purchases, expenses and other transactions.
* Maintain general ledger and subsidiary ledgers.
* Verify supporting documents before accounting entries.
* Maintain proper filing and documentation of financial records.
* Ensure accurate and timely posting of transactions in the accounting/ERP system.
* Support month\-end and year\-end closing activities.

**B. Hospital Billing \& Patient Accounting**

* Coordinate with the Billing Department regarding patient billing and collections.
* Verify daily patient billing summaries and collection reports.
* Reconcile cash, card, UPI, online payment and other collection modes.
* Verify discounts, refunds, credit notes and adjustments as per approved authority.
* Monitor outstanding patient receivables.
* Reconcile billing system reports with accounting records.
* Investigate and resolve billing/accounting discrepancies.

**C. Insurance \& TPA Accounts**

* Coordinate with the Insurance/TPA Department for financial documentation.
* Track insurance/TPA receivables and outstanding claims.
* Maintain claim\-wise outstanding records.
* Reconcile TPA receipts with submitted claims.
* Follow up for pending payments and deductions.
* Record TPA settlements and adjustments accurately.
* Assist in preparing reports relating to insurance receivables and ageing.

**D. Cash \& Bank Management**

* Verify daily cash collection and deposit records.
* Maintain daily cash book.
* Reconcile cash collections with billing/collection reports.
* Prepare bank reconciliation statements.
* Monitor bank receipts and payments.
* Verify payment transactions and supporting documents.
* Assist in daily/weekly cash\-flow reporting.

**E. Accounts Payable \& Vendor Management**

* Process vendor invoices after proper verification and approval.
* Maintain vendor ledgers and outstanding statements.
* Reconcile vendor accounts periodically.
* Verify purchase invoices with purchase orders/GRNs where applicable.
* Prepare payment\-related documents.
* Follow up with departments for pending invoice documentation.
* Support timely vendor payments as per approved schedules.

**F. Pharmacy, Stores \& Purchase Accounting**

* Coordinate with Pharmacy, Stores and Purchase departments for accounting documentation.
* Verify purchase invoices and supporting records.
* Assist with inventory\-related accounting.
* Reconcile purchase records with accounting entries.
* Support periodic stock reconciliation.
* Identify and report discrepancies between physical and system records.

**G. GST \& TDS Support**

* Assist in GST\-related accounting and reconciliation.
* Verify GST details in purchase and expense invoices.
* Support input tax credit reconciliation.
* Assist in preparation of GST reports and supporting schedules.
* Calculate and record TDS wherever applicable.
* Maintain TDS\-related documentation and support timely compliance.
* Coordinate with consultants/Accounts Manager for statutory requirements.

**H. MIS \& Management Reporting**

Prepare regular reports such as:

* Daily collection report
* Daily cash/bank report
* Patient receivables
* Insurance/TPA outstanding
* Vendor outstanding
* Ageing analysis
* Purchase summary
* Expense statement
* Revenue collection summary
* Bank reconciliation status
* Monthly accounts/MIS reports

**I. Audit Support**

* Assist in statutory and internal audits.
* Provide ledgers, vouchers and supporting documents.
* Prepare audit schedules as required.
* Coordinate with auditors for routine information requests.
* Ensure proper documentation of financial transactions.
* Assist in resolving audit queries and observations.

**3\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES – HOSPITAL ENVIRONMENT**

The Accounts Executive must maintain close coordination with:

**Patient Billing → Cashier → Accounts → TPA/Insurance → Pharmacy → Stores → Purchase → Administration → Management**

The employee should ensure that financial transactions generated through hospital operations are accurately captured, reconciled and reported.

**4\. KEY RESULT AREAS (KRAs)**

**Responsibility**

Daily Accounting

Accurate and timely accounting entries

Patient Collections

**5\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

* Accuracy of accounting entries.
* Daily reconciliation of hospital collections.
* Timely bank reconciliation.

* Reduction in unresolved billing/accounting discrepancies.
* Accuracy of vendor and customer ledgers.
* Timely preparation of MIS.
* Timely submission of statutory information.
* Proper maintenance of vouchers and financial documents.
* Timely closure of audit queries.
* Compliance with hospital financial SOPs.

**6\. QUALIFICATION**

**Minimum Qualification:**

* B.Com / M.Com / equivalent qualification in Commerce or Finance.

**Preferred:**

* CA Inter / CMA Inter or relevant accounting certification.
* Knowledge of GST and TDS.

**7\. EXPERIENCE**

**Preferred Experience:** 2–5 years in Accounts/Finance.

Candidates with experience in:

* Hospital accounting
* Healthcare organisations
* Clinics
* Diagnostic centres
* Insurance/TPA accounting
* Service\-sector accounting

will be preferred.

**8\. REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* Strong knowledge of accounting principles.
* Knowledge of GST and TDS.
* Bank reconciliation.
* Ledger reconciliation.
* Accounts payable and receivable.
* Cash management.
* MIS reporting.

**9\. BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS**

**Position – Assistant Vice President.**

**Job location\- Bengaluru**

**Reporting to\- Vice President, Talent Acquisition Head**

**Job Summary:**

  

The Assistant Vice President \- Technology Recruitment is responsible for managing and delivering end\-to\-end recruitment for Technology functions. The role will partner with business leaders, hiring managers, HR Business Partners and other stakeholders to understand manpower requirements, develop appropriate sourcing strategies and ensure timely closure of positions in accordance with approved recruitment processes, service standards and governance requirements.


The role will also lead the Technology Recruitment team, monitor hiring performance, manage recruitment partners, provide market intelligence and drive continuous improvement in recruitment delivery and candidate experience.  



**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Recruitment Planning and Delivery**
-------------------------------------

* Partner with Technology hiring managers and HR Business Partners to understand approved manpower requirements, role specifications, hiring priorities and expected timelines.
* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for Technology positions, including requirement intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, selection, offer management and joining follow\-up.
* Develop recruitment plans and sourcing strategies for regular, niche, critical and leadership Technology roles.
* Ensure positions are progressed and closed within agreed service levels and approved recruitment processes.
* Monitor open positions, ageing, candidate pipelines, interview progress, pending feedback, offer status and joining risks.
* Maintain adequate candidate pipelines and backup options for priority roles to support continuity of hiring delivery.
* Escalate recruitment delays, market constraints and decision bottlenecks to the appropriate stakeholders in a timely manner.

**Sourcing and Candidate Management**
-------------------------------------

* Use appropriate sourcing channels, including direct sourcing, employee referrals, internal mobility, recruitment platforms, market mapping and approved recruitment agencies.
* Build talent pipelines for recurring and anticipated Technology skill requirements.
* Conduct initial candidate screening against the approved job description, required competencies, relevant experience, career motivation, availability and compensation expectations.
* Provide shortlisted profiles with clear screening observations and relevant candidate information to hiring managers.
* Ensure candidates receive timely, accurate and professional communication throughout the recruitment process.
* Maintain a consistent and positive candidate experience while safeguarding candidate confidentiality and personal information.

**Stakeholder Management**
--------------------------

* Develop and maintain effective working relationships with Technology leaders, hiring managers, HR Business Partners and internal support teams.
* Conduct structured intake discussions to clarify role scope, essential criteria, assessment approach, interview panel and target timelines.
* Provide regular recruitment updates covering pipeline strength, progress, ageing, risks, decisions required and proposed corrective actions.
* Provide relevant talent\-market information, including skill availability, candidate expectations and sourcing challenges, to facilitate informed hiring decisions.
* Coordinate recruitment governance reviews and proactively manage recruitment\-related concerns and escalations.

**Interview and Selection Management**
--------------------------------------

* Coordinate with hiring teams to establish appropriate interview panels and assessment criteria.
* Facilitate timely interview scheduling and follow\-up on interview feedback and selection decisions.
* Promote structured and consistent assessment against the approved role requirements.
* Monitor interview\-to\-selection conversion and identify recurring reasons for rejection, withdrawal or delay.
* Ensure selection decisions and supporting feedback are appropriately recorded in the recruitment system.

**Offer and Joining Management**
--------------------------------

* Coordinate compensation inputs, offer recommendations and required approvals in accordance with the applicable compensation and recruitment governance framework.
* Manage candidate expectations and negotiations within approved parameters.
* Track offer acceptance, notice period, joining confirmation, counter\-offer risk and potential dropouts.
* Maintain regular engagement with offered candidates until joining and escalate material joining risks.
* Analyse offer declines and joining dropouts and recommend appropriate corrective measures.

**Team Management**
-------------------

* Lead, guide and support recruiters and sourcing resources assigned to Technology hiring.
* Allocate requisitions based on business priority, workload, role complexity and recruiter capability.
* Conduct regular reviews of recruiter pipelines, productivity, quality, delivery risks and pending actions.
* Coach team members on sourcing, screening, stakeholder management, candidate engagement, process compliance and recruitment\-system usage.
* Promote collaboration, knowledge sharing, accountability and consistent service standards across the Technology Recruitment team.

**Vendor Management**
---------------------

* Engage approved recruitment agencies for relevant requirements in accordance with defined processes.
* Provide clear role briefs and submission expectations to recruitment partners.
* Monitor vendor performance based on profile relevance, candidate quality, conversion, turnaround time and service standards.
* Conduct periodic reviews with recruitment partners and address performance concerns through defined corrective actions.
* Ensure agency usage and related documentation comply with applicable commercial and governance requirements.

**Recruitment Operations, Governance and Compliance**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Ensure recruitment activities comply with approved policies, procedures, controls and authorization requirements.
* Maintain complete and accurate recruitment records, including requisition information, candidate stages, interview feedback, selection decisions, approvals and offer documentation.
* Ensure timely and accurate use of Workday Recruit and other approved recruitment tools.
* Safeguard confidential candidate, compensation, employee and business information.
* Support internal and external audits by providing required recruitment documentation and evidence.
* Identify operational risks, process gaps or data\-quality concerns and implement or recommend corrective action.

**Management Information and Continuous Improvement**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Prepare accurate recruitment reports and dashboards for Talent Acquisition leadership and Technology stakeholders.
* Monitor key recruitment indicators, including open positions, ageing, time to offer, time to fill, conversion ratios, offer acceptance, joining conversion, source mix, recruiter productivity and vendor performance.
* Analyse recruitment data to identify trends, delivery risks and improvement opportunities.
* Recommend and support improvements to sourcing, screening, interview coordination, candidate communication, reporting and recruitment governance.
* Participate in Talent Acquisition transformation, standardization, automation and process\-improvement initiatives

***Key Measures***
==================

* Delivery against approved Technology hiring requirements and agreed timelines.
* Adherence to recruitment service levels, governance requirements and data\-quality standards.
* Quality and continuity of candidate pipelines.
* Profile\-to\-interview, interview\-to\-selection, selection\-to\-offer and offer\-to\-joining conversion.
* Time to offer and time to fill.
* Offer acceptance and joining conversion.
* Recruiter productivity and team capability.
* Stakeholder and candidate service quality.
* Sourcing\-channel and recruitment\-partner effectiveness.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources or Business Administration is preferred.
* 12\+ years of experience in recruitment, substantial Talent Acquisition experience, with significant exposure to Technology recruitment.
* Demonstrated experience managing specialist, niche, volume and leadership Technology hiring.
* Experience leading recruiters or a Technology Recruitment team.
* Experience managing senior stakeholders and external recruitment partners.
* Experience using an applicant\-tracking system or enterprise recruitment platform.
* Experience in banking, financial services, a global capability centre, technology services, consulting or a comparable complex organization is preferred.
* Strong understanding of Technology recruitment markets, roles, skills and sourcing channels.
* Effective sourcing, screening, interviewing and candidate\-management capability.
* Strong stakeholder\-management, influencing and negotiation skills.
* Ability to plan and manage multiple priorities, deadlines and escalations.
* Strong analytical ability and attention to recruitment data and reporting accuracy.
* Knowledge of recruitment governance, documentation, controls and confidentiality requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to lead, coach and develop team members.
* Proficiency in applicant\-tracking systems, recruitment platforms and standard productivity tools.

description:
**AGASTYA NUTRIFOOD**

**Job Description – Accounts Manager Cum CA**

**Location:** Rajoda, Bavla, Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Department:** Finance \& Accounts  
**Designation:** Accounts Manager Cum CA  
**Reporting To:** Management / Director / CEO  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 5–10 years preferred  
**Qualification:** CA / CA Inter with strong relevant experience in manufacturing accounts

**1\. JOB PURPOSE**

The Accounts Manager Cum CA will be responsible for managing the complete Finance \& Accounts function of Agastya Nutrifood, ensuring accurate accounting, statutory compliance, financial reporting, taxation, internal controls, cash\-flow management and financial planning.

The position will work closely with management and other departments to provide timely financial information and support business decisions.

**2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Financial Accounting \& Reporting**

* Manage day\-to\-day accounting operations and ensure accurate accounting records.
* Supervise general ledger, journal entries, accounts payable and accounts receivable.
* Review bank, vendor, customer and inter\-company reconciliations.
* Ensure timely month\-end and year\-end closing.
* Prepare monthly MIS and financial reports for management.
* Analyse revenue, expenses, profitability and major cost variances.
* Maintain proper documentation and audit trails for all financial transactions.
* Coordinate preparation of Balance Sheet, Profit \& Loss Account and Cash Flow statements.

**B. GST \& Direct Tax Compliance**

* Ensure timely GST compliance, including GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B and other applicable returns.
* Monitor input tax credit reconciliation and resolve discrepancies.
* Coordinate GST audit, departmental notices and assessments.
* Manage TDS compliance, deductions, payments and returns.
* Coordinate Income Tax return filing, tax audits and related requirements.
* Support tax planning and ensure compliance with applicable tax laws.
* Maintain proper records for statutory assessments and notices.

**C. Costing \& Manufacturing Finance**

* Monitor product costing and manufacturing expenses.
* Analyse raw material, labour, overhead and production costs.
* Review inventory valuation and stock accounting.
* Coordinate physical stock verification and investigate variances.
* Prepare cost and profitability analysis for management.
* Monitor production\-related expenses and identify cost\-control opportunities.
* Support budgeting and standard\-cost development.

**D. Accounts Payable \& Receivable**

* Supervise vendor invoice processing and payment schedules.
* Review vendor outstanding and ageing reports.
* Monitor customer receivables and collection status.
* Prepare receivable ageing and follow up with concerned departments.
* Ensure proper approval and documentation before payments.
* Monitor credit limits and payment terms.

**E. Banking \& Cash Flow Management**

* Manage banking transactions and bank reconciliations.
* Prepare daily/weekly cash\-flow positions.
* Monitor working capital requirements.
* Coordinate fund transfers, payments and banking documentation.
* Liaise with banks for routine financial matters.
* Support management in cash\-flow planning.

**F. Budgeting \& MIS**

* Prepare annual budgets in coordination with management and departments.
* Prepare monthly budget\-versus\-actual analysis.
* Develop financial MIS and management dashboards.
* Identify significant variances and provide explanations.
* Provide financial data and analysis for management decision\-making.

**G. Audit \& Statutory Compliance**

* Coordinate statutory audit, tax audit and internal audit activities.
* Prepare schedules, supporting documents and audit confirmations.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Maintain statutory records and financial documentation.
* Coordinate with external consultants, auditors and tax professionals where required.

**H. Internal Controls**

* Establish and monitor accounting controls.
* Ensure proper segregation of duties and approval mechanisms.
* Review financial transactions for accuracy and compliance.
* Identify financial risks and recommend corrective measures.
* Strengthen SOPs for purchase, sales, inventory, payments and expenses.

**I. Team Management**

* Lead and supervise the Accounts \& Finance team.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor work completion.
* Review accounting entries and reports prepared by the team.
* Train team members on accounting procedures and compliance.
* Establish timelines and performance standards for the department.

**3\. KEY RESULT AREAS (KRAs)**

**KRA**

**Key Responsibility**

Financial Accounting

Accurate and timely books of accounts

Statutory Compliance

Timely GST, TDS, Income Tax and other applicable compliance

MIS \& Reporting

Timely and accurate monthly MIS

Working Capital

Effective receivable, payable and cash\-flow management

Cost Control

Monitoring manufacturing costs and variances

Audit

Smooth and timely completion of audits

Inventory Accounting

Accurate stock accounting and reconciliation

Internal Controls

Effective financial controls and SOP implementation

Team Management

Efficient performance of Accounts \& Finance team

Management Support

Financial analysis and decision support

**4\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

* Monthly accounts closing completed within defined timeline.
* Accuracy of financial statements and MIS.
* Timely filing of GST, TDS and other statutory returns.
* Reduction in reconciliation and accounting discrepancies.
* Timely collection of receivables.
* Effective control over vendor payments and outstanding.
* Accuracy of inventory valuation.
* Budget\-versus\-actual variance monitoring.
* Timely completion of audits.
* Number/value of unresolved audit observations.
* Cash\-flow forecasting accuracy.
* Reduction of unnecessary financial costs and leakages.

**Infinnium Infotech** is redefining the way organizations engage with data to gain actionable intelligence. We develop software solutions for corporations, law firms, and government agencies using modern technologies such as AI and machine learning to support information governance, including compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and other privacy regulations, litigation readiness, and electronic discovery.Our software product brings simplicity to the complex world of digital data, combining the strength of people and modern technology to help organizations effectively address today’s complex information governance needs and realize the intrinsic value of their data.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a **Technical Writer / Product Documentation Specialist** to join our team and help create and maintain clear, accurate, and user\-friendly product documentation.

The role involves working closely with Product, Development, QA, and Support teams to understand product functionality, UI changes, new features, enhancements, and workflows, and convert this information into comprehensive help documentation.

This role will be particularly important as we undergo a major UI transformation of the product, requiring significant documentation updates and new content within defined timelines. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with technical information, reviewing development stories, understanding application workflows, coordinating with technical teams, and using AI powered tools to improve documentation quality and efficiency.

**Role Summary :**

This position is ideal for a technically inclined writer who enjoys learning software products, collaborating with engineering and QA teams, and turning complex product functionality into clear, practical user documentation. Candidates who combine strong English communication skills with technical curiosity, attention to detail, and effective use of AI\-assisted tools are encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Review TFS/Azure DevOps stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical details to understand new features and product changes.
* Analyze existing and newly developed product functionality and understand end\-to\-end user workflows.
* Work closely with developers, QA/testers, product teams, and support teams to clarify functionality and documentation requirements.
* Participate in discussions, demonstrations, and walkthroughs with developers and testers to understand how features work in the actual product.
* Create and update product help files, user guides, feature documentation, configuration guides, and workflow documentation.
* Document new features and UI changes with clear, structured, and easy\-to\-understand explanations.
* Review the application UI and ensure documentation accurately reflects the latest screens, fields, buttons, options, workflows, and terminology.
* Identify gaps or inconsistencies between product functionality and existing documentation and coordinate with relevant teams for clarification.
* Document configuration options, prerequisites, permissions, limitations, dependencies, and expected behavior where applicable.
* Update existing documentation whenever product functionality, workflows, or UI elements change.
* Maintain consistency in terminology, formatting, structure, screenshots, and documentation standards across the product.
* Coordinate documentation updates with product releases and ensure documentation is completed within required timelines.
* Upload and publish completed documentation to the product/help system as required.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Excellent technical writing and documentation skills.
* Ability to understand software functionality and explain it in simple, user\-friendly language.
* Experience working with software products, SaaS applications, or technical platforms.
* Ability to read and understand user stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical discussions.

description:
Production Head – Frozen Chicken IndustryRoles \& Responsibilities

**Job Title:** Production Head – Frozen Chicken Processing  
**Department:** Production  
**Industry:** Frozen Food / Poultry Processing  
**Location:** Plant / Factory

1\. Production Planning \& Target Achievement

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly production plans based on sales and dispatch requirements.
* Ensure production targets are achieved as per quantity, quality and delivery schedules.
* Plan manpower, machinery, raw materials and production capacity.
* Monitor production output against planned targets and take corrective action.
* Minimize production delays, downtime and bottlenecks.

2\. Frozen Chicken Processing Operations

* Manage the complete production process from **raw chicken receiving to finished frozen product dispatch**.
* Monitor processes such as:
* Raw material receiving
* Slaughtering / dressing, where applicable
* Cutting and deboning
* Portioning
* Marination / seasoning
* Value\-added products
* Packing
* Blast freezing / IQF freezing
* Cold storage
* Dispatch
* Ensure process parameters are followed at every stage.

3\. Quality \& Food Safety

* Ensure production complies with **HACCP, GMP, GHP, FSSAI and company food\-safety standards**.
* Coordinate with QA/QC for product quality and process compliance.
* Monitor product temperature, especially during processing, freezing and storage.
* Control contamination, foreign\-body risks and cross\-contamination.
* Ensure proper hygiene and sanitation practices on the production floor.
* Investigate quality complaints and implement corrective/preventive actions.

4\. Manpower Management

* Plan manpower requirements based on production volume.
* Allocate workers and supervisors across production lines.
* Monitor attendance, productivity and performance.
* Train employees on SOPs, hygiene, safety and food\-handling practices.
* Manage contract labour and manpower productivity.
* Take disciplinary/corrective action in coordination with HR.

5\. Productivity \& Cost Control

* Monitor **yield, recovery percentage and production efficiency**.
* Reduce meat loss, trimming loss, rejection and wastage.
* Control overtime and manpower costs.
* Improve line productivity and machine utilization.
* Track production cost per kg.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and cost reduction.

6\. Machinery \& Maintenance Coordination

* Coordinate with Maintenance for preventive and breakdown maintenance.
* Ensure critical production equipment is available and operational.
* Monitor downtime and production losses.
* Coordinate maintenance of:
* Cutting machines
* Conveyor systems
* Packing machines
* Vacuum packing machines
* IQF/blast freezers
* Refrigeration systems
* Metal detectors
* Weighing systems
* Ensure production machines are operated safely.

7\. Inventory \& Material Management

* Coordinate with Stores and Purchase for availability of:
* Raw chicken
* Packaging materials
* Ingredients
* Labels
* Cleaning chemicals
* Consumables
* Avoid production stoppages due to material shortages.
* Monitor material consumption against standards.
* Control excess inventory and wastage.

8\. Cold Chain Management

* Ensure required temperature is maintained throughout processing and storage.
* Monitor freezer and cold\-room temperatures.
* Ensure minimum product exposure time outside controlled\-temperature areas.
* Coordinate with Cold Storage and Dispatch teams.
* Maintain proper FIFO/FEFO practices.

9\. Documentation \& MIS

Prepare/review daily production reports covering:

* Production quantity
* Product\-wise production
* Raw material consumption
* Yield %
* Rejection %
* Wastage
* Manpower
* Machine downtime
* Freezing quantity
* Packing quantity
* Dispatch quantity
* Production cost/kg
* Target vs. actual production

10\. Safety \& Statutory Compliance

* Ensure safe working practices throughout the production area.
* Ensure employees use PPE such as gloves, aprons, masks, safety shoes and hairnets.
* Conduct regular safety inspections.
* Report and investigate accidents/incidents.
* Ensure compliance with applicable factory, labour, food\-safety and environmental requirements.

11\. Team Leadership

* Lead Production Managers, Production Supervisors, Line Leaders and operators.
* Conduct daily production meetings.
* Set KPIs and performance targets for production staff.
* Review employee performance and productivity.
* Develop supervisors and line leaders for future responsibilities.
