title: Associate Legal HR
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced strong Legal HR Associate with approximately 5 years of relevant experience to manage and support employee\-related legal, contractual, compliance, immigration, and HR matters.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of employment laws, HR policies, employee documentation, contracts, statutory requirements, case management, immigration matters, and HR systems. The role requires close coordination between HR, Legal, Management, employees, external consultants, and government authorities wherever required.

The candidate should be comfortable handling sensitive employee matters, maintaining confidentiality, interpreting applicable legal frameworks, and ensuring that HR practices remain aligned with organizational policies and applicable laws.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Employee Legal \& HR Management

* Manage employee\-related legal and HR matters throughout the employee lifecycle, including joining, employment, transfers, promotions, disciplinary matters, separation, and exit formalities.
* Provide HR and management teams with support on employee\-related legal requirements and documentation.
* Review employee grievances, disputes, disciplinary matters, and other sensitive employee cases.
* Ensure proper documentation and maintenance of employee records relating to legal and compliance matters.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of employee and organizational information.

2\. Employment Contracts \& Documentation

* Draft, review, and maintain employment agreements, appointment letters, amendments, NDAs, confidentiality agreements, service agreements, consultancy agreements, and other employee\-related documents.
* Ensure employment contracts are aligned with applicable employment laws and company policies.
* Coordinate with internal/external legal counsel for complex contractual matters.
* Monitor contract renewals, amendments, notice periods, and other contractual obligations.
* Maintain proper records and tracking systems for employee contracts and legal documents.

3\. Employment Law \& Compliance

* Monitor and support compliance with applicable labour and employment laws, regulations, rules, notifications, and statutory requirements.
* Assist in interpreting legal provisions affecting employees and HR operations.
* Review HR policies and processes from a legal and compliance perspective.
* Support implementation and periodic review of employee\-related policies.
* Identify potential legal/compliance risks in HR processes and recommend appropriate corrective actions.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders for statutory and regulatory compliance.

4\. Employee Cases \& Dispute Management

* Manage and maintain records of employee\-related cases, complaints, disciplinary proceedings, show\-cause notices, investigations, and disputes.
* Assist in conducting internal investigations and preparing relevant documentation.
* Draft responses, notices, warning letters, disciplinary communications, and other employee\-related legal correspondence.
* Coordinate with external advocates, consultants, and legal advisors where required.
* Maintain a centralized tracker for ongoing and closed employee cases.
* Ensure timely follow\-up and closure of employee legal matters.

5\. Immigration \& Work Authorization

* Manage employee immigration and work authorization matters, where applicable.
* Coordinate with employees, immigration consultants, legal advisors, and relevant authorities for visa, work permit, employment authorization, residency, and related documentation.
* Track visa/work permit validity, renewals, expiry dates, and associated compliance requirements.
* Maintain accurate immigration records and ensure timely action on renewals and documentation.
* Support employee relocation and international assignment processes from a legal and compliance perspective.

6\. HR Systems \& Employee Data

* Manage and maintain employee legal and contractual information within relevant HRMS/HRIS systems.
* Ensure employee records, contracts, legal documents, case information, and compliance data are accurately updated.
* Develop and maintain trackers, dashboards, and reports relating to contracts, cases, immigration, compliance, and employee documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve HR processes through effective use of HR systems and automation.
* Ensure appropriate access controls and confidentiality of sensitive employee data.

7\. Policies, Processes \& Legal Framework

* Assist in developing, reviewing, and updating HR policies, procedures, SOPs, and employee handbooks.
* Ensure HR processes are consistent with applicable legal requirements and organizational policies.
* Conduct periodic reviews of employment\-related processes to identify legal or operational gaps.
* Support implementation of new legal requirements and regulatory changes affecting employees.
* Assist management in assessing legal implications of proposed HR decisions and practices.

8\. Employee Relations

* Partner with HR Business Partners and management on sensitive employee relations matters.
* Support resolution of employee grievances and workplace disputes in accordance with company policies and applicable law.
* Assist with disciplinary procedures and ensure appropriate documentation and due process.
* Provide guidance on employee communications involving contractual, disciplinary, policy, or legal matters.

9\. Audit \& Compliance Support

* Support internal and external audits relating to employee records, HR processes, contracts, and statutory compliance.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and evidence for compliance reviews.
* Track identified compliance gaps and coordinate corrective actions.
* Prepare periodic reports for HR and senior management on legal, compliance, case, and contractual matters.

Key Skills \& Competencies

* Strong knowledge of employment/labour laws and HR legal frameworks.
* Good understanding of employee lifecycle management and HR processes.
* Strong contract drafting and review skills.
* Experience in employee relations and case management.
* Knowledge of immigration and work authorization processes.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong documentation and record\-management abilities.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters with discretion.
* Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.
* Ability to interpret legal requirements and translate them into practical HR processes.
* Proficiency in MS Office and HRMS/HRIS platforms.
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through.

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Law (LLB) is preferred/required.
* Additional qualification in Human Resources, Labour Law, Employment Law, Compliance, or a related field will be an advantage.
* Candidates with relevant legal and HR experience will be preferred.

Experience

* 5\+ years of relevant experience in HR Legal, Employment Law, Legal HR, Employee Relations, Labour Compliance, or a similar role.
* Experience working with employee contracts, employee cases, HR policies, compliance, and immigration matters is preferred.
* Experience in a corporate/organization environment with structured HR and legal processes is desirable.

Key Deliverables / KPIs

* Timely and accurate management of employee contracts and legal documentation.
* Effective tracking and closure of employee\-related cases.
* Compliance with applicable employment and labour regulations.
* Timely management of immigration/work authorization requirements.
* Accuracy and completeness of employee legal records in HR systems.
* Timely review and implementation of legal/regulatory changes.
* Reduction of HR\-related legal and compliance risks.
* Effective support to HR and management on employee legal matters.
* Timely completion of audits and compliance requirements.

title: 3D printing Engineer
description:
**About us**

Divide By Zero Technologies designs and manufactures industrial 3D printers in Navi Mumbai. We don't import machines and put our sticker on them — we design the motion system, the extruder, the firmware and the electronics ourselves, and we build them here.

Twelve years in, over 1,300 machines installed across defence, aerospace, automotive, medical, education and general engineering customers. Alongside the machine business we run our own print services bureau, making jigs, fixtures, gauges, prototypes and low\-volume production parts for customers on our own Quantum Pro 500, Aeqon 400 V4, Alpha 500 and Aion 500 MK2 machines.

**What the role actually is**

**You run our print floor.**

A customer file lands. You check it will actually print — wall thickness, feature size, mesh errors, overhangs. You pick the material and profile, slice it, put it on the right machine, and watch the first few layers. When it's done you pull the supports, finish the part, measure it against the drawing, and if it isn't right you print it again. Then you pack it, label it, and get it out the door on the date we promised.

**Every job that leaves this building goes through your hands.**

Two things make this more than machine\-minding. Our bureau is also our proving ground — the sample parts printed here are what convince customers to buy a machine, so the quality of your work directly turns into sales. And because we *build* these printers, when something behaves strangely the engineers who designed the extruder are sitting two rooms away. Your observations from the floor go straight back into the product.

You do not need to know all of this on day one. You need to be practical, careful, and genuinely interested in making things work. We will train you on our machines, materials and slicer profiles.

**What you will do**

* Check incoming customer files for printability and flag problems before the job starts
* Pick the material and profile, set orientation and supports, and slice the job
* Plan jobs across the machines so the fleet stays busy and jobs go out on time
* Start prints, watch them, and catch failures early instead of losing a full build
* Post\-process — support removal, deburring, sanding, drilling, tapping, assembly
* Measure finished parts against the drawing with calipers and gauges, and reprint what doesn't pass
* Run daily and weekly machine maintenance — nozzle checks, bed levelling, belt tension, cleaning — and log it
* Track filament stock and consumption, store material properly, raise indents before you run out
* Update the job tracker for every single job, file receipt through to dispatch
* Pack, label and dispatch finished parts
* Print sample and demo parts for the sales team at short notice
* Report recurring faults and odd machine behaviour to the engineering team

**What we need from you**

**Must have**

* Diploma or B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing, Mechatronics or Automobile Engineering. ITI with strong machine\-handling aptitude is fine
* Comfortable working with machines hands\-on — loading, levelling, changing nozzles, clearing jams
* Able to read a basic 2D drawing — dimensions, tolerances, orientation
* Careful and methodical. You follow a written SOP exactly and you record what you actually did, not what you meant to do
* Real attention to detail on finished parts — you spot stringing, layer shift, warping and dimensional drift before the customer does
* Basic computer skills and willingness to learn new software
* Hindi and Marathi for the floor, working English for job notes
* Based in or around Navi Mumbai — Nerul, Vashi, Panvel, Kharghar, Belapur, Thane

**Nice to have**

* Hands\-on with a slicer — Simplify3D, Cura, PrusaSlicer, Bambu Studio
* Familiar with STL, STEP or OBJ files and basic mesh repair
* Worked with PLA, PLA\-CF, PETG, ABS, ASA, PA6\-CF or PC
* Any CAD exposure — SolidWorks, Fusion 360, AutoCAD — even from a college project
* Experience in a machine shop, tool room, CNC job shop, prototyping lab or plastics unit

**If you have built, tuned or repaired a 3D printer yourself — even a cheap one at home — tell us in your application. We will move you to the front of the queue regardless of your formal experience.**

Why this is a good place to learn this trade

* You will work on industrial machines, not desktop hobby printers — build volumes and materials most people in this field never get to touch
* The people who designed the machine are in the same building. When you want to know why something happens, you can go and ask
* Full training on machines, materials and profiles. Freshers are genuinely welcome here
* Clear growth path — Print Services Executive into Senior Executive, then into applications engineering or service engineering as you build depth
* You will see finished parts go out to real defence, automotive and aerospace customers every week

Compensation and details

* ₹15,000 – ₹22,000 per month, depending on hands\-on experience
* Day shift, Monday to Saturday
* In person at Nerul West, Navi Mumbai

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹22,000\.00 per month

title: BUSINESS CONSULTANT, INTERN - INDIA (4 POSITIONS)
description:
### **About Us**


Phenom Cloud is a partner in enterprise digital transformation. We lead with innovative cloud, business, ERP, and people\-centric solutions, crafting groundbreaking strategies from our global innovation hubs to meet your unique needs. Our blend of deep expertise and best practices empowers you to boost performance, drive continuous improvement, and secure lasting results.


### **Position Summary**


We are seeking Business Consultant \- Intern to join our Global Consulting Group. This is an exciting entry\-level opportunity for graduates who are curious about business, technology, and how organizations work, and who want to build a career in global technology consulting.


You do not need prior experience in HR Technology, Learning Management Systems, or Cornerstone for this role. We will provide structured training to help you understand HR fundamentals, business processes, enterprise technology, and Cornerstone OnDemand (CSOD). After successful completion of internship and certifications, Phenom Cloud will absorb interns as a Business Consultant.


As a Business Consultant \- Intern, you will work with experienced consultants to understand customer requirements, configure solutions, test systems, prepare documentation, and support global customers in implementing and improving their learning and talent solutions. The role offers an opportunity to build expertise at the intersection of Business, HR, Technology, and Consulting.


### **Duties \& Responsibilities**


* Develop a strong understanding of how organizations manage their employees, with a focus on Learning, Development, Talent, and related HR processes.
* Participate in structured training on HR fundamentals, HR processes, HR Technology, Learning Management Systems, and Cornerstone OnDemand (CSOD).
* Learn how enterprise organizations use technology to manage employee learning, development, compliance, certifications, and talent programs.
* Work with senior consultants to understand customer business requirements and translate them into effective functional solutions.
* Participate in customer discovery sessions, requirements gathering, process discussions, and solution design activities.
* Support configuration and administration of CSOD solutions under the guidance of experienced consultants.
* Assist with solution validation, system configuration, testing, and troubleshooting during customer implementations.
* Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect tracking, and deployment readiness activities.
* Update project documentation including requirements documents, configuration workbooks, test scenarios, user guides, and knowledge transfer materials.
* Assist with data preparation, validation, migration, and reconciliation activities as part of customer implementations.
* Support reporting, dashboards, and learning\-related data requirements.
* Participate in customer meetings, workshops, demonstrations, and knowledge transfer sessions as your consulting skills develop.
* Work closely with Business Consultants, Technical Consultants, Project Managers, and customer stakeholders throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Support administrator training, user enablement, and post\-go\-live activities to help customers successfully adopt their solutions.
* Analyze customer requirements and issues, identify possible solutions, and work with senior consultants to resolve challenges.
* Develop strong consulting, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills through hands\-on project experience.
* Stay curious and continuously learn about HR, technology, AI, Learning Technology, and emerging enterprise applications.
* Progressively take ownership of assigned activities and workstreams as you develop your consulting and platform expertise.
### **Skills \& Requirements**


* Bachelor's degree in any discipline, including Business Administration, Human Resources, Commerce, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related fields.
* Fresh graduates and candidates with 0–2 year of experience are encouraged to apply.
* No prior experience in HR Technology, CSOD, or LMS platforms is required.
* Strong interest in learning how businesses and organizations work and how technology can improve business processes.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to understand processes, identify patterns, and think logically.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently.
* Ability to learn new concepts, technologies, and business processes quickly.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with data, system configuration, testing, and documentation.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and other productivity tools.
* Ability to work collaboratively with team members and interact professionally with customers and stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Willingness to work in global time zones, including US business hours, as required.
### **Benefits**


* performance\-related variable pay (bonus).
* Group Medical Insurance covering self and dependents.
* Provident Fund (PF) and Gratuity as per statutory norms.
* Group Term Life and Personal Accident Insurance.
* Annual leave plus applicable public holidays.
* Professional development budget and certification support (including Cornerstone and platform certifications).
* A culture of continuous innovation.
### **How to Apply**


If you are an experienced professional ready to take on role and drive meaningful transformation for global enterprises, we would love to hear from you.


Phenom Cloud Limited is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of background, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation.

title: University Recruiting Coordinator
description:
GE Vernova is looking for a highly organized and detail\-oriented University Recruiting Coordinator to provide essential administrative support to our high\-volume early\-career hiring programs. This role is split equally between two key areas: streamlining the recruitment process for interns and entry\-level hires and managing the logistics and coordination for campus recruiting events across the region. If you thrive on execution, enjoy bringing order to complexity, and have an interest in Talent Acquisition, this is the perfect role for you.
**Job Description**
===================


**Responsibilities**  



**50% \- Recruitment Administration \& Candidate Flow Management**


* **High\-Volume Administrative Support:** Provide core administrative support for the University Recruiting team, focused on high\-volume intern, co\-op, and entry\-level requisitions.
* **Initial Candidate Screening:** Support recruiters by conducting initial CV/resume screening against basic job qualifications to ensure candidates meet minimum requirements before advancing.
* **Interview Scheduling:** Own the scheduling and coordination of high\-volume candidate interviews (phone, virtual, and in\-person), managing complex calendars across candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers.
* **ATS Management:** Ensure data accuracy within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS), processing background checks, managing candidate status changes, and generating reports as needed.
* **Candidate Communication:** Manage administrative candidate communications, ensuring a professional and positive experience from application to offer.
  

  

**50% \- Campus Event \& Program Logistics**


* **Event Planning \& Execution:** Handle all administrative planning and logistical tasks for regional campus recruiting events, including career fairs, information sessions, on\-campus interviews, and networking events.
* **Materials \& Swag:** Manage the inventory, ordering, and shipment of recruiting materials, booth supplies, and promotional swag to ensure delivery to campus events on time.
* **Travel \& Expense:** Coordinate travel arrangements and manage expense reports for the University Recruiting team and participating internal volunteers.
* **Volunteer Coordination:** Coordinate internal business volunteers who support campus events, managing their registration, materials, and schedules.
* **Invoicing \& Budget Tracking:** Process invoices related to university partnerships and event expenditures, tracking spend against the recruiting budget.
  

  

**Qualifications \& Experience**

  

  

* 1\-4 years of professional experience in administrative, coordination, or support role
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field; a Master’s degree or MBA is considered an asset.
* Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint) and/or SmartSheets.
* Experience or strong comfort level working in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.
* A strong interest in the Talent Acquisition or Human Resources field.
  

  

**Desired Characteristics**


* Prior experience in a University Recruiting or HR administrative support role is a significant advantage.
* Exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail; you are the go\-to person for keeping things running smoothly.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a professional demeanor when interacting with candidates and internal stakeholders.
* High sense of urgency and ownership; ability to proactively anticipate needs and problem\-solve.
* Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) is a plus.

**Additional Information**
==========================


**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

· Professional Experience: 3 to 5 years in executive administration, project management, operations, or CXO/Chairperson office coordination (corporate or non\-profit sector).

· Administrative \& Accounting Literacy: Demonstrated competence managing invoice generation, expense tracking, balance sheet fundamentals, and CA coordination.

· Publishing \& Communications Acumen: Exceptional written and verbal English \& Hindi communication skills; prior exposure to managing document layouts, editorial workflows, or corporate newsletters is highly desirable.

 Rajyog International Private Limited is a well\-established leader in the marble and granite industry, founded in 1996 and recognized for its consistent growth and strong reputation. The company supplies high\-quality marble and granite blocks and slabs to global markets including China, Indonesia, Thailand, Italy, Dubai, Singapore, Oman, Turkey, Taiwan, and Vietnam. **Role Description** 
 The Human Resources Manager will oversee the full spectrum of HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, employee relations, and compliance with employment laws and company policies. The role involves developing and implementing HR policies, managing payroll and benefits administration in coordination with the finance team, and maintaining accurate employee records. The Human Resources Manager will work closely with leadership and department heads to identify workforce needs, support organizational development, and promote a positive, safe, and inclusive work environment. Daily responsibilities also include handling disciplinary procedures, conflict resolution, training coordination, and supporting employee engagement and retention initiatives. title: Head HR
description:
We are looking for a
 **Head of Human Resources** 
 with 20\+ years of comprehensive HR leadership experience spanning corporate strategy and plant\-level execution. This role requires a business\-savvy leader who can seamlessly switch between strategic boardroom discussions (compensation restructuring, talent pipelines, M\&A/org design) and ground\-level plant HR operations (EHS, plant productivity, labor compliance, shop\-floor engagement).
 



 Core Key Result Areas (KRAs) \& Responsibilities
 



  





 1\.
 **Corporate HR \& Strategic Talent Management** 




  




* **Strategic HR Partnering:** 
 Translate long\-term business goals into human capital strategies, org structure design, and manpower budgets.
* **Leadership Acquisition:** 
 Drive executive search and top\-tier hiring for leadership, specialized engineering, R\&D, and business heads.
* **Total Rewards \& Comp\-Benefits:** 
 Design competitive compensation structures, variable pay schemes, long\-term incentive plans (LTIPs), and benefit benchmarkings across corporate and operational bands.
* **Performance Management (PMS):** 
 Drive OKR/KPI frameworks, annual appraisal cycles, calibration matrices, and performance improvement plans (PIP).
* **Talent Management \& Succession Planning:** 
 Identify high\-potential talent (HIPO), build leadership pipelines, and establish succession plans for critical C\-suite and plant leadership roles.



  





 2\.
 **Plant HR \& Manufacturing Operations** 




  




* **Plant HR Governance:** 
 Oversee site\-level HR heads across facilities to ensure smooth daily shop\-floor operations, shift planning, and absenteeism management.
* **Industrial Relations \& Compliance:** 
 Manage labor dynamics, trade unions, long\-term wage settlements (LTWS), and zero\-stoppage operations while maintaining 100% adherence to labor laws and Factory Acts.
* **Contract Labor Management:** 
 Optimize contract workforce deployment, vendor compliance, productivity norms, and statutory obligations (PF, ESI, Factory Rules).
* **EHS \& Employee Welfare:** 
 Enforce safety culture, health protocols, plant canteen/transport infrastructure, and environmental safety standards (ISO/OHSAS).



  





 3\.
 **HR Operations, Systems \& Governance** 




  




* **HR Digitalization \& Tech:** 
 Implement and optimize HRMS, ATS, payroll engines, and attendance/time\-tracking systems across corporate and site locations.
* **HR Analytics \& Metrics:** 
 Track critical metrics—Attrition Rate, Cost\-per\-Hire, Revenue\-per\-Employee, Overtime Cost, and Employee Engagement Scores.
* **Policy \& Governance:** 
 Formulate, review, and roll out corporate policies, code of conduct, POSH guidelines, and disciplinary protocols.



  





 4\.
 **Organization Development (OD) \& Learning** 




  




* **Capability Building:** 
 Build functional/technical training matrices for plant workers and leadership/soft\-skills programs for corporate teams.
* **Culture \& Engagement:** 
 Drive company\-wide core values, employee pulse surveys, reward \& recognition (R\&R) programs, and DEI initiatives.



  





**Required Profile \& Competencies** 




  




* **Education:** 
 Full\-time MBA / MSW
* **Experience:** 
 20\+ years of total HR experience, with at least 8\-10 years in a Head of HR / CHRO capacity managing dual corporate and multi\-plant environments.
* **Industry Focus:** 
 Automotive, Heavy Engineering, Process Manufacturing, Logistics, or FMCG.



  





**Key Behavioral Traits** 



* High business acumen \& strategic perspective.
* Strong negotiation and crisis management capabilities.
* Ability to connect with shop\-floor workers as effectively as C\-suite executives.

title: Senior Executive - HR Operations
description:
**Key Responsibilities** 




*1\. Onboarding \& Induction* 



* Coordinate pre\-joining formalities: offer/appointment letter issuance, document collection and joining schedules.
* Conduct joining formalities and the induction programme covering company overview, policies, safety norms, code of conduct and systems access.
* Coordinate with IT, Admin, Accounts and department heads for laptops, ID cards, email IDs, access and seating before Day 1\.
* Track probation and confirmation timelines, and collect new\-joiner feedback at 30/60/90 days.
* Maintain the joiner checklist and ensure complete, verified personnel files (including BGV coordination with the HR Manager).



*2\. Attendance \& Leave Management* 



* Consolidate and validate daily/monthly attendance from biometric or HRMS systems.
* Track leaves, late marks, on\-duty entries and regularisations, and resolve discrepancies with department heads.
* Share the finalised attendance and leave data with the payroll team by the cut\-off date.



*3\. Payroll Support* 



* Prepare monthly payroll inputs: joiners, exits, attendance, leave encashment, incentives, reimbursements and deductions.
* Check payroll sheets/reports for accuracy before release and raise variances with the HR Manager.
* Support statutory compliance inputs (PF, ESI, PT, TDS) and coordinate with Accounts/Finance and auditors as required.
* Handle employee payroll queries and payslip\-related requests.



*4\. TA/DA Processing* 



* Receive, verify and process employee travel claims (TA) and daily allowance (DA) against company policy and approvals.
* Check supporting documents, rate eligibility and grade entitlements, and flag policy deviations.
* Coordinate claim settlement with Accounts and maintain the monthly TA/DA tracker and reports.



*5\. General HR Operations* 



* Maintain the employee master data, HRIS records and HR MIS (headcount, attrition, joiners/exits, attendance summaries).
* Support the exit process: resignation acceptance, clearance, full \& final inputs and issue of relieving/experience letters.
* Issue HR letters and certificates (confirmation, salary/employment verification, transfers, etc.).
* Assist with employee engagement activities, statutory displays/registers and audits.
* Support the HR Manager on policy updates, performance appraisal cycles and ad\-hoc HR projects.



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* MBA/PGDM in HR or a graduate degree with a specialisation in HR.
* 4–7 years of experience in HR operations, preferably in a manufacturing, steel, power or other industrial setup.
* Hands\-on experience in onboarding, attendance management, payroll processing and reimbursement/TA\-DA handling.



**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Working knowledge of payroll and labour compliance (PF, ESI, PT, Factories Act basics, Payment of Wages, etc.).
* Proficient in MS Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables) and any HRMS/payroll software.
* Strong attention to detail, confidentiality and deadline discipline.
* Good communication and coordination skills across levels, from plant floor to senior management.
* Ability to conduct engaging induction sessions and handle multiple tasks at once.



**Key Performance Indicators** 



* Onboarding completion and document accuracy (zero Day\-1 gaps)
* Attendance and payroll input turnaround, with error rate
* TA/DA claim turnaround time and policy adherence
* New\-joiner feedback and probation\-completion tracking
* Timeliness and accuracy of HR MIS reports

title: Business Automation Associate – AI & No-Code Automation
description:
We’re looking for individuals interested in building a career in **AI, business automation, and workflow engineering**.

As a Business Automation Associate, you’ll learn how businesses automate repetitive processes, connect different tools, build AI\-powered workflows, and improve operational efficiency — **without requiring deep programming expertise**.

This opportunity is particularly suited for candidates from **Business Analysis, Operations, QA, Project Management, CRM/ERP, Consulting, and other business\-focused backgrounds** who want to transition into automation and AI\-enabled roles.

What You’ll Work With

You’ll gain hands\-on exposure to tools such as:

* n8n
* Microsoft Copilot Studio
* Microsoft Power Automate
* AI Builder
* Retell AI
* APIs \& workflow integrations
* AI\-powered business automation

What You’ll Do

* Build and manage business automation workflows
* Automate repetitive business processes
* Connect applications and data using no\-code/low\-code tools
* Work with AI agents and AI\-powered workflows
* Identify opportunities for process automation
* Translate business requirements into automation solutions
* Test, troubleshoot and improve workflows
* Work on practical, real\-world automation use cases

Who Can Apply?

This opportunity is a good fit for:

* Business Analysts
* Project Managers / Project Coordinators
* QA / Operations professionals
* ERP / CRM Consultants
* Management / Business Consultants
* Entrepreneurs and business owners
* Professionals looking to transition into AI \& Automation
* Freshers with strong interest in technology and business automation

**You do not need to be an advanced programmer.** Basic familiarity with computers, business processes or technology is sufficient.

What We’re Looking For

* Good logical and problem\-solving skills
* Understanding of basic business processes
* Willingness to learn AI and automation tools
* Ability to understand workflows and identify inefficiencies
* Good communication skills
* Curiosity about AI, automation and emerging technologies

Career Growth

The skills developed through this pathway can lead toward roles such as:

**Automation Associate → Automation Engineer → Senior Consultant → Solutions Architect → Business Automation / AI Consultant**

Important Note

This is an **upskilling and career\-transition opportunity** designed to help candidates build practical, job\-relevant skills in AI and business automation.

Candidates will undergo a structured learning and practical project pathway before progressing toward relevant career opportunities.

**There is no guaranteed job placement or guaranteed salary.**

Why This Opportunity?

Traditional coding isn't the only way to build a career in technology.

Businesses increasingly need professionals who can understand **business problems \+ AI \+ automation** and turn them into working solutions.

If you’re looking to move beyond traditional business/operations roles and build skills in **AI\-powered automation**, this could be a strong next step.

**Apply now to learn more about the role and the career pathway.**

Pay: ₹14,999\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

title: Zoho Books Intern
description:
We are looking for a motivated Zoho Books Implementation Analyst with 0–1 year of experience to join our Zoho practice. This is an excellent opportunity for a fresher or early\-career professional with an accounting or finance background to build a career in cloud accounting and ERP implementation. You will work closely with senior Zoho consultants to support client onboarding, Zoho Books configuration, data migration, and basic user support — gaining hands\-on, guided exposure to real client implementations from day one. **Key Responsibilities Business Understanding \& Support** 

●Assist senior consultants in understanding client business processes and accounting requirements.

●Participate in requirement\-gathering discussions and accurately document notes and action items.

●Support the team in analyzing basic business workflows relevant to Zoho Books implementation.

**Zoho Books Configuration \& Setup** 

●Assist with configuring Zoho Books — Chart of Accounts, Taxes, Items, Customers, Vendors, and Bank Accounts — under guidance.

●Support setup of invoicing, billing, and payment workflows.

●Help configure basic reports and dashboards as directed by senior consultants.

**Data Migration \& Validation**

●Assist in migrating opening balances, master data, and historical transactions into Zoho Books.

●Perform data validation and reconciliation checks to ensure accuracy.

●Support data cleanup and formatting activities ahead of migration.

**Implementation Support**

●Support senior consultants during implementation, functional testing, and go\-live activities.

●Help test configured workflows against expected business outcomes.

●Document configuration steps and processes for internal reference.

**Customer Support \& Query Handling** 

●Respond to routine customer queries related to Zoho Books usage under supervision. ●Escalate complex or unresolved issues to senior consultants promptly.

●Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and issue status.

**Training \& Documentation**

●Assist in preparing user guides, training materials, and FAQs.

●Support delivery of basic training sessions for end users.

●Document standard operating procedures for common Zoho Books tasks.

**Learning \& Certification**

●Actively pursue Zoho Books and Zoho Finance Suite certifications.

●Stay updated on new Zoho Books features, updates, and best practices.

●Participate in internal training and knowledge\-sharing sessions.

**Team Coordination** 

●Coordinate with senior consultants, developers, and project managers on assigned tasks. ●Provide timely status updates on assigned activities.

●Support multiple client engagements as directed by the team lead.

**Required Qualifications**

●Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

●0–1 year of experience in accounting, bookkeeping, or ERP/software implementation — freshers are welcome to apply.

●Basic understanding of accounting principles (debits/credits, invoices, journals, reconciliation).

●Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.

●Strong written and verbal communication skills.

●Genuine willingness to learn Zoho Books and other Zoho applications.

●Working proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets.

●Detail\-oriented with strong organizational skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

●Exposure to Zoho Books, QuickBooks, Tally, or any other accounting/ERP software. ●Basic knowledge of GST and Indian taxation fundamentals.

●Internship experience in accounting, finance, or ERP implementation.

●Basic understanding of business processes across Sales, Purchase, and Inventory.

●Zoho Books certification, if already completed, is a plus.

**Key Competencies**

Accounting Fundamentals **Zoho Books,** Attention to Detail **Data Accuracy**  Customer Support **Documentation**  Communication Skills **Problem Solving**  Eagerness to Learn **Team Collaboration**  Time Management **MS Excel** What We Expect From You **We're looking for someone early in their career who is curious, detail\-oriented, and eager to learn — someone who can follow structured processes accurately today while building toward independently owning client implementations tomorrow. Above all, we value accuracy, accountability, a proactive attitude, and a genuine interest in building a long\-term career in Zoho/ERP consulting.** 

What We Offer **●Structured onboarding and hands\-on mentorship from senior Zoho and Odoo consultants. ●Support toward Zoho Books and Zoho Finance Suite certifications. ●Real client implementation experience from day one, in a guided environment. ●Collaborative, entrepreneurial work culture with direct leadership visibility. ●A clear growth path toward a full\-fledged Zoho Functional Consultant role.** 

How to Apply **Send your resume and a brief note on your relevant experience to careers@trivectadigital.com.** 

**Please use the subject line: Application – Zoho Books Implementation Analyst. Website: trivectadigital.com**

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:
Stantec is a global leader in sustainable engineering, architecture, and environmental consulting. The diverse perspectives of our partners and interested parties drive us to think beyond what’s previously been done on critical issues like climate change, digital transformation, and future\-proofing our cities and infrastructure. We innovate at the intersection of community, creativity, and client relationships to advance communities everywhere, so that together we can redefine what’s possible. The Stantec community unites approximately 32,000 employees working in over 450 locations across 6 continents.
   

  

 At Stantec, we're driven by a shared purpose to bring people, technology, and data together to create impact across our clients and communities. Our Digital Centre of Excellence (CoE) supports this mission by improving internal efficiency, enabling scalable innovation, and strengthening collaboration through modern digital and cloud technologies.
   

  

 We are seeking an Operations Data Analyst to work in the Digital Solutions Architecture and Operations team to support the effective operation, optimization, and financial management of cloud\-based services. Working closely with our Asset and Products team and the wider operations, technical, and business stakeholders, this role will turn operational data into clear evidence that helps teams understand cost, performance, reliability, and the root causes of service issues. The ideal candidate combines analytical discipline with an appreciation of cloud operations and a practical familiarity with Microsoft Azure technologies.
   

  

 Your Opportunity
   

  

 The Operations Data Analyst will play a key role in helping Stantec proactively make informed, evidence\-based decisions in the operation of our Azure Landing Zone environments. The role will gather, validate, analyse, and present operational and financial data from Azure and related platforms, supporting our FinOps activities, service improvement, incident analysis, and cost accountability.
   

  

 Working within a Microsoft\-based environment, you will use query, data transformation, and visualisation tools to investigate patterns, test hypotheses, identify contributing factors, and communicate findings in a way that is meaningful to both technical and non\-technical audiences. While helping establish repeatable analysis methods, trusted reporting, and actionable insights that improve operational outcomes, this is not just management reporting. This role is about making a positive difference in how we run our cloud operations, especially when troubleshooting operational issues with the technical teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities \- Operational Data Analysis \& FinOps
   

  

**In This Role, You Will Have The Following Responsibilities**
* Collect, check, and organize operational, usage, performance, and cost data from Microsoft Azure and related platforms.
* Support FinOps and operational reporting across DCoE and with Digital Practices by identifying cost drivers, usage trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Use KQL, Power Query, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and other Microsoft tools to analyze data and create clear reports, with support and training where needed.
* Assist technical teams with investigations into incidents, service issues, unexpected costs, and recurring operational problems.
* Present findings in a simple, evidence\-based way, clearly highlighting known facts, assumptions, data quality issues, and recommended next steps.
* Work with cloud, finance, service management, and engineering colleagues to improve data quality, tagging, reporting consistency, and operational insight.


 Your Capabilities and Credentials
   

  

* Apply structured analytical thinking and practical problem\-solving to operational questions, with guidance where needed.
* Demonstrate an appreciation of cloud operations, including reliability, monitoring, resource utilization, support processes, and cost management.
* Use or develop skills in KQL, Power Query, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and related tools to analyze data and present clear findings.
* Communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including assumptions, evidence limits, and recommended next steps.
* Collaborate constructively across operations, finance, engineering, architecture, and service management teams while continuing to build Azure and operational knowledge.


**Education, Qualifications \& Experience**
* Relevant experience or interests in data analysis, operational analysis, cloud operations, service management, business intelligence, FinOps, or related discipline.
* Practical familiarity with Microsoft Azure concepts, cost and usage data, monitoring, logging, and reporting tools; deeper platform knowledge can be developed in the role.
* Experience using analytical tools such as Excel, Power Query, Power BI, or Microsoft Fabric with awareness of SQL, KQL, to investigate data, identify trends, and present clear findings.


 Desirable
   

  

* Familiarity with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Cost Management, Resource Graph, Workbooks, or related Azure operational tools.
* Awareness of cloud cost models, tagging, budgets, licensing, cost allocation, and basic FinOps principles.
* Exposure to service management processes, data governance, security, privacy, or role\-based access considerations in cloud environments.
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, governed dashboards, enterprise reporting, distributed organizations, or the architecture, engineering, and construction industry would be beneficial.

title: Electronics Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Junior Electronics Engineer, **Fresher OR with 1\-2 years of professional experience** in electronics design and PCB development to join our engineering team in Kolkata. This is a full\-time, on\-site role, ideal for candidates looking to expand their skills in circuit design, PCB layout, component selection, and embedded hardware bring\-up.

As a Junior Electronics Engineer, you will work on a range of technologies including analog and digital circuits, microcontroller\-based systems, IoT applications, and medical device electronics, while designing reliable and optimized hardware solutions for real\-world applications. You will collaborate with senior engineers, firmware teams, and cross\-functional groups to deliver production\-ready electronic systems.

Recent graduates with demonstrated hands\-on exposure to circuit design and KiCad PCB tools through academic projects, internships, or personal projects are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

Circuit Design \& Development

* Design complete or partial electronic circuits based on technical specifications, system requirements, and application constraints
* Perform detailed circuit analysis and simulations using industry\-standard tools (SPICE, LTspice, or equivalent)
* Create comprehensive schematic diagrams with proper component annotation, reference designators, and detailed documentation
* Conduct design calculations for analog circuits, signal conditioning, power distribution, and signal integrity
* Ensure all designs meet performance specifications, reliability standards, and safety requirements
* Implement best practices for noise reduction, EMI/EMC compliance, and thermal management
* Participate actively in design reviews with senior engineers and stakeholders, incorporating feedback and design improvements
* Evaluate alternative circuit topologies and component solutions to optimize performance, cost, and manufacturability

Component Selection \& Sourcing

* Evaluate and analyze comprehensive component datasheets and technical specifications
* Select appropriate semiconductors (microcontrollers, op\-amps, voltage regulators, analog\-to\-digital converters, etc.), passive components (resistors, capacitors, inductors, transformers), and functional modules based on circuit requirements
* Consider critical factors including performance parameters, power consumption, operating temperature ranges, availability, lead times, cost\-effectiveness, and supply chain reliability
* Maintain and continuously update component libraries and design documentation for future project reuse
* Coordinate with procurement teams to ensure component availability, manage obsolescence risks, and optimize cost without compromising quality
* Document component selections with justifications and alternative options for design flexibility

PCB Layout \& Routing

* Utilize **KiCad or EasyEDA** (schematic capture and PCB design tools) to translate detailed schematics into production\-ready PCB layouts
* Design single, double, and multi\-layer PCBs with proper layer stackup optimization for signal integrity and manufacturability
* Perform comprehensive PCB Design Rule Checks (DRC) and ensure full compliance with manufacturing specifications and design guidelines
* Execute critical signal integrity analysis including impedance matching, crosstalk assessment, and timing analysis for high\-speed signals
* Design optimal power distribution networks (PDN) and ground planes to minimize voltage drops and noise
* Route complex signal paths while adhering to design constraints including trace width, spacing, and via placement rules
* Implement thermal management strategies through copper pours, thermal vias, and optimized component placement
* Optimize PCB layouts for cost efficiency, manufacturability, and assembly considerations
* Generate complete manufacturing documentation including layer stackups, silkscreen markings, assembly drawings, design specifications, and manufacturing notes
* Conduct design for manufacturability (DFM) reviews with manufacturing partners
* Work with fabrication houses to ensure designs meet production capabilities and tolerances

Firmware Development for Testing \& Board Bring\-Up

* Develop and maintain embedded firmware for microcontroller\-based designs primarily in C/C\+\+
* Create validation and testing firmware that comprehensively exercises hardware functionality
* Implement drivers and application logic for microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, ARM Cortex\-M, RISC\-V, Arduino, or equivalent platforms)
* Support standard communication protocols including I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, USB, and GPIO
* Perform comprehensive board bring\-up activities including power\-on sequencing, clock verification, and peripheral initialization
* Execute functional testing and validation of all hardware subsystems and components
* Debug hardware issues and design flaws using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and software debugging tools
* Maintain detailed test procedures, logs, and documentation for quality assurance and future reference
* Collaborate with firmware engineers to ensure hardware\-software integration and performance optimization

Documentation \& Knowledge Management

* Maintain comprehensive and well\-organized design documentation including schematics, PCB layouts, bill of materials (BOM), design specifications, and change logs
* Prepare detailed technical reports, design summaries, and project documentation for internal reviews and client deliverables
* Create and maintain design standards and best practice guidelines for team consistency and knowledge sharing
* Document design decisions, trade\-offs, and lessons learned for organizational knowledge base
* Prepare presentations and technical summaries for design reviews and stakeholder communications

Collaboration \& Cross\-Functional Teamwork

* Work closely with senior hardware engineers and technical leads to understand requirements, constraints, and design objectives
* Partner with firmware engineers for seamless hardware\-software integration and optimal system performance
* Collaborate with mechanical engineers on component placement, thermal considerations, and mechanical constraints
* Coordinate with quality assurance and testing teams to address design issues and implement improvements
* Communicate technical findings, design decisions, and challenges clearly with internal teams and external clients
* Participate in design reviews, technical discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives

Required QualificationsExperience \& Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent professional experience)
* 1\+ year of demonstrated experience in electronics design, circuit development, or PCB layout in professional or academic settings
* OR recent graduate with proven hands\-on exposure to circuit design and PCB development through academic projects, internships, or personal projects
* Portfolio, GitHub repository, or work samples demonstrating circuit design and PCB layout capabilities (highly valued)

Technical Skills \- Essential

* Proficiency in KiCad including schematic capture, PCB layout, and design rule checking
* Strong foundational knowledge of analog and digital circuit design principles
* Comprehensive understanding of passive components (resistors, capacitors, inductors, diodes, relays) and active components (op\-amps, transistors, voltage regulators, comparators)
* Knowledge of microcontroller basics and embedded systems architecture (ARM, AVR, RISC\-V)
* Proficiency in C/C\+\+ programming for embedded systems and microcontroller development
* Solid grasp of PCB design fundamentals including layer stackup, trace routing, via placement, and manufacturing constraints
* Understanding of signal integrity concepts including impedance, crosstalk, and propagation delay
* Familiarity with power distribution and basic power supply design concepts

Technical Skills \- Practical Experience

* Hands\-on experience with component selection from datasheets and specification evaluation
* Practical knowledge of communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, USB, or GPIO
* Familiarity with basic circuit simulation concepts (SPICE, LTspice, or similar tools)
* Experience with debugging and testing tools including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and multimeters
* Proficiency with schematic capture and PCB design software (KiCad preferred; experience with Altium, Eagle, or equivalent is acceptable)

Soft Skills \& Attributes

* Exceptional attention to detail with commitment to design quality and accuracy
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with systematic troubleshooting approach
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and team collaboration
* Collaborative team player with strong interpersonal skills
* Self\-motivated and proactive with genuine enthusiasm for continuous learning and professional development
* Willing to ask questions and seek guidance from senior engineers

Preferred Qualifications (Good to have, but not necessary)Advanced Technical Skills

* Familiarity with circuit simulation tools including LTspice, Proteus, or PSPICE
* Experience with power electronics design including switching regulators, DC\-DC converters, or power management ICs
* Knowledge of high\-speed PCB design including impedance matching and differential pair routing
* Exposure to signal processing concepts and analog filter design
* Familiarity with RTOS concepts (FreeRTOS, Zephyr) for embedded firmware development

Industry\-Specific Experience

* Experience with medical device design including understanding of regulatory requirements and design controls
* Knowledge of India MDR, CDSCO regulations, and compliance requirements for medical devices
* Exposure to IEC, FCC, CE, and other electrical safety standards
* Experience with healthcare applications or medical\-grade electronics
* Background in IoT device design or wireless embedded systems
* Familiarity with wearable electronics or sensor\-based system design

Professional Development \& Tools

* Experience with version control systems (Git, GitHub, GitLab) for design collaboration
* Proficiency in Python or Shell scripting for test automation and firmware development
* Familiarity with hardware description languages (Verilog, VHDL) for FPGA design (a plus)
* Knowledge of PCB assembly processes including surface mount technology (SMT) and component placement optimization
* Experience with thermal analysis and simulation tools
* Hands\-on experience with hardware testing methodologies and quality assurance processes
* Familiarity with design documentation standards and ISO specifications

Industry Credentials

* Professional certifications in electronics engineering or embedded systems (valuable but not required)
* Completed online courses in PCB design, embedded systems, or circuit design from recognized institutions

What We OfferCareer Development \& Learning

* Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge embedded systems, IoT products, and medical device electronics
* Direct mentorship and guidance from experienced senior hardware engineers and technical leads
* Comprehensive exposure to the complete product development lifecycle from concept to manufacturing
* Access to advanced design tools and laboratory equipment including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and test equipment
* Regular technical training and skill development opportunities
* Involvement in challenging projects with real\-world applications that impact users

Work Environment \& Culture

* Collaborative and supportive team environment with emphasis on knowledge sharing
* Opportunity to contribute ideas and participate in design innovation initiatives
* Clear communication with transparent project goals and expectations
* Recognition and appreciation for technical contributions and achievements
* Inclusive and respectful workplace culture
* Flexibility for continuous learning and professional growth

Compensation \& Benefits

* Competitive salary and benefits package commensurate with experience
* Performance\-based incentives and bonuses
* Career growth opportunities with clear progression toward senior engineering and leadership roles
* Potential for specialized role development (medical devices, IoT, power electronics, etc.)

Location and Work Mode

* Employment Type: Full\-time
* Work Mode: Work from office / On\-site
* Primary Location: Sodepur, Kolkata, India
* Work Hours: Standard business hours with flexibility for critical project milestones

Application Requirements

Interested candidates should submit the following materials:

1\. **Resume/CV** \- Highlighting relevant experience, projects, internships, and technical achievements

2\. **Cover Letter** \- Explaining your interest in the role, career objectives, and why you are suited for this position

3\. **Portfolio or Project Samples** \- Links to design files, GitHub repositories, or documentation of past projects (Fritzing designs, KiCad projects, technical reports)

4\. **References** \- Names and contact information of previous supervisors, mentors, or colleagues who can speak to your technical abilities

5\. **Certifications** (if applicable) \- Any relevant technical certifications or training completion documents

About Our Company

We are a specialized electronics design company based in Kolkata focused on contract electronics design, PCB development, and embedded product manufacturing. Our expertise spans medical devices, IoT applications, consumer electronics, and industrial embedded systems. We work with diverse clients to transform concepts into production\-ready hardware solutions.

We maintain a culture of technical excellence, continuous innovation, and collaborative problem\-solving. Our team is committed to delivering high\-quality, reliable products that meet stringent industry standards and client expectations.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable team and welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of background, experience level, or personal characteristics. We encourage applications from underrepresented groups in engineering and provide a supportive environment for professional growth and development.

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Sodepur, Kolkata, West Bengal: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Location:

* Sodepur, Kolkata, West Bengal (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

 alliantgroup is a professional services firm that provides tax consulting and compliance services to businesses in the United States. These credits and incentives are designed to encourage businesses to invest in certain types of activities, such as research and development, energy efficiency, and hiring employees from certain disadvantaged groups. alliantgroup services include helping businesses identify and claim these credits and incentives, as well as providing guidance on compliance with the relevant regulations.
 



 alliantgroup is headquartered in Houston, Texas with additional offices located in Austin, Boston, Chicago, Indianapolis, New York, Irvine, Sacramento, Washington, D.C.; and Bristol and London in the U.K.
 



 More about our culture and why we love alliantgroup

 alliantgroup started its operations in India in the year 2020 with a world\-class office in Hyderabad to provide Tax, Advisory, Audit and Accounting services. alliantgroup India Talent comprises a team of skilled professionals who address the most pressing needs of U.S CPA Firms.  Our people and culture set us apart as a firm, and our team includes professionals from a diverse array of fields, including business, engineering, software development, law, and accounting.
 



  





**Alliant Cybersecurity** 




 Alliant Cybersecurity created a full\-service cybersecurity consultancy for American businesses. We are technology and vendor agnostic and have a customizable security plan that can be made to fit any business’s needs. Our team has seasoned penetration testers, auditors, technologists, and security analysts to help with client’s needs whether it’s a one\-time project or permanent outsourced cybersecurity to our Managed Security Operations Center. We are here as an extension of client’s team, offering straightforward solutions to everyday cybersecurity challenges especially in the moments that matter most.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 Alliant Cybersecurity is seeking an experienced Level 1 analyst based in Hyderabad to help expand its Cybersecurity and Risk Advisory practice. This position primarily supports US\-based customers and requires flexibility to work during US business hours.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 




**Security Operations \& Investigation:** 



* Knowledge of security monitoring technologies and cored security principles
* Direct experience with any SIEM or log aggregation system
* Ability to review captured network traffic, and compare against the contents of a security alert to verify the nature of the detection
* Experience and familiarity with IT management products and services
* Experience analyzing Firewall, IDS, IPS, Web Proxy, Anti\-Virus and SMTP data for security\-related concerns and events
* Skilled at using multiple operating systems
* Scripting skills in any common language (Python, Perl, Bash or Powershell) is a plus
* Ability to suggest technical solutions to complicated problems



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Operational security monitoring to include: review security alerts, conduct triage analysis of related security events, make true/false positive decisions, make escalation decisions (to senior analysts or to the Incident Response process), and make initial severity determinations
* Manage and administer a SIEM, develop reports and other capabilities to support the needs of our clients
* Identify data sources and analytics for inclusion into SIEM
* Conduct trending analysis of security alerts and events to identify patterns indicative of new unauthorized activity
* Develop new signatures and correlated searches based on a variety of requirements
* Identify log and event sources including Active Directory event logs, Routers, Switches, Firewalls, PCAP/Flow data, DNS, audit and authentication logs, VPN, IDS, and other sensor field tools and technologies
* Make recommendations on new threat feeds and tools to help evolve automated threat detection capabilities as well as aid in computer forensic and historical investigations
* Provide Cybersecurity and Threat Analyst services to support active information security incidents and events from the Logging and Event Management solution
* Coordination with ISMS core team to support ISMS activities and implantation strategies at the company.



  





**Education:** 




 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or other related disciplines.
 



  





**Certifications:** 




 Professional Security certifications are a plus
 



  





**What are we looking for:** 



* Minimum 2 years of SOC experience
* knowledge in:
* Computer Forensics
* Reverse Engineering
* IDS/SIEM/Log Management
* Threat Intelligence
* Malware Analysis
* EDR \& Incident Response
* Vulnerability Management



  





**Essential Skills:** 



* Rigorous process adherence and attention to detail
* Strong time management and multitasking abilities

description:
NVIDIA is seeking a highly motivated, creative system software engineer with strong embedded, kernel/driver, and security experience to join the GPU Software team in Pune, Maharashtra. As someone who is hardworking and passionate about their work, you will design and build key security features and verification strategies for NVIDIA GPUs. You should demonstrate the ability to excel in an environment with complex, multifaceted software and hardware designs.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Define, design, develop and verify security and platform features for next\-gen RISCV and other in\-house controllers on NVIDIA GPUs, collaborating closely with hardware, firmware and system software teams.
* Perform security analysis and hardening of various firmware \& middleware (threat modeling, code reviews, static/dynamic analysis, fuzzing, negative testing).
* Follow the devices from inception through silicon bring‑up and production into desktops, notebooks, workstations, data centers, and gaming console products that are used throughout the world.
* Use pre‑silicon modeling, simulation and emulation to validate system and security properties early, de‑risk bring‑up, and shift‑left defect discovery.
* Multiple opportunities to collaborate and communicate effectively with distributed teams across time zones.
* Use AI‑assisted tools to improve development, review, and testing efficiency while staying aligned with NVIDIA security and coding best practices.


**What We Need To See**
* B.Tech./B.E. degree or higher (Computer science or related) or equivalent experience.
* 3\+ yrs of relevant software development experience, especially with embedded systems and/or kernel/driver stack.
* Strong interest and background in software and hardware security, with hands‑on experience building or maintaining security‑relevant features.
* Excellent C programming skills and experience with low‑level, resource‑constrained or real‑time environments (bare‑metal or RTOS) and device driver or BSP development.
* Solid understanding of computer architecture and SoC fundamentals (caches, buses, MMUs, memory controllers, DMA, interrupt controllers, security islands, fuses).
* Experience with complex system‑level debugging (cross‑component issues involving firmware, drivers, and hardware).
* Comfortable using AI tools for development, code reviews, and testing in a secure and responsible way.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to drive designs and reviews across teams.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience with RISC‑V architecture, low‑level BSP / firmware bring‑up, toolchains, and/or on‑chip security controllers.
* Strong understanding of hardware security, applied cryptography, and secure coding practices, especially for embedded controllers and firmware.
* Hands\-on work with secure boot, code integrity and confidentiality, TEEs, keys provisioning/rotation.
* Experience with simulation/emulation and silicon bring‑up for security or control processors (FPGA prototyping, virtual platforms, QEMU/PQEMU, emulators).
* Familiarity with security verification techniques: fuzzing, fault‑injection, coverage‑driven security testing, negative testing, or formal methods for security properties.

Position\- Apprentice – Quality Control (QC)


Department \- Quality Control


Location\- Ambernath, Maharashtra


Qualification

* M.Sc/BSc in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry.
* Freshers are encouraged to apply.


Experience


0–1 year (Freshers eligible)


About PolyPeptide Group:


PolyPeptide Group AG and its consolidated subsidiaries (“PolyPeptide”) is a specialized Contract Development \& Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) for peptide\- and oligonucleotide\-based active pharmaceutical ingredients. By supporting its customers mainly in pharma and biotech, it contributes to the health of millions of patients across the world. PolyPeptide serves a fast\-growing market, offering products and services from pre\-clinical to commercial stages. Its broad portfolio reflects the opportunities in drug therapies across areas and with a large exposure to metabolic diseases, including GLP\-1\. Dating back to 1952, PolyPeptide today runs a global network of six GMP\-certified facilities in Europe, the U.S. and India. PolyPeptide’s shares (SIX: PPGN) are listed on SIX Swiss Exchange.


OUR VALUES


Trust: We build and maintain trust in all our relationships – both with each other and with our


customers. We support each other and work as a team.


Innovation: We are curious and driven by finding smart solutions to the challenges we face.


Excellence: We always strive to deliver high quality and adapt to meet the needs of our


customers.


Job Purpose


To support the Quality Control team in performing routine laboratory activities, sample analysis,


documentation, and compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Laboratory


Practices (GLP), and company quality standards.


Key Responsibilities

* Assist in sampling, testing, and analysis of raw materials, in\-process samples, finished


products, and stability samples.

* Support routine analysis using laboratory instruments such as HPLC, GC, UV\-Visible


Spectrophotometer, pH Meter, and other analytical equipment under supervision.

* Prepare laboratory reagents, solutions, and standard preparations as per approved


procedures.

* Perform routine laboratory housekeeping and ensure cleanliness of the work area.
* Assist in maintaining laboratory records, logbooks, analytical worksheets, and


documentation in compliance with GMP and GLP requirements.

* Support calibration, verification, and maintenance of laboratory instruments and


equipment.

* Follow laboratory safety procedures and ensure compliance with EHS guidelines.
* Participate in investigations, OOS/OOT documentation, and laboratory activities under


the guidance of senior team members.

* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams whenever required.
* Perform any other responsibilities assigned by the reporting manager.


Skills \& Competencies

* Basic knowledge of analytical chemistry and laboratory techniques.
* Understanding of GMP, GLP, and laboratory safety practices.
* Good documentation and record\-keeping skills.
* Basic knowledge of analytical instruments is desirable.
* Attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Willingness to learn and adapt in a regulated manufacturing environment.


What We Offer

* Monthly Stipend: ₹18,000
* Canteen Facility
* Company Bus Facility from Ambernath Railway Station
* Hands\-on training in Quality Control operations within a regulated pharmaceutical


manufacturing environment.

* Opportunity to gain practical exposure to analytical instruments, GMP/GLP practices,


and quality systems.
