title: Creative Designer & AI Video Specialist for Hospitality Group | Full-time |
description:
\*\*Experience:\*\* Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience

We are looking for a \*\*Creative Designer \& AI Video Specialist\*\* who can take an idea, brief, or brand requirement and independently turn it into polished, premium, publish\-ready content.

This is not a trainee or entry\-level production role. We are looking for someone with \*\*at least 3 years of professional/corporate experience\*\* who has developed strong creative judgment, understands premium visual communication, and can work with ownership rather than requiring step\-by\-step supervision.

You will work across multiple restaurant, hospitality, and lifestyle brands, creating content that is visually refined, contemporary, intentional, and appropriate for a \*\*premium, Tier 1 audience\*\*.

\#\# What You'll Do

\* Edit high\-quality short\-form video content for \*\*Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other digital platforms\*\*.

\* Transform raw footage into polished content through strong editing, pacing, transitions, typography, captions, sound design, color grading, and visual storytelling.

\* Create high\-quality \*\*AI\-generated videos\*\* using Google Flow/Veo and other AI video\-generation platforms.

\* Create and develop \*\*AI\-generated imagery\*\* for campaigns, social media, creative concepts, and brand storytelling.

\* Design premium graphic assets including promotional creatives, event campaigns, story templates, menu visuals, digital advertisements, branded posts, and other marketing collateral.

\* Translate creative briefs into finished work while maintaining the \*\*visual identity, tone, and positioning of each brand\*\*.

\* Develop creative concepts independently rather than relying solely on pre\-existing templates or references.

\* Explore new AI tools, workflows, techniques, and creative technologies to improve the quality and efficiency of content production.

\* Work closely with the Social Media Manager and wider creative team to execute campaigns and content calendars.

\* Take feedback constructively and turn around revisions quickly and accurately.

\* Manage multiple brands, projects, and deadlines simultaneously while maintaining consistency and quality.

\* Take ownership of assigned projects from brief to final delivery and remain accountable for the quality and timeliness of your work.

\* Be proactive in finding solutions when a brief presents a technical or creative challenge rather than waiting for step\-by\-step instructions.

\#\# The Creative Standard We Expect

Our brands operate in the \*\*premium restaurant, hospitality, and lifestyle space\*\*, and our content needs to reflect that positioning.

We are looking for someone with a strong understanding of:

\* Premium and contemporary visual aesthetics

\* Clean, sophisticated composition

\* Strong typography and visual hierarchy

\* Modern brand storytelling

\* High\-end food, hospitality, and lifestyle content

\* Editorial\-style visual direction

\* Tasteful use of color, motion, transitions, and effects

\* Creating content that feels intentional rather than template\-driven

\*\*A strong sense of visual taste is essential.\*\*

We are specifically looking for someone who understands the difference between simply making content look "busy" and creating content that looks \*\*premium, considered, aspirational, and commercially effective\*\*.

\#\# You Should Be Someone Who

\* Has \*\*3\+ years of professional experience\*\* in graphic design, video editing, or a closely related creative role.

\* Has worked in a professional/corporate environment and understands deadlines, accountability, collaboration, and quality standards.

\* Can receive a brief and \*\*figure out the execution independently\*\*.

\* Has strong creative instincts and is comfortable bringing their own ideas to the table.

\* Is resourceful — if you don't know how to execute something, you know how to research, experiment, learn, and find a way to make it work.

\* Doesn't require constant micromanagement or spoon\-feeding.

\* Takes ownership of their work and is comfortable being accountable for the final output.

\* Can work independently while also collaborating effectively with a team.

\* Is curious about new creative technologies and actively explores AI\-driven workflows.

\* Can adapt their creative approach across different brands rather than applying the same visual treatment everywhere.

\* Understands that premium design is often about \*\*restraint, detail, composition, and intention — not simply adding more elements\*\*.

\#\# Mandatory Skills \& Tools

Hands\-on professional proficiency in \*\*all\*\* of the following is required:

\* \*\*Adobe Photoshop\*\*

\* \*\*Adobe Premiere Pro\*\*

\* \*\*Adobe After Effects\*\* / broader Adobe Creative Cloud ecosystem

\* \*\*Canva\*\*

\* \*\*CapCut\*\*

\* \*\*Google Flow / Veo\*\*

\* AI video\-generation tools

\* AI image\-generation tools

\* Other relevant AI creative tools and workflows

Candidates should be able to demonstrate actual work created using these tools. \*\*Basic familiarity or having used a tool occasionally is not sufficient.\*\*

\#\# Required Experience

\* Minimum \*\*3 years of professional/corporate experience\*\* in graphic design, video editing, creative production, or a similar role.

\* Demonstrated experience creating \*\*premium\-quality digital content\*\*.

\* Strong portfolio showcasing both \*\*design and video work\*\*.

\* Demonstrated ability to create content for brands with a sophisticated visual identity.

\* Practical experience using AI for image and video generation.

\* Experience managing multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

\* Strong understanding of social media content formats and platform requirements.

\#\# Good to Have

\* Previous experience in \*\*hospitality, restaurants, hotels, luxury, lifestyle, fashion, beauty, or premium consumer brands\*\*.

\* Experience working across multiple brands simultaneously.

\* Experience developing creative concepts and visual campaigns, not just executing pre\-defined designs.

\* Familiarity with emerging AI creative tools and workflows.

\* Understanding of food photography, hospitality storytelling, and lifestyle content.

\* Experience working with performance marketing or social media teams.

\#\# What This Role Is Not

This role is \*\*not suitable for freshers, interns, trainees, or candidates looking for a role where they will be taught the fundamentals of design and video production from scratch.\*\*

We need someone who can \*\*come in, understand the brief, think creatively, find solutions, execute independently, and deliver work at a professional standard.\*\*

You should not need to be told every step of \*how\* to create something. We will provide the \*\*direction, brand context, and desired outcome\*\* — we expect you to bring the creative thinking and execution expertise required to get there.

\#\# Working Requirements

\* Full\-time, in\-person role

\* Monday–Friday

\* Ability to work across multiple brands and simultaneous deadlines

\* Strong commitment to deadlines and delivery schedules

\* Comfortable working with a fast\-paced creative team

\* Availability for urgent edits, last\-minute deliverables, and occasional late\-night work calls when business requirements demand it

\* Basic English communication skills, written and verbal

\#\# Portfolio Requirement

\*\*A strong portfolio is mandatory.\*\*

Applications without a relevant portfolio demonstrating professional\-level \*\*graphic design, video editing, AI\-generated content, and premium brand work\*\* may not be considered.

\*\* Share your Portfolio at marketing1@kahani.social and nikhil@legalacco.com

description:
Join us as a Scrum Master at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
   

  

 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with, skills to meet business requirement as well as job\-specific skillsets.
   

  

 To be successful as a Scrum Master, you should have experience with:
   

  

**Essential Skills**
* Strong expertise in Agile/Scrum frameworks and ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, Reviews, Retrospectives).
* Proven experience in delivery management, including release planning, dependency management, risk and issue tracking.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage Product Owners, Technology Leads, Business Teams, and Senior Management.
* Strong facilitation, conflict resolution, and leadership capabilities.
* Proficiency in Agile tools such as JIRA, Confluence.
* Experience in tracking and communicating Agile metrics (velocity, sprint predictability, burn\-down, cycle time).
* Ability to drive teams toward delivery commitments while removing impediments and managing escalations.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include**
* Experience managing multiple Agile teams and working in scaled Agile environments (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS). Domain knowledge in Banking, Risk, Finance, Treasury, Regulatory Reporting, or Data Management. Demonstrated ability to lead Agile transformation and organizational change initiatives.
* Strong executive communication skills with experience presenting delivery status, risks, and KPIs to senior stakeholders.
* Relevant certifications such as CSM, PSM, SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Agilist, PMI\-ACP, or PMP would be added benefit.


 This role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
* Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
* Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
* Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
* Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
* Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
* Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
 To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
   

  

 Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
   

  

 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
   

  

 Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
   

  

 Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
   

  

 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
   

  

 Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
   

  

 Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
   

  

 Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
   

  

 Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
   

  

 Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

**Product Consultant \- Firki** 




**Remote** 




  





**Working at Teach For India** 




 Teach For India is on a journey to reach an India free of poverty and filled with love by ending educational inequity in our country. Fifteen years into our journey we are a movement of \~5000\+ Alumni working at all levels of the education system, who are reaching 1 in 10 children across the country. These Alumni have graduated from our two\-year Fellowship Program where they taught in under\-resourced classrooms to put \~33,500 low\-income children on a different life path. Today, we have \~1000 Fellows and are the largest pipeline of driven, skilled talent into the educational ecosystem in India. Over 16,000 Teach For India students have appeared for the 10th grade board examinations till date, with an impressive 95% pass rate across cities as of November 2024\.
 



 In 2022, we embarked on

 , our fourth strategic phase. We have a bold and ambitious ten\-year journey ahead of us that aims to
 **grow 50,000 leaders** 
 , who will
 **work collectively** 
 , and
 **with love** 
 , to
 **transform the lives of 1 in 10 low\-income children in our regions** 
 , through an
 **education that unleashes the potential of self, others and India**

1. **Strengthen** 
 our core Fellowship to build strong teacher leaders who provide an excellent and equitable education to our children and continue to do so beyond the Fellowship
2. **Scale** 
 our impact by strategically introducing additional Fellowships as alternative pathways for leadership development
3. **Match** 
 the Alumni of our programs at an intersection of their interests and the needs of the system and our children

 for key issues that impact educational equity, and engage 3\.5% of the population in the movement for educational equity

 collectively with our Alumni to learn about and address key issues in our regions.

description:

**1\. Scrum Master \& Agile Delivery (\~50%)** 



* **Agile Coaching:** 
 Serve as a coach for the development team, guiding them in Agile principles, Scrum guidelines, and continuous improvement practices.

 Facilitate all Agile ceremonies, including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews/Demos, and Retrospectives.
* **Backlog \& Acceptance Criteria:** 
 Collaborate with Product Owners and stakeholders to prioritize and groom the product backlog, ensuring user stories and acceptance criteria are clear and actionable.
* **Blocker Removal \& Conflict Resolution:** 
 Identify and remove team impediments, resolve conflicts, and shield the team from external disruptions to maintain momentum.
* **Metrics \& Health Reporting:** 
 Track, analyze, and share Scrum health, project metrics (velocity, burn\-down, cycle time), and progress reports with stakeholders to maintain transparency.
* **Cross\-Team Alignment:** 
 Collaborate with other Scrum Masters and stakeholders to coordinate dependencies, align priorities, and manage risks across teams.



**2\. Web QA \& Automation Framework Engineering (\~50%)** 



* **Framework Development \& Maintenance:** 
 Architect, maintain, and expand scalable automated testing frameworks (e.g., Selenium WebDriver with Java, Playwright, or Cypress) tailored for web applications.
* **End\-to\-End \& API Testing:** 
 Design, write, and execute comprehensive manual and automated test suites for UI interfaces, cross\-browser compatibility, responsive designs, and backend REST APIs.
* **CI/CD Integration:** 
 Integrate automated web test suites into continuous delivery pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps) for automated regression execution.
* **Defect \& Quality Management:** 
 Define and enforce the "Definition of Done" (DoD), triage defects, and work closely with Java developers to diagnose and resolve root causes.
* **UI/UX Quality Advocacy:** 
 Apply an understanding of UI interface design principles to ensure web applications meet design consistency, usability, and functional requirements.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements** 



* **Experience:** 
 5 to 7 years of experience in software delivery/testing, with at least
 **2–3 years in a dual or active Scrum Master role** 
 .
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* **Certifications:** 
 Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM I/II), or equivalent Agile certification required.
* **Java \& UI Knowledge:** 
 Solid understanding of Java development technologies and UI interface design principles to effectively collaborate with full\-stack engineers and designers.
* **Web Automation Tech:** 
 Hands\-on experience developing web test automation frameworks using
 **Java (Selenium/REST Assured)** 
 or modern JavaScript/TypeScript tools (
 **Playwright/Cypress** 
 ).
* **Agile Tools:** 
 Advanced proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Agile reporting dashboards/metrics.
* **Soft Skills:** 
 Excellent communication, facilitation, problem\-solving, and conflict\-resolution skills with a proven ability to motivate cross\-functional teams.

title: Product Intern
description:
About Bytebeam
 
 Bytebeam builds the hardware and software that power the next generation of smart connected vehicles. We do device telemetry, remote diagnostics, OTA updates, alerts, and fleet\-scale device management. We help teams ship connected products faster and run them reliably in the field. We are now building an AI\-native platform for Indian commercial fleets. We are building it to be several times better than anything in the market, not a little better.
 


 Role Overview
 
 You are an early\-career product builder, and this track grows into an APM. You do two things: find the real problem (in the field, with data) and make people keep coming back (activation, retention, and renewals). You keep the experience low\-friction, push it toward feeling personal to each user, and bring a UX/UI eye to shape the answer. We hire you for hunger and attitude, not a resume or pedigree, and we shape your focus to your strengths across discovery and engagement.
 


 What you'll do
 * Run discovery: go to fleet owners, operators, and drivers in the field, and find the real problem, not the surface one.
* Prove it with data: decide what to track, dig into cohorts and funnels, and set the success metric and the counter\-metric. Tell a real signal from noise.
* Drive engagement, retention, and renewals: own the post\-signup funnel, cut friction (the biggest lever on retention), and make renewing effortless.
* Make it personal: push the product toward a personalized, then hyper\-personalized, experience that adapts to each user. You learn what personal means by spending time with users on the ground, not by guessing from a dashboard.
* Shape and define: turn problems into clear user flows, simple wireframes, and full feature logic (states, edge cases), so engineering builds without guesswork.
* Work AI\-first: use AI for research, synthesis, prototyping, and analysis, so you punch above your experience.


 What we're looking for
 * Early\-career, 0\-2 years, or a strong record of projects.
* A strong discovery instinct: you find the real problem and tell a need from a want.
* You care about retention: you can explain why people keep coming back to a product you admire, and you believe a product should adapt to each user (personalization and hyper\-personalization).
* Comfort with numbers: cohorts, funnels, retention curves (D1 / D7 / D30\), and renewal rates, read honestly.
* A UX/UI eye: you can turn a problem into a clear flow and a simple screen.
* AI\-first, hungry, high ownership, and happy to travel and spend real time with users on the ground. Bonus: you have built or analysed retention, renewals, personalization, notifications, or gamification.


 Why Bytebeam
 * Real products, used in production by teams running connected vehicles and fleets.
* Real problems and real ownership from day one, coached weekly. Deliver, and we grow you into an APM.
* Work that spans software, hardware, field operations, fleet economics, and reliability.



 Location: India · significant field travel required

title: Area Manager - Operations
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Area Manager – Multi\-Site Operations**

*Jaiswal Group*

Role Overview

**Job Title**

Area Manager – Multi\-Site Operations

**Department**

Operations

**Reports To**

General Manager – Operations

**Scope**

Multi\-site Food Service / Canteen Operations

**Industry**

Institutional Food Service / Contract Catering

Job Summary

The Area Manager at Jaiswal Group is a key operational leadership role responsible for overseeing multiple canteen and food service units within an assigned region. This role demands a hands\-on operator who can drive consistent service quality, food safety compliance, and financial performance across all sites.

You will be the primary point of accountability between frontline site teams and senior management ensuring that daily operations run smoothly, clients are satisfied, costs are controlled, and people are developed. If you thrive in a fast\-paced, multi\-site environment and take genuine ownership of results, this role is designed for you.

Key Responsibilities1\. Site Operations \& Daily Management

* Visit a minimum of two units daily to assess operational standards, address on\-ground issues, and ensure smooth service delivery.
* Monitor day\-to\-day operations across all assigned units and ensure adherence to defined service standards and SOPs.
* Ensure production planning is completed at least two days in advance and executed through the system; verify compliance daily.
* Review and approve the Canteen Service Report (CSR) and ensure all documentation at each site is completed as per the prescribed checklist.

2\. Food Safety \& Compliance

* Ensure all units are compliant with FSSAI licensing requirements licences must be prominently displayed and valid at all times.
* Oversee the collection and frozen storage of food samples for a rolling three\-day period at each site.
* Ensure periodic water quality reports are conducted and findings are documented.
* Maintain all compliance\-related documentation at the unit level and keep it up to date at all times.
* Ensure personal grooming standards are enforced by the Unit Manager on a daily basis.

3\. Cost Control \& Profitability

* Prepare and review the Daily Profitability Report (DPR) for all sites and identify variances requiring corrective action.
* Track and analyse projected versus actual raw material consumption on a daily basis to detect and address inefficiencies.
* Drive food waste reduction target food wastage at or below 3% daily and ensure raw food wastage is recorded every day.
* Ensure cooked food portion weights are recorded and average per\-person consumption is updated in the system in coordination with the costing team.
* Approve petty cash and cash purchases for assigned units (with Purchase and Costing teams kept in the loop); actively minimise cash purchases.
* Audit cash sales wherever applicable at sites.

4\. Inventory \& Procurement

* Ensure a minimum of two weeks’ raw material inventory is maintained at all times across assigned sites.
* Review and approve purchase requisitions for respective sites.
* Conduct random physical and perpetual stock audits to verify inventory accuracy.
* Check the quality of incoming materials; escalate and coordinate with the Purchase team if any material falls below standard.
* Ensure all grocery brands used at sites are as per the approved agreement specifications.

5\. Menu Planning \& Costing

* Collaborate with the client to plan menus within the agreed budget; obtain approval from the Costing team before implementation.
* Ensure approved menus are updated in the system with targeted food cost figures.
* For weekly menus, ensure finalisation by Friday of the preceding week; for monthly menus, by the 20th of the prior month.

6\. Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Conduct formal client feedback sessions at least once a week; document and act on all feedback received.
* Prepare and share feedback reports on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis with the client and internal stakeholders.
* Verify headcount of meals consumed at each site; ensure any cash collections are updated in the system accurately.
* Ensure timely invoicing for all sites; verify invoices before submission and follow up on recoveries to avoid delays.

7\. Team Leadership \& Training

* Identify high\-potential employees across sites and optimise workforce deployment and duty allocation accordingly.
* Conduct a weekly briefing for site teams; ensure Unit Managers conduct daily staff briefings at every site without fail.
* Re\-impart regional training programmes to site teams and conduct structured on\-the\-job training sessions at least once a week.
* Support site teams in hiring staff wherever required, following the defined HR process.
* Initiate and drive the Rewards \& Recognition programme across all assigned sites to boost morale and performance.

8\. HR \& Attendance Management

* Ensure the Attendance Management System is functional and being used correctly at all units.
* Oversee attendance regularisation and ensure HR\-related documentation at each unit is kept updated at all times.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

**KPI**

**Target / Frequency**

Daily site visits completed

Minimum 2 units per day

Food waste percentage

≤3% daily across all sites

Raw material inventory cover

Minimum 2 weeks at all times

Client feedback sessions conducted

Minimum once per week

Daily Profitability Report (DPR) submitted

Daily, without exception

On\-the\-job training sessions delivered

Minimum once per week per region

Menu finalisation – Weekly

Completed by Friday of preceding week

Menu finalisation – Monthly

Completed by 20th of prior month

Staff briefings at units

Daily, verified by Area Manager

Compliance documentation up to date

100% at all sites, always

Invoice verification \& submission

On time, every billing cycle

Attendance system usage

Active and accurate at all units

Required Qualifications \& Experience

* Graduate or postgraduate in Hotel Management, Food Service Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum 5–8 years of experience in food service, canteen operations, or institutional catering, with at least 2–3 years in a multi\-site or supervisory role.
* Prior experience managing client relationships and working within contractual food service environments is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of FSSAI regulations, food safety protocols, and compliance documentation.
* Hands\-on familiarity with ERP or operations management systems used for production planning, inventory, and reporting.

Key Skills \& CompetenciesOperational Excellence

* Strong understanding of multi\-unit food service operations and the ability to manage complexity across sites simultaneously.
* Ability to read, interpret, and act on daily operational data including profitability reports and consumption variance.

Food Safety \& Quality

* Thorough knowledge of FSSAI norms, food hygiene standards, and documentation requirements.
* Disciplined approach to compliance no shortcuts on safety.

Financial Acumen

* Comfortable with cost analysis, budgeting, and driving profitability at the unit level.
* Ability to identify cost leakages and implement corrective measures quickly.

Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills to manage client expectations and maintain long\-term relationships.
* Proactive in seeking feedback and turning it into actionable improvements.

People Leadership

* Natural team builder with the ability to motivate, train, and hold teams accountable across multiple locations.
* Experience in structured training delivery and performance management at the field level.

Planning \& Organisation

* Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations simultaneously.
* Strong follow\-through culture things get done, and results are tracked.

*This job description is indicative and may evolve in line with business requirements.*

Pay: ₹70,000\.00 \- ₹120,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Lab Manager
description:
**Although this position allows for administrative work to be done remotely, this is fundamentally a field\-based management role. The Operations Manager is required to conduct daily, mandatory site visits. Every single day, you are expected to physically visit at least one active camp site at a different location within the Jaipur region. These visits are crucial to:**

* **Ensure operational integrity by checking that the camp is set up correctly, running smoothly, and adhering to all protocols.**
* **Actively manage any on\-site grievances or logistical crises immediately.**
* **Meet with partner NGO officials and local coordinators present at the site to take their feedback, ensure their satisfaction, and build strong, long\-term relationships.**

**1\. Team Recruitment \& Management**

* **Talent Acquisition:** End\-to\-end recruitment of phlebotomists and field technicians in various locations. Conduct interviews, verify certifications, and onboard new hires.
* **Duty Roster \& Allocation:** Create and manage complex duty rosters, assigning the team of 30 phlebotomists to different camp locations based on requirements, skill level, and geography.
* **HR Management:** Manage attendance, leaves, shift swaps, and performance evaluations. Handle team grievances and disciplinary issues.
* **Training \& SOP Adherence:** Conduct remote or in\-person training sessions on pre\-analytical protocols, patient handling, safety, and operational Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

**2\. Camp Logistics \& Operational Oversight**

* **Resource Planning:** Ensure all field teams have necessary supplies (vaccutainers, needles, ice packs, transport boxes, consent forms) before deploying to a camp.
* **Punctuality Monitoring:** Track the real\-time location and arrival of phlebotomists at camp venues to guarantee on\-time setup.
* **Problem Solving:** Act as the central command hub during active camps to immediately resolve issues like staff shortage, vehicle breakdown, or material deficit.

**3\. Clinical Compliance \& Sample Logistics**

* **Cold Chain Management:** Monitor and enforce strict cold chain maintenance protocols during sample collection and transport to ensure sample viability.
* **Lab Coordination:** Coordinate with partner laboratories to ensure timely and proper handover of collected samples. Verify that the correct tests are registered for the correct samples.
* **Report Management:** Tracking the Analytical Turn Around Time (TAT). Follow up with labs for timely report generation and ensure reports are dispatched/uploaded to the patient or NGO partner without delay.

**4\. Finance, Billing \& Recovery**

* **Billing Generation:** Oversee the accurate generation of bills based on the actual number of tests conducted at each camp.
* **Payment Recovery:** Coordinate with NGO partners and corporate clients for timely processing of payments against submitted invoices. Maintain a tracker of receivables.
* **Expense Management:** Verify and approve field team expenses, including travel and logistics costs.

**5\. Stakeholder Management \& Grievance Redressal**

* **NGO Liaison:** Act as the primary point of contact for NGO partner representatives, coordinating camp dates, locations, and expectations.
* **Grievance Handling:** Promptly and professionally handle any grievances from patients, NGO partners, or labs regarding the conduct of phlebotomists, delays in reports, or billing discrepancies.
* **Relationship Building:** Foster positive long\-term relationships with lab partners, supply vendors, and NGO clients.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bangalore City, Bengaluru, Karnataka

title: Assistant Manager - Procurement
description:
**FinBox: Where Fintech Meets Fun!**
------------------------------------


Welcome to FinBox, the buzzing hive of tech innovation and creativity!


Since our inception in 2017, FinBox has built some of the most advanced technologies in the financial services space that help lenders like Banks, NBFCs and large enterprises build and launch credit products within a matter of days, not months or years. FinBox is a Series B funded company which is expanding globally with offices in India, Vietnam, Indonesia and Philippines.


Our vision is to build the best\-in\-class infrastructure for lending products and help Banks \& Financial Services companies across the world scale and launch credit programs that set a new standard in the era of digital finance. So far, we’ve helped our customers disburse Billions of Dollars in credit across unsecured and secured credit including personal loans, working capital loans, business loans, mortgage and education loans. FinBox solutions are already being used by over 100\+ companies to deliver credit to over 5 million customers every month.

**Why Should You be a FinBoxer:**
---------------------------------

* **Innovative Environment:** At FinBox, we foster a culture of creativity and experimentation, encouraging our team to push the boundaries of what's possible in fintech.
* **Impactful Work:** Your contributions will directly impact the lives of millions, helping to provide fair and accessible credit to individuals and businesses alike.
* **Growth Opportunities:** We are a Series B funded startup and have ample opportunities for growth, professional development and career advancement.
* **Collaborative Culture:** Join a diverse and inclusive team of experts who are passionate about making a difference and supporting one another.

**Who’s a Great FinBoxer:**
---------------------------


At FinBox, we’re on the lookout for exceptional folks who are all about innovation and impact. If you’re excited to shake things up in the banking \& financial services world, keep reading!

**Creative Thinkers:** If your brain is always bubbling with out\-of\-the\-box ideas and wild solutions, you’re our kind of person. We love disruptors who challenge the norm and bring fresh perspectives to the table.

**Customer Heroes:** Our customers are our champions, and we need heroes who can understand their needs, deliver magical experiences, and go above and beyond to keep them happy.

**Team Players:** We believe in the power of “we.” If you thrive in a collaborative environment, value different viewpoints, and enjoy being part of a spirited, supportive team, you’ll fit right in.

**About the Role:**
-------------------


We are looking for a **Assistant Manager \- Procurement** to manage end\-to\-end procurement and sourcing activities. The role will involve vendor management, P2P operations, commercial negotiations, cost optimization, and close collaboration with internal stakeholders.  

  

**What You'll Do:**

* Manage the **end\-to\-end procurement and P2P process**, including PRs, POs, amendments, deliveries, and closure.
* Develop and execute **sourcing strategies** based on business requirements and budgets.
* Identify, evaluate, compare, onboard and manage vendors and suppliers.
* Conduct vendor comparison and commercial evaluation to support informed sourcing decisions.
* Coordinate delivery tracking, material/service verification, and timely resolution of procurement issues.
* Lead **commercial negotiations** to achieve competitive pricing and favorable terms.
* Manage vendor relationships and monitor **supplier performance, quality, and delivery timelines**.
* Partner with Finance on **invoice validation, payment processing, and reconciliation**.
* Maintain accurate procurement records, contracts, pricing, vendor data, and reports.
* Track procurement spend and identify **cost\-saving and optimization opportunities**.
* Collaborate with Finance, HR, Admin, IT, Operations, Legal and other teams to ensure timely procurement.
* Support contract renewals, vendor reviews, and procurement\-related escalations.
* Ensure procurement activities follow **internal policies, approval processes, and compliance requirements**.
* Identify opportunities to improve procurement processes and operational efficiency.

**What We're Looking For:**

* **Minimum 5 years of experience** in procurement, sourcing, purchasing, or vendor management.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **P2P and end\-to\-end procurement processes,** including PR, PO, vendor onboarding, invoice validation, and PO closure.
* Proven experience in **vendor sourcing, commercial negotiation, onboarding, and relationship management**.
* Good understanding of **commercial terms, contracts, and procurement practices**.
* Strong analytical skills with experience in spend analysis, cost optimization, and procurement reporting.
* Experience with **P2P, procurement, or vendor management tools**.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a **fast\-paced startup environment**.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, and a **cost\-conscious mindset**.

Manage end\-to\-end employee onboarding and offboarding processes.

Prepare and issue offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, experience letters, and relieving letters.

Conduct employee induction and orientation programs.

Ensure a smooth and positive employee experience throughout the employee lifecycle.

6\. Performance \& Probation Management

Track employee probation periods and confirmation timelines.

Coordinate with managers regarding probation reviews and performance documentation.

Maintain accurate performance and appraisal records.

Conduct and document exit interviews.

Coordinate employee asset handover and recovery.

Support the preparation and completion of Full \& Final (F\&F) settlement documentation.

Ensure timely issuance of relieving and experience letters.

Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills

Strong time management and coordination abilities

Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee information

Problem\-solving and interpersonal skills

About the Role

We are looking for a **Front Desk Executive cum Telecaller** to be the first point of contact for prospective parents, visitors, students, and other stakeholders. The role combines **front\-office administration, telephone handling, enquiry management, and admissions support**.

The ideal candidate should be warm, articulate, well\-presented, and comfortable speaking with parents over the phone and in person. The candidate will play an important role in creating a welcoming and professional experience for everyone interacting with the School.

Telecalling \& Admissions Enquiries

* Schedule campus visits, counselling sessions, meetings, and other appointments.
* Maintain accurate records of all calls, enquiries, follow\-ups, and outcomes.

Admissions Support

* Maintain and update prospective\-parent information in the admissions/CRM system.
* Support the scheduling of assessments, interactions, school tours, and parent meetings.
* Assist with admission forms, documentation, and other administrative requirements.
* Coordinate communication with prospective families regarding appointments and next steps.
* Support admission events, open houses, workshops, and outreach activities.

Administrative Responsibilities

* Maintain front\-office records, registers, and documentation.
* Coordinate with Security, Administration, Transport, Admissions, and other departments as required.
* Assist with basic data entry, reports, and daily administrative tasks.
* Ensure messages and requests are communicated accurately and promptly.

Qualifications

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong **Hindi and English** communication skills; knowledge of additional languages is an advantage.
* Pleasant, warm, and professional personality.
* Strong telephone etiquette and active listening skills.

title: Corporate Sales Manager
description:
About us

We are an early\-stage travel and tourism company based in Coimbatore, building leisure, group and corporate travel experiences for individual travellers, companies and institutions. As a young team, every person here owns real work from day one — you will not be a cog in a process, you will help build the process.

About the role

This is a dual role. Roughly 60% travel operations and 40% corporate and institutional sales. You will handle the end\-to\-end running of trips — quoting, booking, coordinating, and keeping guests happy — while also meeting companies, colleges and institutions in and around Coimbatore to bring in group and corporate business.

It suits someone who is organised enough to run a booking without errors, and personable enough to sit across from an HR head or a college administrator and hold a conversation. If you want variety rather than a narrow job description, this is it.

What you'll do — Operations

Build itineraries and cost sheets for domestic and international packages, group tours, and corporate offsites

Coordinate bookings with hotels, DMCs, transport operators, airlines and activity partners; negotiate rates

Handle guest communication from enquiry through to post\-trip feedback — calls, WhatsApp, email

Manage documentation: vouchers, invoices, visa paperwork, insurance, travel advisories

Be the point of contact while groups are travelling, including occasional after\-hours support during live trips

Maintain trip files, vendor records and the enquiry pipeline in our CRM/sheets

Track trip\-level costs and margins, and flag leakage

What you'll do — Corporate \& Institutional Sales

Build a prospect list of corporates, manufacturing and engineering firms, IT companies, hospitals, educational institutions, clubs and associations across Coimbatore, Tiruppur, Erode and Salem

Do outreach — calls, LinkedIn, emails, walk\-ins — and convert them into meetings

Attend client meetings (in person and online): offsites, annual team outings, MICE, dealer and incentive trips, student educational tours, faculty and alumni travel

Prepare proposals and presentations; follow up until closure

Represent the company at local trade and industry events, expos and association meets

Maintain relationships with existing accounts so repeat business comes back to us

What we're looking for

0–2 years of experience. Freshers with the right attitude will be trained. Prior experience in travel, hospitality, events, or any client\-facing sales role is an advantage

Any graduate. Degrees in Travel \& Tourism, Hotel Management, BBA or similar are a plus, not a must

Fluent English and Tamil, spoken and written. Comfort in Hindi or Malayalam is a bonus

Genuinely good on the phone and in person — warm, clear, and able to handle a client who is upset

Detail\-orientation that shows up in the work: correct dates, correct names, correct amounts, every time

Working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets, WhatsApp Business, and basic presentation tools

Willing to travel locally for client meetings, and occasionally to escort or set up a group tour

Two\-wheeler and valid licence preferred for client visits

Nice to have

Familiarity with GDS, B2B booking portals or travel CRMs

Exposure to social media, content or destination marketing

Existing contacts in the Coimbatore corporate or education ecosystem

Work arrangement and flexibility

Core working days at our Coimbatore office, with flexibility to work from home on agreed days once you are settled in

Flexible start and finish timings can be discussed around genuine personal commitments such as school hours

Some evening or weekend availability is needed when a group is actually travelling — we plan this in advance, and compensate with time off

**We actively encourage applications from women returning to work after a career break.** If you have been away from a full\-time role for a while, that is not a mark against you here. We are happy to structure the first few months as a phased, part\-remote ramp\-up while you find your rhythm.

title: Manager - People Excellence
description:
**Manager \- People Excellence** 




 Location \- Gurgaon
 



  





**About Urban Company** 




 Urban Company is a tech\-enabled home services marketplace. Customers use our platform to book services, such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, which are delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high quality, standardized and reliable service experience. To fulfill this promise, we work closely with our hand\-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.
 



  





**About the Role \& Team** 




 People Excellence runs the operating backbone of the People Success function. This role runs the operations side of it: the processes, people and vendors that deliver payroll, compliance, benefits and the employee lifecycle day in and day out.
 



 You will work through your team and vendors, setting the standards, spotting risk early, and lifting the quality of how each process runs. Accuracy is non\-negotiable \- people get paid correctly, filings go in on time, and audits close without surprises. Alongside running it, you will build the process and automation that make the work less manual over time.
 



**What you'll do:** 



* **Employee lifecycle.** 
 Own every stage: BGV and onboarding, confirmations, leave, movement and transfer, promotion, rehire, offboarding and exit formalities, along with the letters, contracts and personnel records behind them. That includes employee queries and service delivery: response times, escalation paths, and fixing the root cause of whatever keeps coming back. HRMS administration and data hygiene sit here too, and a full revamp of onboarding is an early priority.
* **Employee experience.** 
 Design the moments that matter across the journey, from a joiner's first week to an exit that ends well, and improve them on evidence rather than instinct.
* **HR data and reporting.** 
 Own the recurring reports and ad hoc data requests from leadership, Finance, vendors and auditors, and make sure the numbers hold up.
* **Payroll.** 
 Make sure monthly processing, full and final settlements, reconciliations and Finance reporting land accurately and on time, across India and international entities.
* **Compliance.** 
 Hold the function's statutory and labour compliance, with a dedicated compliance team member reporting in.
* **Benefits and ESOP.** 
 Insurance, car lease, and the monthly ESOP exercise.
* **Operating rhythm.** 
 Set the SOPs, SLAs and review cadence, and build the dashboards that surface a problem before it becomes an escalation.
* **Audits.** 
 Programme manage internal and external audits: hold the plan, track closure, and keep area POCs on time with auditors.
* **Projects.** 
 Lead the charter's key projects, starting with the payroll vendor implementation and the ESOP exercise.
* **Automation.** 
 Find what can be automated across lifecycle, payroll and compliance, and deliver it with internal teams and vendors.
* **Team, vendors and stakeholders.** 
 Manage and develop the people running these processes, own vendor commercials, SLAs and delivery across payroll, compliance and benefits, and be the point of contact for this charter across Finance, Legal, Tech and the People Success partners.



**What we'll need:** 



* 5\-8 years of experience in HR operations with exposure to payroll and compliance
* Working knowledge of Indian statutory and labour compliance: PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, Shops \& Establishments, CLRA
* Experience managing a small team, with evidence of developing people rather than only allocating work
* Hands on with Microsoft Excel and Google suite (high Excel proficiency would be a plus)
* Strong attention to detail, with the judgement to know which errors are material
* Super organized yet agile to adapt to UC's way of working



**Folks you will work with:** 




 We understand that the people you work with and learn from is the single most important determinant of how much you enjoy working at a place. In fact, this defines the culture in many ways. Here is a list of UC folks you can expect to work with and collaborate with:
 


* Utkarsh Bindal, VP: Ex. Airtel, Bira91, MDI
* Chetna Wadhwa, Director: Ex. Rivigo, MDI, DCE
* Kushagra Varshney, General Manager \- Rewards \& People Excellence



**What can you expect:** 



* A great work environment with massive ownership and growth opportunities \- we hire folks for a career opportunity, not just the role.
* Energy and hustle of a startup with processes and depth of a big organization
* Expect to work with people you can learn from and are invested in your growth



  





*At Urban Company we are committed to providing equal and fair opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive work environment. We endeavor to maintain a work environment free from harassment based on age, colour, physical ability, marital status, parental status, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity.*

Specialist. Responsive. Thoughtful. Our values aren't just words; they are the backbone of our business. Our team embodies our values daily, to surpass client expectations, evolve constantly and nurture genuine relationships for the long\-term.


**Job requirements**

Role Overview
  

  

The Senior Analyst – Pension Administration is the entry\-level role within the pension operations hierarchy.
  

This role is responsible for carrying out day to day pension administration tasks, maintaining member records, and supporting accurate processing of member events under Defined Benefit (DB), Defined Contribution (DC), or Hybrid schemes.
  

As a frontline colleague, the Senior Analyst follows established procedures, works with high attention to detail, and ensures SLA driven delivery of calculations, data updates, and member communication drafts.
  

The role supports the wider team by completing assigned work efficiently, escalating issues appropriately, and contributing to high\-quality member service.
  

  

Role \& Responsibilities:
  

  

Member Event Processing
  

  

Process routine pension administration tasks such as Retirements, Leavers, Transfers, Deaths and member data updates.
  

Follow documented procedures, Scheme Rules, and calculation guidance to complete work accurately and on time.
  

Input and maintain member data across designated pension administration systems.
  

  

Pension Calculations
  

  

Perform simple calculations using automated and manual tools, under supervision.
  

Check own work carefully and escalate discrepancies or unclear cases to senior colleagues.
  

Ensure calculation outputs are aligned with Scheme Rules and internal quality standards.
  

Quality, Compliance \& Controls
  

  

Deliver work with strong accuracy and adherence to SLAs, audit requirements, and compliance standards.
  

Follow data security policies and maintain confidentiality of member records.
  

Escalate potential errors, risks, or issues in line with defined procedures.
  

  

Experience \& Qualifications
  

* 1–2 years of experience in pensions, financial services, shared services, or operations (freshers with strong aptitude may be considered).

  

* Basic understanding of Defined Benefit and Defined Contribution pension concepts — training will be provided.

  

* Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and willingness to learn technical pension rules.
* Good communication skills, both written and verbal.

  

* Proficiency in MS Office and ability to work with workflow systems.

  

* Professional pensions qualifications (PMI) — not mandatory; training support may be offered.

If you are interested in this role, then we’d love to hear from you. Please go ahead and click apply and submit your resume with appropriate contact information.

**Global Business Services**

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.


Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

***Market Ops***

  



**Derivatives Collateral Operations** manages the margining for the OTC, Repo Derivatives \& Foreign Exchange businesses and Repo agreements. Collateral Management is a tool to control \& reduce the bank's credit exposure risk on Derivative trades.


The Collateral Operations Unit monitors daily margining for customers across various products (Rates, Commodity, Structured Credit, Equity, Foreign Exchange, and Repo, Futures \& Options). The Counterparty’s net exposure is evaluated each morning in order to determine collateral requirement. Margin Calls are made and received by Collateral Analyst and collateral exchanged. Team is also responsible to perform Security Optimization, Journal processing, liquidity and regulatory reporting.

  



**Global Markets Business Finance \& Control (BF\&C)** seeks to provide a first\-class support service with particular focus on the relationship between trading risk positions and P\&L components. We are looking to recruit an individual to work in the P\&L production area covering the Fixed Income/FX/Equity trading desks. The candidate’s main responsibility will be to produce and deliver the daily P\&L to front office, providing a high standard of analysis and explanation around any issues faced and daily revenue drivers. Good communication and time management skills are essential to perform this role.


Individual will be responsible for metric governance which require collection/validation of metric values, followed by gathering RCA \& G2G commentary on non\-performing metrics. **Structured Trade Review** \- Reconcile the trade bookings (in at\-least one asset class) in the trade/risk booking systems with the documents (Confirmation, Pricing Supplement, Term Sheet) \& ensure no discrepancies. Identify potential PnL breaks/ settlement breaks due to mis\-booking, ensure the amendment of mis\-booking \& report MTM impact of amendments. Identify, Confirm \& Report conservative valuation bookings (over hedges) \& approximate bookings for trades.

  



**EMEA Securities Settlements** team perform various functions like pre\-matching, settlements, sufficiency, Depot Transfers and controls functions like margin, queue/break management, FOP, and margin payments for few entities. We work on both equities and fixed income products. Maintaining client/broker relationship and keeping the market, credit, liquidity, and operational risk to its minimum is key to the success. Teams interact with several different internal teams which are part of trade lifecycle and also with various counterparties externally to match/settle the trades.

title: Operations Analyst – Business Excellence
description:
Link to apply:
 **https://forms.gle/GmqRdZEQ63sp7Sh86** 




  





**The role**




  





 This role sits between analytics and operations. You'll own a core operational metric across every one of our kitchens: dig into the data to find what's driving it, work with the teams on the ground to fix it, and prove the fix worked. It's not a reporting job and it's not a pure ops job. You'll be measured on what actually changes in our kitchens.
 



  





**What you'll do**




  




* Own a key metric. Take end\-to\-end responsibility for improving one core operational KPI across all kitchens.
* Find the why in the data. Build the tracking, spot patterns and outliers, and turn analysis into clear actions, not just dashboards.
* Fix problems on the ground, remotely. Work closely with area managers and kitchen teams over calls, audits and store data to understand what's really happening and design practical solutions.
* Run pilots and scale fast. Test ideas in a few kitchens, measure the results properly, and roll out what works across the network.
* Standardize what works. Turn high\-performing practices into simple SOPs and make sure they stick across locations.
* Work across teams. Partner with area managers, central teams and training to roll out changes and build capability at the store level.
* Keep raising the bar. Never settle for "this is how it's always been done."



  





**What we're looking for**




  




* Engineer from a reputed institute (IIT/NIT/BITS or similar), 1\-4 years of experience.
* Strong analytical skills: comfortable with Excel/Sheets and SQL, and able to go from raw data to a clear recommendation.
* Exceptional problem\-solving: you enjoy both math puzzles and messy real\-world business problems.
* Near\-perfect attention to detail.
* Ability to drive action through others: you can influence teams you don't manage, over calls and messages.
* Leadership in college (fests, clubs, placements, sponsorships) or strong extra\-curricular involvement.
* Self\-driven and accountable. Remote doesn't mean relaxed: this role needs high ownership in a high\-intensity culture.



  





*This is a hands\-on role. You'll use data every day, but success is measured by what changes in our kitchens, not by dashboards or decks.* 




  





**Why join us**




  




* 100% remote \- work from anywhere in India.
* 12\-20 LPA with real ownership from day one.
* Small, lean team \- we hire only \~15 people a year.
* Work directly with founders and top management and learn from the best.
* See your impact in real time \- your changes show up in the business numbers.
* Be part of a 10X scale\-up over the next 5 years.



  





**Who we are**




  




* Market leaders: One of India's largest food delivery companies, with brands like BOX8 (India's largest chain of North Indian meals) and MOJO Pizza (India's largest homegrown pizza delivery chain).
* Fast, profitable growth: 600\+ Cr revenue run\-rate, 50% CAGR, valued at 4,000 Cr, and one of the few profitable start\-ups.
* Backed by top investors: Tiger Global, A91, IIFL and Mayfield.
* Scale: 500\+ cloud kitchens and 12 brands across Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai and Kolkata, adding \~100 kitchens a year.
* Stable leadership: Founded by IIT Bombay and IIT Kharagpur alumni; no one from the leadership team has left in the last 5 years.

****Introduction to the Position****
 MX is on a mission to improve the financial lives of everyone and, for this reason, we’re creating innovative software designed to bring financial freedom to the lives of individuals, families, and communities. Our products help consumers understand and manage their financial data, improve their financial decision\-making, and strengthen connections between financial institutions and their customers. We believe that data are central to every important financial action and we’re looking for smart, driven, creative individuals to come build with us!
   

  

 The MX Product team is responsible for building world\-class financial tools that leverage our unrivaled data assets. As consumers and institutions interact with these tools, new insights and information are created that can be transformed into even better products. In service to creating the industry's most compelling products, the Operational Analytics Team takes the lead on the company’s most computationally and analytically complex problems. If you’re keen to conduct careful analyses focused on core business problems, operational analysis, and instrumentation in an intellectually engaging environment, you’ll enjoy working at MX as a Product Analyst.
   

  

 As a Product Analyst, you’ll partner with colleagues from the Product and Analytics teams to complete a variety of computational activities, including analyzing customer journey and end\-user metrics, data mining exercises, data stratification and quality control, and dashboard and KPI development. Your work will inform new product development and help us understand how to maximize our product portfolio’s marketplace effectiveness. As a talented “data wrangler”, you’ll leverage your analytical skills to discover new correlations and predictive relationships using MX’s expanding, world\-class data assets. Eager to learn, you’ll also look for ways to enhance your analytical toolbox through side\-by\-side training and self\-directed study. The ability to interpret and communicate analytical results will be important for success, as will patience in the face of analytic uncertainty. Your computational background, collaborative spirit, and hands\-on approach to solving problems will mark you as an ideal candidate for this role.
   

  

 As part of MX’s thriving analytics organization, you’ll enjoy autonomy and the ability to make a real difference in a successful and high\-growth company. As you partner with other creative and enthusiastic team members, you’ll be rewarded and recognized for your high\-caliber work. MX’s values are central to the company’s success, and you’ll live by questioning assumptions and taking initiative, advancing our data\-driven approach to solving problems, and showing empathy and a commitment to radical honesty in equal measure.
   

  

****Job Responsibilities****
* Work with colleagues from the product and analytics functions to design customer and procedural metrics, complete operational and segmentation analyses, predict end\-user behavior, and make data\-driven recommendations about product features
* Evaluate product effectiveness (including versus industry peers), complete market analyses, refine customer value propositions, and collect customer feedback
* Write scripts to support hypothesis\-based and theory\-free data mining projects (e.g., create new pattern recognition algorithms and find hidden relationships between features)
* Create new data assets, modeling features, and dashboards in service to MX’s product platform
* Monitor data platform system performance to identify and address challenges to data quality (e.g., accuracy, completeness, and reliability) and availability
* Lead data exploration work to generate insights on product effectiveness, institutional client results, and end\-user (consumer) financial health
* Develop presentations and memoranda to communicate key messages and insights based on rigorous analyses
* Serve as a subject matter expert on analytical best practices and data visualization


**Basic Qualifications (Must\-Have)**
* Bachelor’s degree, including quantitative coursework (e.g., Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Computer Science, or similar)
* 1\-3 years’ experience with operational, financial, or marketing analytics (likely including building dashboards and KPIs and analyzing product performance metrics)
* Proficiency with at least one database query language (e.g., SQL); familiarity with Python and exposure to modern data science environments (e.g., cloud, Jupyter, and git) is preferred
* Critical thinking skills, attention to detail, and focus on results
* Drive to tackle demanding goals with enthusiasm, tenacity in the face of stubborn obstacles, and interest in pursuing personal and technical development alongside other commitments
* Commitment to client needs and satisfaction, humility in the face of constructive feedback, and production of high\-quality work that builds trust and confidence with stakeholders
* Proven experience presenting analytical results to managers and teammates


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Familiarity with Python or other statistical programming languages for data manipulation, analysis, and visualization.
* Hands\-on experience working in modern data science environments (e.g., cloud platforms like AWS/GCP, Jupyter notebooks, version control systems like git).
* Prior professional experience in fintech, financial services, or high\-growth SaaS environments.
* Proficiency with Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, and data modeling.
* Experience building or optimizing analytics infrastructure, ETL pipelines, or data warehouse implementations.


**Compensation**
 The expected earnings for this role could be comprised of a base salary and other forms of cash compensation, such as bonus or commissions as applicable.
   

  

 This pay range is just one component of MX’s total rewards package. MX takes a number of factors into account when determining individual starting pay, including job and level they are hired into, location, skillset, peer compensation.
   

  

* Please note applicants applying for this position must have the legal right to work in India without the need for sponsorship. We are unable to provide work sponsorship for this role, and candidates should be able to verify their eligibility to work in the country independently. Proof of eligibility to work in India will be required as part of the hiring process.


**Work Environment**
 In this role, a significant aspect of the job involves working in the office for a standard 40\-hour workweek. We believe that the collaborative nature of our work and the face\-to\-face interactions among team members are essential for fostering a dynamic and productive work environment. Being present in the office enables seamless communication, facilitates quick decision\-making, and encourages spontaneous collaboration that contributes to the overall success of our projects. We value the synergy that comes from having our team members physically together, allowing for immediate problem\-solving, idea exchange, and team building.

title: ML Research Engineer, Speech
description:
**About Blue Machines And The Speech Research Team**
 Blue Machines (ApnaTime Tech Pvt. Ltd.) builds enterprise voice AI agents for banks, insurers, healthcare and telecom companies. Our platform has handled tens of millions of production voice minutes, is ISO 27001/27701 and SOC 2 Type II certified, and runs both on cloud and on\-prem.
   

  

 We already run our own models in production: Aurora (STT tuned for BFSI), Floe (language\-switch detection), end\-of\-utterance models, and noise cancellation, all on BM Zap, our low\-latency voice framework. The Speech Research team takes this further: better accuracy on Indian languages and code\-mixed speech, natural expressive TTS, and full\-duplex speech\-to\-speech models that cut latency across the whole conversation.
   

  

 What makes this work different
   

  

* Real traffic: your model ships to live enterprise calls, not a leaderboard
* Hard problems: 8 kHz telephony audio, Hinglish and code\-switching, accents, noisy environments, domain entities (loan numbers, policy IDs, names)
* Tight latency budgets: streaming inference where every 50 ms is noticed by callers
* A full loop: data, training, evaluation, serving and production feedback in one team


 Location: Bengaluru (on\-site / hybrid)
   

  

* Team: Speech Research, reporting into the CTO org


 Role 1: ML Research Engineer, Speech (1\-3 years)
   

  

 You will build speech models from the ground up: implement architectures from scratch, pre\-train them on large audio corpora, then adapt and ship them. You'll own well\-scoped experiments from data to deployed checkpoint, with guidance from senior researchers.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Pre\-train STT models from scratch (Conformer/Zipformer encoders, CTC/RNN\-T/TDT decoders, self\-supervised pre\-training like wav2vec 2\.0/HuBERT/BEST\-RQ), then fine\-tune them for Indian languages, Hinglish and BFSI vocabulary
* Train TTS models from scratch (flow\-matching, diffusion, neural codec LMs, vocoders) and extend them to new voices, languages and speaking styles
* Build speech\-to\-speech components from scratch: audio tokenizers and codecs, speech encoders connected to LLMs, streaming decoders
* Turn papers and new ideas into working PyTorch code: write the model, tokenizer and training loop yourself, and train from random initialisation
* Build data pipelines: cleaning, segmentation, forced alignment, pseudo\-labelling, augmentation (noise, codecs, 8 kHz telephony simulation)
* Maintain evaluation suites: WER/CER, entity error rate, code\-switch accuracy, MOS and speaker similarity, latency (time to first token / byte)
* Optimise models for serving: quantisation, streaming chunking, ONNX/TensorRT export, batching on GPUs
* Analyse production errors, turn them into test sets, and close the loop with the platform team
* Write clear experiment reports and share findings in weekly research reviews


**What you bring**
* 1\-3 years in ML, with at least one real project in speech or audio (industry, research lab, or a strong thesis)
* B.Tech/M.Tech/MS in CS, EE or a related field; a PhD is not required
* Strong Python and PyTorch; able to implement a model architecture and training loop from scratch, not just call APIs or fine\-tune checkpoints
* Working knowledge of speech basics: spectrograms, MFCC/mel features, CTC, attention\-based seq2seq, vocoders
* Hands\-on with at least one of: NeMo, ESPnet, Hugging Face Transformers/Audio, fairseq, Coqui, k2/icefall
* Has trained at least one model from random initialisation (speech, audio or language), including multi\-GPU jobs, mixed precision and experiment tracking (W\&B, MLflow)
* Careful with evaluation: you know why a WER number can mislead, and you check your data


**Nice to have**
* Speak or understand Hindi or another Indian language
* Publications, Kaggle/benchmark results, or open\-source contributions in speech
* Exposure to real\-time audio (WebRTC, SIP, streaming inference) or telephony audio
* Familiarity with LLM fine\-tuning (LoRA, SFT) or audio\-language models


**What success looks like in 6 months**
* Contributed to a pre\-trained\-from\-scratch model that shipped to production with a measured gain on a customer\-relevant test set
* Owns a piece of the evaluation or data pipeline that others rely on
* Runs experiments independently and reports results the team can trust

Joining Amex Tech means being part of a global engineering organization that is shaping the future of commerce through cutting\-edge platforms, data, and Artificial Intelligence. Our teams build scalable, secure, and intelligent systems that power seamless experiences for customers and colleagues worldwide.

From intelligent automation to advanced decisioning and personalized engagement, we are embedding AI into core sales and customer platforms—while ensuring strong governance, reliability, and responsible use at enterprise scale
   

  

 You will also contribute to the development of enterprise AI platforms, reusable frameworks, and engineering best practices while ensuring AI solutions are reliable, secure, and aligned with responsible AI and governance standards.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement AI and Agentic AI solutions that enhance customer engagement, sales effectiveness, and operational efficiency across enterprise CRM platforms.
* Build intelligent workflows using Large Language Models (LLMs), enterprise data, and tool integrations to automate customer and business processes.
* Develop production\-ready GenAI applications, including Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and AI\-powered business workflows.
* Build and maintain scalable data pipelines and AI solutions using Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as BigQuery, Composer (Airflow), DataProc, and related cloud services.
* Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems, APIs, and data platforms while ensuring operational reliability and performance.
* Collaborate with product managers, software engineers, data engineers, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into AI\-enabled solutions.
* Contribute to shared AI frameworks, reusable components, evaluation pipelines, and engineering standards.
* Ensure AI applications comply with enterprise security, governance, responsible AI, and operational standards.


**Qualifications**
* 3–5\+ years of experience in full stack \-software engineering, machine learning engineering, data engineering, or applied AI.
* Hands\-on experience building or integrating GenAI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Experience with Agentic AI concepts, including orchestration frameworks, tool calling, context management, or multi\-step AI workflows.
* Understanding of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, prompt engineering, and LLM evaluation techniques.
* Strong programming skills in Python and experience developing backend services, APIs, and data pipelines.
* Experience with AI/ML frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit\-learn.
* Working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including BigQuery, Composer (Airflow), DataProc, Cloud Storage, and related data services.
* Understanding of cloud\-native application development, distributed systems, and modern software engineering practices.
* Knowledge of CI/CD, containerization (Docker), and production deployment concepts.
* Good problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively in cross\-functional teams


**About Us**
 At American Express, our culture is built on a 175\-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world\-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
   

  

 As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well\-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
