title: Lab Technician
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Role Name And Description**
 Lab Technician
   

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
 Lab technician to support end\-to\-end software, firmware and product testing and validation. Assists the Lab Lead with build\-out and design.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Build, cable, configure, maintain and document lab systems, devices and test environments under the direction of the Lab Lead.
* Execute end\-to\-end software, firmware, configuration and product test plans and record clear, reproducible results.
* Support Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android plus enterprise AV endpoints, peripherals and infrastructure.
* Provision and reset devices using Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, Microsoft Entra ID and approved deployment procedures.
* Monitor device health, collect logs, reproduce reported defects and support technical troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis.
* Maintain lab inventory, asset labels, firmware and software baselines, test accounts, spares and configuration records.
* Assist with rack, room and bench build\-out, including connectivity checks and safe equipment handling.
* Raise defects with complete evidence, track retesting and help maintain test scripts, knowledge articles and operating procedures.
* Coordinate with engineering, vendors and support teams while following lab access, change and security controls.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Technical diploma, degree or relevant hands\-on experience in AV, IT, electronics or a related field.
* Practical troubleshooting skills and a structured approach to executing and documenting tests.
* Good written and verbal English communication and the ability to work effectively with distributed teams.
* Attention to detail, safe working practices, customer orientation and willingness to learn new technologies.
* Ability to manage multiple test tasks, shifting priorities and repetitive validation activities accurately.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Hands\-on Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android deployment, configuration and lifecycle support.
* Enterprise AV systems installation, integration and troubleshooting, including cameras, microphones, speakers, displays, DSPs and control devices.
* Windows and Android device troubleshooting plus basic Microsoft 365 administration awareness.
* Microsoft Intune device management, Autopilot provisioning and Microsoft Entra ID fundamentals.
* Basic networking knowledge including TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP and device connectivity.
* PowerShell fundamentals for device checks, log collection and repeatable tasks.
* Experience using monitoring and management platforms such as Teams Admin Center, Control Hub, Poly Lens or Neat Pulse.
* Ability to follow test plans, capture evidence and maintain accurate inventory and configuration documentation.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Azure Administration knowledge aligned to AZ\-104 concepts.
* Azure Monitor and Log Analytics exposure.
* Power Automate, Logic Apps or Microsoft Graph API familiarity.
* Python or scripting experience for test automation.
* ServiceNow incident, request and asset\-management experience.
* AV industry certification such as CTS or relevant Crestron training.
* Experience with secure print, smart lockers or workplace spaces technology.


**What We Look For**
* We’re looking for a dependable, curious and detail\-oriented technician who enjoys hands\-on testing, follows disciplined processes and communicates defects clearly.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on challenging projects and gain access to an expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: You’ll have the tools and flexibility to make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: You’ll gain the insights, coaching and confidence to help build the leadership capabilities the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be empowered to use your voice and help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Role Summary**
 Build automation that helps athenahealth deliver reliable, high\-quality software at scale. The Member of Technical Staff – Automation Engineer will develop and maintain automated test coverage across UI, API, and backend layers, and will use Claude and Codex agents and skills to help solve testing problems such as test generation, test data creation, and failure triage. This role is based in Chennai, India and follows a hybrid work model. The person in this role will collaborate with engineers, QA partners, and other stakeholders to deliver maintainable automation solutions using modern software development and AI\-assisted testing practices. This position reports to the Senior Engineering Manager, Quality.
   

  

**Team Summary**
 Our Collector QA team is building new and evolving test automation capabilities for athenahealth customers. We work on solving complex quality and reliability problems for a broad set of stakeholders, including customers, internal technology\-enabled services teams, and multiple BPO vendors. Much of this work involves designing and implementing automated test coverage that validates large volumes of claim resolution workflows, with a focus on improving reliability, coverage, and release confidence.
   

  

 These systems support quality validation that may be performed manually by QA partners or automated to improve overall test coverage and productivity. That means our team builds automation that exercises UI flows, validates API contracts, verifies backend data integrity, and creates a more efficient and reliable testing experience across revenue cycle operations. The engineering work often involves balancing test stability, coverage, maintainability, and evolving business needs across distributed systems.
   

  

 As a Member of Technical Staff, this role contributes directly to the development of automated test coverage, API and backend automation, and Claude/Codex\-based testing agents that support these workflows. Success in this role requires solid software engineering fundamentals, exposure to test automation practices, and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions. The team values clear communication, practical problem solving, and thoughtful engineering that improves quality outcomes for customers and internal users.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
* Develop automated tests using Playwright with TypeScript to support business\-critical workflows and platform capabilities.
* Build and maintain API automation (REST/GraphQL) and backend test automation that integrate with internal platforms and dependent systems.
* Use Claude and Codex agents and skills to help solve testing problems, such as generating test cases, creating test data, and triaging test failures.
* Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to translate quality requirements into automated test coverage.
* Create and enhance automated tests and CI/CD test integrations that support high\-volume transactional workflows.

* Contribute to code reviews, test reviews, and team engineering practices that improve automation quality and consistency.
* Support optimization of test execution performance and pipeline throughput to improve operational efficiency.
* Use AI tools, where appropriate, to improve productivity in day\-to\-day automation work, such as understanding unfamiliar code, drafting test cases, summarizing technical information, or exploring implementation options, while reviewing outputs carefully before applying them.


**Additional Job Responsibilities**
* Document automated test coverage, implementation details, and test dependencies for shared understanding across the team.
* Support deployment, release validation, and post\-release monitoring for assigned test coverage or features.
* Assist in improving CI/CD workflows and test automation practices across the team.
* Contribute to test reporting and monitoring improvements that help detect and resolve automation and production issues.
* Partner with adjacent teams to align on API contracts, integration points, and shared test dependencies.
* Share technical knowledge through walkthroughs, documentation, and collaborative problem\-solving sessions.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows or reduce manual testing effort through automation enhancements.


**Expected Education \& Experience**
* 2 to 4 years of software engineering experience in test automation, backend development, or related application development work.
* Hands\-on experience with Playwright using JavaScript and TypeScript for building and maintaining automated test suites.
* Experience developing or supporting API automation (REST/GraphQL) and backend/service\-based test automation.
* Exposure to building agents and skills with Claude and Codex to solve testing problems, such as automated test generation and failure triage.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, version control, and cloud application deployment concepts (AWS or Azure).
* Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including object\-oriented design, testing, debugging, and version control.
* Experience working in Agile or iterative development environments with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to analyze technical issues, communicate clearly, and contribute practical solutions.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

title: Quality Executive – Food Manufacturing
description:
Wellversed is looking for a Quality Assurance (QA) Executive with 1–3 years of experience in quality assurance, quality control, food processing, nutraceuticals, pharmaceuticals, or FMCG manufacturing. The role involves ensuring product quality, monitoring manufacturing and packaging operations, maintaining quality documentation, and ensuring compliance with regulatory and company standards.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 1\. Quality Inspection \& Product Testing
 


* Conduct quality inspections of raw materials, packaging materials, in\-process products, and finished goods.
* Verify product specifications, labeling, and packaging quality before product release and dispatch.
* Monitor product quality parameters and ensure compliance with established standards.



 2\. Process Monitoring \& Compliance
 


* Monitor manufacturing and packaging activities to ensure adherence to SOPs, GMP, hygiene, and quality standards.
* Identify deviations, non\-conformities, and quality issues, and support corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Ensure compliance with FSSAI, GMP, and other applicable regulatory requirements.



 3\. Documentation \& Quality Systems
 


* Maintain quality records, inspection reports, batch records, and other QA documentation.
* Support internal and external audits by preparing and maintaining required documents.
* Assist in implementing and improving quality management systems and processes.



 4\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement
 


* Work closely with Production, R\&D, Procurement, Warehouse, and Compliance teams to maintain product quality and process efficiency.
* Support customer complaint investigations and root cause analysis.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and operational performance.



  





**Requirements** 



* 1–4 years of full\-time experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Food Processing, Nutraceuticals, Pharmaceuticals, or FMCG Manufacturing.
* Proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel and Google Sheets.
* Relevant degree in Food Technology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Chemistry, or a related field.
* Good understanding of GMP, SOPs, quality systems, and regulatory requirements.
* Strong analytical, observation, documentation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Learnability, flexibility, and adaptability to work in a fast\-paced environment.



  





**About Wellversed** 




 Wellversed owns and operates a portfolio of nutrition brands to empower people to attain their most optimal state of wellness. Our brands like Wellcore, YouWeFit, Zero Sugar, Okami, Osmo, and Dynamite enable people to unlock their performance potential and live healthier lives. The brands are made available to our customers through an omni\-channel approach including our own eCommerce portal (
 
 www.wellversed.in
 
 ).

title: Infrastructure Support Administrator
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Infrastructure Support Administrator
 



**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, India
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Shift Timings:** 
 6AM to 2\.30 PM, 9\.30 AM to 6 PM, Rollover days. 365 days a year.
 



**Working Days:** 
 5 Days
 



  
 



**About the Role**




 We are seeking a proactive Infrastructure Support Administrator to join our team. In this critical role, you will be the first line of defence for our server and cloud environment, ensuring high availability and performance during overnight hours.
 



 You will initially focus on monitoring and remediating alerts via PRTG, performing health checks on Windows/Linux servers, and supporting our Azure and Microsoft Entra environments. As the role evolves, you will take ownership of server patching and advanced infrastructure operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




 \- Monitoring \& Remediation: Monitor the PRTG dashboard, validate alerts, and execute documented runbooks to resolve incidents quickly.
 



 \- Troubleshooting: Perform root\-cause analysis for Windows Server issues (CPU, memory, services, Event Viewer) and basic Linux administration tasks.
 



 \- Cloud \& Identity Support: Support Azure VM health, networking, and monitor Entra ID sign\-in logs for authentication issues.
 



 \- Incident Management: Escalate complex incidents requiring specialized knowledge, vendor support, or production changes while documenting all actions taken.
 



 \- Maintenance: Participate in overnight maintenance activities and eventually execute approved patching workflows (Windows/Linux).
 



 \- Documentation: Maintain detailed incident notes, shift handoff summaries, and contribute to the improvement of knowledge articles and runbooks.
 



  
 



**Required Technical Skills**




 \- Windows Server: Strong troubleshooting skills (Event Viewer, Services, Task Manager, PowerShell) for performance and service\-related issues.
 



 \- Linux Admin: Basic command\-line proficiency (CPU, memory, disk usage, logs, SSH).
 



 \- Monitoring (PRTG): Experience with infrastructure monitoring tools; ability to distinguish between informational, warning, and critical alerts.
 



 \- Microsoft Azure: Knowledge of VMs, Resource Groups, Networking (VNETs/NSGs), and Azure Monitor.
 



 \- Microsoft Entra (Azure AD): Familiarity with user/group management, authentication logs, MFA, and Conditional Access.
 



  
 



**Preferred Experience**




 \- Experience with enterprise patching tools (e.g., Azure Update Manager, WSUS, MECM/SCCM).
 



 \- Understanding of backup validation and restore considerations.
 



 \- Familiarity with virtualized environments (VMware/Hyper\-V).
 



  
 



**Operational Requirements**




 \- Must be available for a consistent overnight shift.
 



 \- Excellent written communication skills for incident notes and shift handoffs.
 



 \- Ability to prioritize alerts based on business impact and follow security/compliance protocols rigorously.
 



  
 



**Why Join Us?**




 \- Career Growth: The role starts with monitoring and expands into patching, infrastructure ownership, and continuous improvement.
 



 \- Critical Impact: Directly influence the stability and security of our global infrastructure.
 



  
 



**Evaluation Criteria**




 Ideal candidates will demonstrate the ability to:
 



 \- Troubleshoot a Windows server with high CPU or low disk space.
 



 \- Investigate a PRTG alert and determine the appropriate action.
 



 \- Differentiate between an Azure resource issue and a guest OS issue.
 



 \- Explain a safe patching workflow from pre\-checks to post\-validation.
 



 \- Write a clear and concise shift handoff summary.
 



  





 Join our team and contribute to a collaborative, innovative environment, where your ideas can truly make a difference.
 



 We look forward to receiving your application

title: Member of Technical Staff – MTS
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
   

  

**Business Title: Member of Technical Staff**
**Position Summary**
 Build software that helps athenahealth solve complex healthcare business challenges at scale. The Member of Technical Staff will develop and maintain backend services and cloud\-based applications that support high\-volume claim resolution workflows, improve operational efficiency, and contribute to reliable product experiences for customers and internal teams. This role is based in Chennai, India and follows a hybrid work model. The person in this role will collaborate with engineers, product partners, and other stakeholders to deliver maintainable, scalable solutions using modern software development practices. This position reports to the Manager, Engineering.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our Collector R\&D teams are building new and evolving services for athenahealth customers. We work on solving complex business problems for a broad set of stakeholders, including customers, internal technology\-enabled services teams, and multiple BPO vendors. Much of this work involves designing and implementing workflows that manage large volumes of claim resolution activity, with a focus on improving visibility, throughput, and operational consistency.
   

  

 These systems support work that may be completed manually by operations partners or automated to improve overall productivity. That means our teams build software that helps route work, manage exceptions, connect business rules to execution paths, and create a more efficient experience across revenue cycle operations. The engineering work often involves balancing scale, reliability, maintainability, and evolving business needs across distributed systems.
   

  

 As a Member of Technical Staff, this role contributes directly to the development of backend services and microservices that power these workflows. Success in this role requires solid software engineering fundamentals, experience working with service\-based systems, and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions. The team values clear communication, practical problem solving, and thoughtful engineering that improves outcomes for customers and internal users. Source context: the Collector R\&D team summary provided in your prompt and athenahealth engineering JD guidance on MTS back\-end roles:
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
* Develop backend applications and services using Java to support business\-critical workflows and platform capabilities.
* Build and maintain scalable microservices that integrate with internal platforms and dependent systems.
* Implement cloud\-based solutions on AWS with attention to reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Create and enhance APIs and service integrations that support high\-volume transactional workflows.
* Troubleshoot application and service issues, identify root causes, and deliver fixes that improve system stability.
* Contribute to code reviews, unit testing, and team engineering practices that improve software quality and consistency.
* Optimize application performance and service interactions to support scalability and operational efficiency.
* Use AI tools, where appropriate, to improve productivity in day\-to\-day engineering work, such as understanding unfamiliar code, drafting test cases, summarizing technical information, or exploring implementation options, while reviewing outputs carefully before applying them.


**Additional Job Responsibilities**
* Document technical designs, implementation details, and service dependencies for shared understanding across the team.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and estimation activities.
* Support deployment, release validation, and post\-release monitoring for assigned services or features.
* Assist in improving CI/CD workflows and development practices across the team.
* Contribute to monitoring and alerting improvements that help detect and resolve production issues.
* Partner with adjacent teams to align on API contracts, integration points, and shared dependencies.
* Share technical knowledge through walkthroughs, documentation, and collaborative problem\-solving sessions.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows or reduce manual effort through service enhancements and automation.


**Expected Education \& Experience**
* 2 to 4 years of software engineering experience in backend development, distributed systems, or related application development work.
* Hands\-on experience with Java for building and maintaining production applications.
* Experience developing or supporting microservices and service\-based architectures.
* Working knowledge of AWS and cloud application deployment concepts.
* Experience building or consuming RESTful APIs and integrating with distributed systems.
* Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including object\-oriented design, testing, debugging, and version control.
* Experience working in Agile or iterative development environments with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to analyze technical issues, communicate clearly, and contribute practical solutions.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.


**About Athenahealth**
***Our vision:***
*In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.*
***Our company culture:***
*Our talented* 
*employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do\-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission\-driven problem\-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award\-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.*
***Our DEI commitment:***
*Our vision of accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.*
**What We Can Do For You**
*Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative* 
*workspaces* 
 —
 *some offices even welcome dogs.*
*We also encourage a better work\-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in\-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment,* 
*full\-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth* 
*enables* 
*employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.*
*In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.*
*Learn more about our culture and benefits here: athenahealth.com/careers*
*https://www.athenahealth.com/careers/equal\-opportunity*

title: Officer - Group operations
description:
The Officer \- Group Operations supports the Vetting Desk in two areas: vessel vetting (RightShip, Q88 and related questionnaires) and ship security (ISPS Code). The role tracks inspections, keeps vetting and security records up to date, follows up on findings until closed, supports Ship Security Plan work, security intelligence and guidance for vessels in high\-risk areas, and reports compliance status to management. The role works to set procedures under the guidance of the Operations Manager.
   

  

**ROLES ACCOUNTABILITIES:**
**Vetting**
* Upload inspection reports, findings, RCAs and CAPs to the RightShip portal and internal databases accurately and on time
* Follow up with ship staff and business units on corrective actions until all findings are closed
* Prepare, update and submit Q88, Baltic Questionnaire and other vetting questionnaires, and keep vessel certificate records current


**Ship Security**
* Assist in preparing and amending Ship Security Plans (SSPs), including collecting vessel data and updating GA Plans after flag or class changes
* Send standard security guidance to vessels entering high\-risk areas; track vessel reporting deadlines and send reminders
* Draft and send CSO messages and security circulars; keep the PMSC list up to date
* Support vessels preparing for ISPS audits, RightShip inspections and dry docks with documents and follow\-up
* Collect and map maritime security intelligence from threat feeds, advisories and incident reports; brief the desk on risks to fleet vessels and trading routes
* Manage day\-to\-day contact with ship staff, business units, CSOs, security providers and external authorities on security matters


**Reporting and Administration**
* Prepare regular reports and dashboards on inspection status, findings trends, Safety Score and security compliance
* Maintain files, databases and SOPs; track invoices for desk services; take part in process improvement and training
* Take on additional roles or desk processes, or move internally within Group Operations, as business needs require


**Requirements**
**KEY SKILLS AND CAPABILITIES:**
**Technical Skills**
* Working knowledge of the ISM and ISPS Codes, ship security plans and guidance for high\-risk areas
* Understanding of RightShip inspections, Q88 and vetting questionnaires, and the RCA and CAP process
* Maritime security intelligence mapping: tracking threats and incidents and relating them to fleet routes
* Use of AI tools and a sound understanding of data; MS Office 365 and Power BI or similar


**Professional Skills**
* Project management and project support: planning, tracking actions and reporting progress
* Good written and spoken English; clear, confident dealings with internal and external stakeholders
* Well organised and accurate; handles confidential documents securely and manages several deadlines at once


**PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:**
* Master's degree in International Business or International Relations
* Bachelor's degree in Maritime Studies, Political Science or Business Administration
* 1\-2 years in ship management support, vetting, maritime security or compliance. Freshers keen to learn may be considered
* Knowledge of RightShip procedures, Q88 or the ISPS Code preferred


**Benefits**
**About Anglo\-Eastern**
 Anglo\-Eastern is a global leader in independent ship management services. The Group manages over 700 vessels under full technical management, supports around 500 additional ships under crew management, and has overseen more than 1,000 newbuildings and conversions through its newbuilding supervision and project management divisions.
   

  

 Headquartered in Hong Kong, Anglo\-Eastern operates through a network of 30 offices across Asia, Europe, and the Americas, including wholly owned maritime training facilities. Our strength lies in our people: over 39,000 seafarers and 2,350 shore\-based employees who work together to support clients across ship types while building trust, driving performance, and shaping a better maritime future.
   

  

**Why join Anglo\-Eastern?**
* Join a globally respected company with a strong maritime heritage of over 50 years
* Work in an environment anchored in integrity, trust, and long\-term relationships
* Access continuous learning and structured career development across a truly global network
* Be part of a team committed to delivering excellence and shaping a better maritime future


 Join us today!

title: Senior Associate – Information Security & IT Infrastructure
description:
**Job Description: Senior Associate – Information Security \& IT Infrastructure** 




  





**Position Overview** 




 We are seeking a skilled Senior Associate – Information Security \& IT Infrastructure to manage and strengthen the organization’s information\-security posture, Google Workspace environment, endpoint infrastructure, and related IT operations.
 



 The role will be responsible for the planned migration from Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace, ongoing Google Workspace administration, endpoint management and security, security\-policy implementation, incident management, DLP, VAPT coordination, audit support, and infrastructure enhancement.
 



 The successful candidate must have hands\-on experience across information security, Google Workspace, endpoint management, endpoint protection, identity and access management, networking, and IT infrastructure operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace Migration** 



* Plan and execute the migration from Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace.
* Migrate email, calendars, contacts, files, shared drives, user accounts, groups, permissions, and other business data.
* Develop migration plans, user\-mapping structures, data\-validation processes, rollback procedures, and cutover schedules.
* Ensure data integrity, security, regulatory compliance, and minimal business disruption throughout the migration.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, implementation partners, and vendors during planning and execution.
* Provide post\-migration support, issue resolution, user training, and adoption assistance.
* Decommission or optimize existing Microsoft services after successful migration, subject to business requirements.



**2\. Google Workspace Administration and Security** 



* Administer and secure the complete Google Workspace environment.
* Configure and manage users, organizational units, groups, domains, shared drives, licences, roles, and administrative privileges.
* Manage Gmail, Google Drive, Calendar, Meet, Groups, Vault, and other relevant Google Workspace services.
* Implement authentication, Multi\-Factor Authentication, Single Sign\-On, access\-control, sharing, retention, and data\-protection policies.
* Configure Google Workspace security controls, alerting, investigation rules, email protection, and audit logging.
* Manage Google Vault for retention, eDiscovery, legal holds, and compliance requirements.
* Conduct periodic reviews of user access, privileged accounts, external sharing, inactive accounts, and security configurations.
* Troubleshoot Google Workspace administration, security, access, email\-delivery, and data\-sharing issues.
* Monitor service health and coordinate with Google or implementation partners for escalated cases.



**3\. Endpoint Management** 



* Manage the complete lifecycle of organizational endpoints, including laptops, desktops, and mobile devices.
* Enrol, configure, monitor, update, and decommission endpoints using appropriate endpoint\-management or MDM platforms.
* Implement device\-configuration policies, application deployment, patch management, software inventory, and compliance monitoring.
* Maintain accurate asset records, device ownership information, warranty details, and endpoint lifecycle documentation.
* Establish secure processes for employee onboarding, device allocation, role changes, offboarding, and data removal.
* Define and enforce policies for corporate devices and BYOD environments.
* Evaluate and implement endpoint\-management solutions aligned with the Google ecosystem and organizational requirements.



**4\. Endpoint Security** 



* Deploy, configure, and monitor endpoint detection and response, antivirus, anti\-malware, firewall, disk encryption, and device\-control solutions.
* Define endpoint\-security baselines for Windows, macOS, mobile devices, and other supported platforms.
* Monitor endpoint alerts and investigate suspicious activity, malware, compromised devices, and policy violations.
* Ensure operating systems, browsers, applications, and security tools remain patched and updated.
* Implement controls for removable media, local administration, browser security, application installation, and data transfer.
* Track endpoint compliance and remediate devices that do not meet organizational security standards.
* Evaluate endpoint\-security products, conduct proofs of concept, and recommend suitable solutions.
* Maintain appropriate integration between endpoint\-security tools, identity systems, DLP platforms, and security\-monitoring solutions.



**5\. Security Posture Verification and Enhancement** 



* Conduct periodic security\-posture assessments across users, endpoints, cloud platforms, applications, and IT infrastructure.
* Review existing security policies and recommend improvements based on identified risks and business use cases.
* Work closely with security partners and vendors to verify security configurations and implement enhancements.
* Track security observations, vulnerabilities, remediation actions, owners, and closure timelines.
* Develop and maintain information\-security policies, standards, procedures, and operational guidelines.
* Ensure security controls remain practical, scalable, and aligned with changing business requirements.



**6\. Identity and Access Management** 



* Manage identity, authentication, user provisioning, access rights, and privileged accounts across Google Workspace and other business applications.
* Implement and enforce MFA, role\-based access controls, least\-privilege principles, and secure administrative access.
* Conduct periodic user\-access and privileged\-access reviews.
* Ensure timely access provisioning, modification, and revocation during employee onboarding, transfers, and offboarding.
* Support the transition of identity and access controls from the Microsoft ecosystem to the Google ecosystem.
* Coordinate integrations between Google Workspace and third\-party identity or SSO platforms where required.



**7\. Data Loss Prevention** 



* Implement and manage DLP controls for email, cloud applications, web activity, and endpoints.
* Define policies for monitoring and protecting confidential, personal, financial, and business\-sensitive information.
* Evaluate full\-stack DLP and employee internet\-usage monitoring solutions.
* Conduct vendor evaluations and proofs of concept to identify suitable DLP technologies.
* Monitor DLP alerts, investigate violations, document findings, and coordinate remediation.
* Periodically review DLP rules to reduce false positives while maintaining effective protection.



**8\. Security Incident Management** 



* Monitor, investigate, document, and coordinate the resolution of information\-security incidents.
* Manage escalated security\-related calls and ensure timely containment, remediation, and closure.
* Perform initial incident analysis and coordinate with internal teams, vendors, and leadership where required.
* Maintain incident records, root\-cause analyses, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
* Support phishing investigations, compromised\-account response, endpoint isolation, malware response, and data\-leak investigations.
* Assist in developing and testing incident\-response procedures and escalation matrices.



**9\. VAPT and Vulnerability Management** 



* Coordinate Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing activities with internal stakeholders and external vendors.
* Finalize testing scope, access requirements, timelines, rules of engagement, and supporting documentation.
* Review findings, validate risks, assign remediation owners, and track observations through closure.
* Coordinate retesting and ensure timely submission of closure evidence.
* Maintain vulnerability registers and provide periodic management updates.
* Support continuous vulnerability identification and remediation across endpoints, networks, servers, cloud environments, and applications.



**10\. ISO 27001 and Audit Support** 



* Support ISO 27001 certification, surveillance audits, internal audits, and customer or regulatory assessments.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external auditors for scope, evidence, access, interviews, and closure requirements.
* Maintain relevant policies, procedures, risk registers, audit evidence, and control documentation.
* Track non\-conformities, observations, corrective actions, and improvement opportunities.
* Assist with risk assessments, control testing, compliance reviews, and management reporting.



**11\. IT Infrastructure and Network Support** 



* Support the setup, maintenance, security, and enhancement of office network, server, storage, internet, and related infrastructure.
* Monitor the availability, performance, capacity, and security of infrastructure components.
* Coordinate infrastructure upgrades, office migrations, and technology\-refresh initiatives.
* Work with vendors and service providers for procurement, implementation, maintenance, and escalated support.
* Maintain infrastructure diagrams, configuration records, inventories, credentials, licences, and operational documentation.
* Assist in ensuring backup availability, recovery readiness, business continuity, and infrastructure resilience.



**12\. Operational Escalations and Collaboration** 



* Manage escalated IT infrastructure and information\-security issues and coordinate their resolution.
* Collaborate with the IT team, business stakeholders, vendors, and management on technical and security matters.
* Support ongoing infrastructure improvements, security\-policy enhancements, and implementation of new solutions.
* Evaluate new technologies and recommend solutions that improve security, scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Prepare periodic reports covering security posture, endpoint compliance, incidents, vulnerabilities, audit actions, and migration progress.
* Create and maintain SOPs, troubleshooting guides, handover documents, and technical records.



**Required Skills and Experience** 



* Relevant experience in information security, IT infrastructure, endpoint administration, or a similar role.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Google Workspace administration and security.
* Demonstrated experience in Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace migrations.
* Strong knowledge of Gmail, Drive, Shared Drives, Google Vault, Google Admin Console, Google endpoint management, and Google Workspace security controls.
* Experience with endpoint\-management, MDM, EDR, antivirus, patch\-management, and device\-compliance platforms.
* Working knowledge of Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS endpoint administration.
* Experience with identity and access management, MFA, SSO, RBAC, and privileged\-access controls.
* Knowledge of DLP, incident response, vulnerability management, VAPT, and information\-security operations.
* Familiarity with ISO 27001 controls, audit coordination, risk management, and compliance documentation.
* Understanding of networking, firewalls, VPNs, servers, storage, backups, and cloud infrastructure.
* Experience conducting vendor evaluations, proofs of concept, tool implementations, and security reviews.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, coordination, and stakeholder\-management skills.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
* Google Workspace Administrator or Google Cloud certification – not mandatory
* Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, or Microsoft security experience will be beneficial for managing the transition.
* Experience working with security vendors, managed service providers, auditors, and distributed business teams.



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Structured problem\-solving and incident\-management abilities.
* Security\-first approach with practical business awareness.
* Ability to independently manage projects and operational responsibilities.
* Strong communication and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Attention to detail and disciplined documentation.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and escalations effectively.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and protecting organizational information.

title: AI Red Team Tester
description:
**About The Role**
 If you've ever looked at a system and immediately started thinking about how to break it — this role was made for you. We're looking for security\-minded professionals to stress\-test AI systems, expose their weaknesses, and help build the next generation of safe, reliable AI.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your findings directly shape how AI behaves in the real world.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design and execute red\-teaming exercises to uncover security weaknesses in AI systems
* Craft adversarial prompts and edge\-case scenarios to probe model guardrails and safety filters
* Evaluate AI outputs for unsafe behavior, bias, and policy violations
* Document vulnerabilities, exploits, and unexpected behaviors in clear, structured reports
* Collaborate with engineering teams to recommend practical mitigations and improvements
* Stay current on emerging AI security threats, jailbreak techniques, and adversarial research
* Help define and refine security evaluation rubrics and testing protocols


**Who You Are**
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity concepts — threat modeling, penetration testing, or ethical hacking
* Hands\-on experience with AI/ML systems, large language models, or prompt engineering
* Creative and analytical — you enjoy finding the edge cases others miss
* Excellent written communication and documentation skills
* Comfortable working independently in an asynchronous, task\-based environment
* Familiarity with open\-source AI platforms or LLM ecosystems is a plus
* Background in infosec, AI safety research, or adversarial ML is a bonus — but not required


**Why Join Us**
* Work at the cutting edge of AI security alongside top research labs
* See your work directly improve the safety of AI products used by millions of people
* Full autonomy and a flexible schedule — work when and how you work best
* Build deep, marketable expertise in one of the fastest\-growing fields in tech
* Ongoing contract potential with opportunities to expand scope and responsibility
* Be part of a global community of experts shaping the future of responsible AI

title: Offensive Security Analyst (Structured / Non-Exploit)
description:

 What if your ability to think like an adversary could directly shape how AI understands and reasons about cybersecurity threats? We're looking for Offensive Security Analysts to analyze real\-world attack paths, model adversary behavior, and help build the AI systems that will define the future of security.
   

  

 This role is focused on
 **structured adversarial reasoning** 
 — not exploit development. You'll bring your red team instincts and attack knowledge to a unique challenge: teaching AI how threats actually unfold, where defenses break down, and how risk cascades through modern environments.
   

  

 Fully remote, flexible hours, and meaningful work at the frontier of AI.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Analyze attack paths, kill chains, and adversary strategies across realistic, production\-like environments
* Identify weaknesses, misconfigurations, and defensive gaps in complex system architectures
* Review and evaluate red team scenarios, intrusion narratives, and threat models
* Generate, label, and validate adversarial reasoning data used to train and benchmark AI systems
* Articulate attack chains, impact assessments, and risk tradeoffs in clear, structured formats

* Background in cloud security, network architecture, or enterprise environments
* Prior work in security research, CTF competitions, or technical writing
* Exposure to AI tools or data labeling workflows


**Why Join Us**
* Work directly on frontier AI systems alongside the world's leading AI research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — structure your work around your life, not the other way around
* Freelance autonomy with the substance of meaningful, high\-impact projects
* Apply your offensive security expertise in a novel, intellectually engaging context
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Security Engineer
description:
**Security Engineer (VAPT and Remediation)** 




**Location:** 
 Pune (Hybrid)
 



**Experience:** 
 5\+ years
 



**Availability: 0\-15 days** 




  





 About the role
 



 This is a hands\-on security engineering role that owns the full cycle: find the vulnerability, prove it, fix it, and confirm it stays fixed. You will run penetration tests and security reviews across our applications and infrastructure, then remediate what you find, in application code or in configuration, whatever the fix requires.
 



  





 What you will do
 



 Security Analysis and Testing
 


* Plan and execute penetration tests on web applications, APIs, mobile apps (iOS and Android), thick clients, and supporting infrastructure.
* Review application and infrastructure security design: authentication and authorization, session handling, data flows, secrets management, network exposure, and cloud configuration.
* Find what scanners miss through manual testing: business logic flaws, chained vulnerabilities, and privilege escalation paths.
* Run and tune vulnerability scans across applications, hosts, and cloud accounts.
* Triage, deduplicate, and prioritize findings by exploitability and business impact alongside CVSS.
* Track remediation to closure and maintain an accurate view of open risk.
* Retest fixes and close findings only when the vulnerability is confirmed resolved.



 Remediation and patching
 


* Fix vulnerabilities directly in application code, in whatever language or framework the application uses.
* Fix infrastructure and configuration issues: web server and TLS settings, cloud IAM and network rules, container and Kubernetes configuration, infrastructure\-as\-code, and CI/CD pipeline hardening.
* Apply patches and upgrades to operating systems, frameworks, libraries, and third\-party components, and verify the exposure is closed.
* Where code or infrastructure is owned by another team, raise the change yourself as a pull request or configuration change and drive it to merge.



 Reporting and communication
 


* Write clear findings with reproduction steps, evidence, risk rating, and specific remediation guidance.
* Explain risk to developers, DevOps engineers, and non\-technical stakeholders, and agree on realistic remediation timelines.



 What you bring
 



 Experience
 


* 5\+ years in penetration testing, application security, or security engineering, with a track record of fixing the vulnerabilities you report.



 Deep VAPT expertise
 


* Web: manual testing with Burp Suite Professional; OWASP Top 10 and ASVS; injection, authentication and session flaws, access control (IDOR/BOLA), SSRF, deserialization, XXE, race conditions, and business logic abuse.
* API: REST, GraphQL, SOAP, and gRPC; OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT weaknesses; mass assignment, rate limiting, and object\-level authorization failures.
* Mobile (iOS and Android): static and dynamic analysis against OWASP MASVS/MASTG; Frida, Objection, MobSF, jadx, and Ghidra or Hopper; SSL pinning and root/jailbreak detection bypass; insecure storage, IPC, and deep link issues.
* Thick client: interception of non\-HTTP protocols, reverse engineering of .NET, Java, and native binaries, memory and local storage analysis, DLL hijacking, and client\-side trust issues.
* Infrastructure: network and host testing with Nmap, Nessus, and Metasploit; Active Directory fundamentals; Linux and Windows hardening.



 Remediation skills
 


* Able to read and modify code in multiple languages. Expect a mix that may include Java, C\#/.NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, PHP, Go, Swift, and Kotlin. Depth in at least two of these, and the ability to land a correct, tested fix in an unfamiliar codebase.
* Scripting in Python, Bash, or PowerShell to automate testing and remediation.
* Practical experience with Git\-based workflows, pull requests, and code review.
* Working knowledge of Nginx, Apache, IIS, TLS configuration, Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure\-as\-code such as Terraform or CloudFormation.



 Working knowledge (fundamentals level)
 


* Cloud security: IAM, networking, storage, logging, and encryption across AWS, Azure, and GCP; CIS benchmarks; CSPM and cloud audit tooling such as Prowler.
* Vulnerability assessment: enterprise scanners, CVSS, and patch management processes.
* SOC operations: SIEM concepts, log analysis, incident response fundamentals, and MITRE ATT\&CK; able to support incident triage with attacker\-perspective input and feed detection ideas back from test findings.



 Communication
 


* Clear written reports and the ability to explain risk and trade\-offs to engineers and business stakeholders.



 Nice to have
 


* Public security research, CVEs, bug bounty findings, or CTF experience.
* Experience integrating SAST, DAST, and SCA tooling such as Aikido into CI/CD pipelines.
* Threat modeling and secure design review experience.
* Familiarity with compliance evidence requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS) as they relate to vulnerability remediation.



 What success looks like
 


* Findings from your tests reach confirmed, retested fixes within agreed timelines.
* Development and DevOps teams see you as someone who fixes problems alongside them.
* Recurring vulnerability classes decline over time because fixes address root causes.
* Cloud misconfiguration and patch exposure windows stay short.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Ops Staff** is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Shipment Processing \& Operations*** Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.

**Data Entry \& Operational Documentation*** Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.

**Operational Support*** Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.

**Safety, Security \& Compliance*** Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.

* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.

* Protect company assets and customer property.

* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.

Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**

  


The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.

**Job Purpose:**

  


To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**

  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

**Qualifications \& Experience:**

  

**Education**:

* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**

  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance

**Key Performance Indicators:**

  

**KRAs**

 **KPIs**

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency

  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**

  


When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths**across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist & HR Generalist (Animal Shelter)
description:
**This position is NOT for everyone.**

Sarvoham is looking for a **Talent Acquisition Specialist \& HR Generalist** **who genuinely believes in compassion, animal welfare, animal rights, and responsible people relationships.**

This is **not a desk\-only role**. Our **People \& Culture** team must understand the realities of working in an animal shelter and be willing to step onto the ground whenever required pro\-actively.

**We are looking for someone who:**

● Is **vegan or open to transitioning to veganism**, and genuinely understands the ethical principles behind welfare of the animals.

● Genuinely cares about **all animals and all species**, not only dogs, and believes animals deserve **compassion, dignity, freedom from cruelty, and protection from exploitation**.

● Is willing to **actively advocate for animal rights and welfare**, both within and outside the organization.

● Is willing to be **hands\-on with shelter operations** and participate in or support activities such as **animal rescues, animal handling, bathing, feeding, walking, cleaning kennels, maintaining hygiene, enrichment, transportation, and basic shelter upkeep**.

● Is willing to work alongside **animal caretakers, rescuers, veterinarians, volunteers, and frontline teams**, and understands and respects the challenges they face.

● Can respond calmly and responsibly during **animal emergencies, rescue situations, difficult cases, injuries, conflicts, and other high\-pressure shelter situations**.

● Is willing to understand the complete animal\-care cycle, from **rescue and admission to treatment, rehabilitation, enrichment, adoption, foster care, and end\-of\-life care where necessary**.

● Believes employees working in animal welfare deserve **empathy, dignity, fairness, psychological safety, accountability, and strong leadership**, while being capable of holding people accountable without losing compassion and humanity.

● Is willing to **lead by example** rather than expect others to do work they are unwilling to do themselves.

● Understands that working for an animal welfare organization is fundamentally different from working in a conventional corporate environment.

**Please DO NOT apply if:**

* **You are not compassionate towards animals, care only about dogs, are unwilling to support ground\-level shelter operations, or are uncomfortable with cleaning, handling, feeding, walking, bathing, rescuing, or caring for animals when required.**
* **Please also do not apply if you believe Talent Acquisition Specialist \& HR Generalist should remain completely separate from shelter operations, are unwilling to stand up against animal cruelty and advocate for animal rights, or are looking only for a conventional corporate role.**
* At Sarvoham Animal Foundation, **Talent Acquisition Specialist \& HR Generalist** is not simply about Human Resources, Talent Acquisition and employee relations.
* It is about **building a culture around a shared purpose: creating a kinder world for animals while building an organization where the people serving that mission can thrive.**
* We would rather hire **one deeply aligned person who is willing to learn, get their hands dirty, stand up for animals, and lead with compassion** than someone with an impressive résumé who does not believe in our mission.
* **If this resonates with you, please read the complete JD carefully before applying.**
* **If it does not, we respectfully request that you do not apply.**

**Position**: Talent Acquisition Specialist \& HR Generalist

**Department:** Human Resources

**Location:** Bangalore, India (On\-site)

**Reporting To:** People \& Culture Manager

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Sarvoham is a charitable organization dedicated to the welfare of under\-privileged animals in Bangalore, India. Sarvoham was established in April 2017 by co\-founders Haris Ali \& Madhusmita Sahu with a vision to create an inclusive eco\-system that co\-exists with animals providing them a respectable life that contributes to the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) frameworks and Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs’) for the planet.

Over the past 9 years, Sarvoham has grown from a small charity effort to a well\-established animal welfare organization. We have rescued more than 3500 street animals, and provide a shelter for more than 200 dogs.

Sarvoham means the harmony between all elements of nature, both human and non\-human, and the organization is guided by the spirit of harmonious coexistence.

**ROLE PURPOSE:**

Sarvoham stands at a defining moment in its journey to create a more compassionate world for animals and seeks to expand its impact by building a sustainable ecosystem of partnerships and philanthropy that will enable many more lives to be saved and transformed.

We are looking for compassionate and organized freshers who are passionate about people practices while ensuring that our culture remains aligned with our mission and values. This is a pivotal role responsible for building the organization's all\-round people practices that translate into an ecosystem of partnerships, influence, and trust. This role requires an incumbent who can balance empathy with high levels of ownership and accountability through excellence in employee experience and wellbeing that is sustainable in the long\-term while also addressing the required evolution.

**WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS:**

* **Building Sarvoham as a purpose driven employer of choice for Talent:** Sarvoham has built a reliable and credible rescue and rehabilitation model since 2017\. The Foundation is looking for an experienced member as the Talent Acquisition Specialist \& HR Generalist to attract, engage, build sustainable and meaningful relationships with individuals who resonate with the Foundation’s purpose to build a society that provides a ‘respectable’ life to all animal species.
* **Build a Talent community with a Stewardship mindset:** Working closely with the CEO, Board, leadership team and civil society organizations, the incumbent will cultivate meaningful relationships that generate talent in the form of full\-time employees and volunteers who inspire collective action and expand the Foundation's impact across India.
* **Design the People, Culture and Talent Community:** Work closely with the leadership team at Sarvoham to design, implement and lead the talent attraction and retention strategy at Sarvoham that can attract desired talent across technical and functional requirements with a sense of purpose and commitment to contribute positively to perpetuity of Sarvoham's veterinary and sanctuary missions.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**End to End Talent Acquisition (50%):** Spearhead end to end talent acquisition across roles for the foundation including but not limited to:

Veterinary professionals, Animal caregivers, Shelter and sanctuary staff, Field rescue teams, Fundraising professionals, Communications and Marketing roles, Finance, Human Resources and Administration in addition to Leadership and Specialist positions

***Responsibilities:***

* Partner with the leadership team at Sarvoham to project manpower requirements.
* Design job descriptions and recruitment campaigns.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, social media, referrals, universities and professional networks.
* Build available talent pipelines that align with the vision, mission and purpose of Sarvoham for critical positions.
* Screen resumes and conduct competency and skills assessments including initial interviews.
* Conduct reference and background checks for shortlisted candidates.
* Own the candidate engagement and communication engagement throughout the recruitment process.
* Prepare letters of intent, letters post compensation and fitment assessment within approved guidelines.
* Ensure an exceptional candidate experience from recruitment and onboarding to across the employee life\-cycle.

**HR Generalist (50%):** Partner with the leadership team at Sarvoham to support the employee life\-cycle including but not limited to the following:

***Responsibilities:***

* Coordinate pre\-joining formalities, conduct induction programmes, facilitate new employee orientation and ensure smooth integration into teams.
* Maintain employee records, support HRIS updates, coordinate probation to confirmations, maintain HR dashboards and reports.
* Organise meaningful employee engagement initiatives including learning and development.
* Performance Management aligned with policies.
* Support wellness and recognition programmes.
* Support implementation of HR policies and compliance with regulations.
* Address employee queries and grievances, initiating corrective and disciplinary measures as required.
* Partner on Strategic Projects at Sarvoham including volunteering for animal welfare activities and programs.

**SUCCESS MEASURES:**

**Community Engagement \& Social Impact:**

Build partnerships with agencies and groups for building a network of veterinarians’ , NGOs, and volunteers that empower communities to become active participants in animal welfare, environmental sustainability, and community resilience.

**Candidate \& Employee NPS:**

Build credibility for Sarvoham as an employer of choice with a vision that resonates and attracts employee acquisition, sustainable retention and development to become active participants in animal welfare, environmental sustainability, and community resilience.

**Candidate \& Employee Experience:**

Build credibility for Sarvoham as an employer of choice with a vision that resonates and attracts employee acquisition, sustainable retention and development to become active participants in animal welfare, environmental sustainability, and community resilience.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE:**

The ideal candidate is a purpose\-driven individual who combines strategic thinking with a blend of compassion, influence, and execution, engaging prospective employees and communities, while inspiring internal teams around a shared purpose.

* **Work Experience:** 0\-2 years of progressive experience in talent acquisition and employee life\-cycle management. Freshers are encouraged to apply.
* **Proven Track Record:** of fulfillment and employee satisfaction.
* **Operational Skills:** Proven ability to recruit and design, people thinking policies and processes with psychometric assessments, assignments and data\-driven management.

**PREFERRED BACKGROUNDS:**

* Understands brand building.
* Ability to become a preferred partner for candidates and employees.
* 0–2 years of HR experience.
* Experience in NGOs, healthcare, veterinary services, social impact organizations as a volunteer or employee.
* Practices and promotes a life\-style that is animal friendly.

**WHY JOIN SARVOHAM:**

We are on a mission to establish equity, inclusion, and compassion for animals in society, so that they can lead a fulfilling and respectable life. We are looking for a clinician who resonates with this mission and believes that their experience, skills, and judgment can genuinely change outcomes for the animals who need it most — leading by example, and helping build a people practice that will sustain for generations to come.

Pay: Up to ₹400,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Bengaluru, Karnataka 560076: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Application Question(s):

* At Sarvoham we do not encourage the use of AI for any communication. Please confirm that you have not used AI or paraphrasing tools. We only consider authentic responses to these questions.
* Have you ever personally rescued or helped an injured, abandoned, or distressed animal? Please describe.
* Are you comfortable working in an environment with rescued animals, including those that are sick, injured, disabled, or terminally ill? Please explain.
* When would you be available to join Sarvoham if selected?
* Do you currently follow a vegetarian or vegan lifestyle? If no, are you willing to transition?
* Are you willing to actively advocate for veganism as part of Sarvoham's mission?
* How do you believe you can contribute to Sarvoham? Please be specific in reference to your skills.
* Briefly describe your experience managing the complete People \& Culture function for an organization.
* As a People \& Culture manager, would you hire a candidate who consumes meat as a personal choice for an animal\-welfare organization? Please explain
* What do you know about Sarvoham? Why do you want to work for an animal welfare organization like Sarvoham? Please share in your own words.

entry level position who can provide support to the sourcing function. Collects suppliers’ quotations and examines bids. Identifies and selects suppliers that meet the organization’s standards of price, quality, and delivery.

To understand the Customers product requirements and source non\-catalog products from Market Source suppliers for customers based on product codes, descriptions and applications required.

* Use product knowledge, to find new cross\-references based on provided data (competitor information, descriptions, manufacturer part numbers)
* Review and validate cross\-references provided by the system
