description:
**COMPLIANCE EXECUTIVE – PMS**

Location: Satellite, Ahmedabad

Qualification: Qualified Company Secretary (CS)

Experience: Fresher / 0–1 year

**ABOUT THE ROLE** 

We are looking for a qualified Company Secretary (CS) fresher to join our Compliance team as a Compliance Executive – PMS . The role will primarily focus on regulatory and compliance activities relating to our SEBI\-registered Portfolio Management Services (PMS) business . The candidate will work closely under the Compliance Officer and will receive hands\-on exposure to SEBI regulations, regulatory filings, audits, internal controls and the day\-to\-day compliance framework of an investment management business. While compliance will be the primary responsibility , the role will also work closely with the Operations and Accounts teams. In a PMS, regulatory compliance is closely connected with transactions, client accounts, reconciliations, reporting and financial records. The candidate will therefore be expected to understand and support these functions wherever required to ensure that compliance data, reporting and outcomes are accurate, complete and timely .

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1\. PMS \& Regulatory Compliance** 

● Assist the Compliance Officer in ensuring compliance with applicable SEBI Portfolio Managers Regulations, circulars, guidelines and other regulatory requirements . ● Track regulatory requirements, compliance calendars, filing dates and internal deadlines. ● Assist in preparing and submitting periodic regulatory filings, reports and disclosures. ● Monitor SEBI circulars and regulatory developments and assist in identifying their applicability to the firm. ● Maintain appropriate supporting records and documentation for regulatory compliance. ● Assist in implementation and monitoring of internal compliance policies, processes and controls.

**2\. Compliance Monitoring \& Documentation** 

● Maintain compliance trackers, registers, checklists and supporting documentation. ● Perform periodic checks to ensure prescribed processes and internal controls are being followed. ● Assist in reviewing client documentation, agreements, disclosures and other compliance\-related records. ● Follow up with relevant teams for information and documents required for compliance. ● Ensure regulatory and compliance records are properly maintained and readily retrievable.

**3\. Audit \& Regulatory Support** 

● Assist with internal audits, statutory audits, compliance audits and regulatory inspections . ● Compile and cross\-check information required by auditors, regulators and other external agencies. ● Coordinate internally to obtain supporting documents and ensure timely closure of audit observations. ● Maintain proper records of audit queries, responses, observations and corrective actions.

**4\. Operations \& Accounting Coordination**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

Position: Senior Accounts Executive

CA Location: Ahmedabad

Employment Type: Full\-time

Reports to: Group Head Accountant

ROLE SUMMARY

We are looking for a Chartered Accountant to join our Accounts team and work closely with the Group Head Accountant across accounting, taxation, financial reporting and MIS for the Capital 8 Group. As a Portfolio Management Services (PMS) business, the role will also include selected PMS operational responsibilities that are closely connected with accounts, reconciliations and financial reporting. The candidate will be trained on these processes as part of the role. This is a hands\-on role suited to a CA who is quick, accurate, detail\-oriented and takes pride in producing complete and correct work on time.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1\. Accounts \& Finance** 

● Support the Group Head Accountant in maintaining complete and accurate books of accounts across group entities. ● Accounting and review of entries in Tally , including ledgers, journals, expenses, income, investments and banking transactions. ● Prepare and review bank, ledger and other financial reconciliations . ● Assist with monthly, quarterly and annual closing of accounts. ● Support preparation of financial statements, schedules and MIS reports . ● Handle and review GST, TDS and other applicable tax compliances , including calculations, reconciliations and filings. ● Assist in preparation of data, workings and documentation for statutory audit, tax audit and other audits . ● Coordinate with auditors, consultants, banks and other external parties as required. ● Maintain proper supporting documents, workings and accounting records so that books remain complete and audit\-ready . ● Prepare and review Excel\-based workings, reconciliations and management reports. ● Identify accounting discrepancies, missing information or incorrect entries and proactively work towards resolving them. ● Support the Group Head Accountant across other accounting, finance and treasury responsibilities as required.

**2\*.** PMS Operations \& Reconciliation\*

As part of the Accounts team, the candidate will also support operational processes of our Portfolio Management Services (PMS) business that directly interact with accounting and financial reporting. ● Learn and understand the basic trade lifecycle — execution, settlement, custody, banking, accounting and reporting . ● Assist with day\-to\-day PMS operational processes and related accounting entries. ● Reconcile data between internal records, bank accounts, custodian records and Fund Accountant/PMS reports. ● Cross\-check transactions, holdings, cash balances, fees and other financial data across different systems and records. ● Support trade settlement, reconciliation and other operational processes as assigned. ● Carefully verify operational data before it flows into accounting and investor reporting. ● Coordinate with Accounts, Operations and other internal teams to resolve differences or missing information. ● Understand how errors in transactions or operations can flow into accounts, reporting and compliance , and ensure operational work is handled with the same care and accuracy as accounting work. No prior PMS experience is required. The candidate will learn these processes on the job and develop an understanding of how PMS Operations and Accounts work together.

**REQUIRED SKILLS \& ATTRIBUTES**

● Chartered Accountant (CA) — freshers are welcome. ● Strong understanding of accounting fundamentals, taxation, GST and TDS. ● Strong Excel skills and familiarity with Tally or similar accounting software. ● Strong numerical ability and attention to detail. ● Ability and willingness to cross\-check and independently verify numbers , rather than relying entirely on system outputs. ● Quick learner, comfortable learning PMS accounting and operational processes on the job. ● Good written and verbal communication skills.

**WHAT WE LOOK FOR You will do well in this role if you:**

● Like your numbers to tally perfectly and take pride in accurate, complete work. ● Notice when something doesn't look right and investigate it rather than letting it pass. ● Are organised, disciplined and take deadlines seriously. ● Prefer completing work correctly the first time rather than fixing errors later. ● Take ownership of your work and are comfortable being accountable for its accuracy and completeness. ● Keep your workings, files and supporting documents organised and audit\-ready. ● Enjoy working in a high\-accountability, high\-productivity environment . ● Want to learn, grow and gradually take on greater independent responsibility across Group Accounts and PMS processes.

title: Technical Trainer
description:
Job Description: **Robotics Trainner**

**Job post summary**

**Location:** Bangalore (In\-person)  
**Office Base:** Banashankari, Bangalore  
**Travel Requirement:** Travel to partner schools across Bangalore

**Job Type:** Full\-time, Permanent  
**Schedule:** Day Shift (Monday to Saturday)

**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹30,000 per month (based on experience)  
*(Freshers may start from ₹12,000 – ₹18,000 with training provided)*

**About the Role**

We are looking for passionate and enthusiastic **Robotics, AI \& STEM Trainers / STEM Teachers** to deliver engaging, hands\-on learning experiences for school students from **Grades 1 to 10**.

The role involves teaching and facilitating practical learning across **Robotics, Electronics, Coding, Artificial Intelligence, Python, AI\-assisted/vibe coding, 3D Printing, and emerging technologies**.

The trainer will travel to different partner schools across Bangalore to conduct STEM sessions, implement curriculum, guide student projects, and create an engaging environment where students can learn by building and experimenting.

**Key Responsibilities**  
1\. STEM Curriculum Development \& Delivery

* Design and deliver structured STEM lessons covering Robotics, Electronics, Coding, AI, and emerging technologies.
* Customize teaching methods according to different age groups and skill levels.
* Conduct practical and activity\-based sessions that encourage students to learn through experimentation.
* Integrate multiple technologies into project\-based learning activities.

2\. Robotics \& Electronics

* Conduct hands\-on training using robotics kits, Arduino, sensors, motors, and basic electronic components.
* Teach students fundamental concepts of circuits, sensors, automation, and robotics.
* Guide students in building and programming simple robotic systems.
* Assist students in troubleshooting hardware, wiring, and robotics\-kit issues.

3\. Coding \& Python

* Teach beginner\-friendly programming concepts using **block\-based coding and Python**.
* Introduce students to programming fundamentals such as variables, conditions, loops, functions, and basic logic.
* Help students develop small applications, games, automation projects, and robotics programs.
* Introduce age\-appropriate computational thinking and problem\-solving concepts.

4\. Artificial Intelligence \& Generative AI

* Introduce students to the **fundamental concepts of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning** in a simple and age\-appropriate manner.
* Explain concepts such as AI, data, models, computer vision, natural language processing, and generative AI at a basic level.
* Conduct beginner\-friendly AI activities and projects.
* Introduce students to responsible and ethical use of AI.
* Demonstrate how AI tools can be used for learning, creativity, research, and problem\-solving.

5\. AI\-Assisted / Vibe Coding

* Introduce students to **AI\-assisted coding and beginner\-level “vibe coding” concepts**.
* Teach students how to describe an idea clearly and use AI coding assistants to help create simple applications and prototypes.
* Help students understand, test, modify, and debug AI\-generated code rather than simply copying it.
* Encourage students to combine creativity, problem\-solving, and programming to build small functional projects.

6\. 3D Printing \& Digital Fabrication

* Introduce students to the basics of **3D printing and digital fabrication**.
* Explain the basic workflow from idea → 3D design → slicing → printing.
* Guide students through simple 3D design/CAD activities.
* Demonstrate basic 3D\-printer operation, material handling, and print troubleshooting.
* Help students create simple physical prototypes and STEM models.

7\. Project\-Based Learning

* Guide students through practical projects combining robotics, coding, AI, electronics, and 3D printing.
* Encourage students to identify real\-world problems and develop technology\-based solutions.
* Support students in building prototypes and demonstrating their projects.
* Encourage creativity, experimentation, teamwork, and innovation.

8\. Classroom Instruction \& Student Engagement

* Conduct interactive and engaging sessions for students from Grades 1–10\.
* Create a positive classroom environment that encourages curiosity and experimentation.
* Explain technical concepts in a simple and student\-friendly manner.
* Manage classrooms effectively while maintaining a hands\-on learning environment.

9\. Student Assessment \& Feedback

* Monitor student progress and maintain performance records.
* Evaluate student understanding through activities, projects, and practical assessments.
* Provide constructive feedback to help students improve their technical and problem\-solving skills.
* Identify students who require additional guidance and support.

10\. Technical Support \& Troubleshooting

* Assist students in troubleshooting robotics kits, electronics, programming, AI tools, and 3D\-printing activities.
* Diagnose basic hardware and software issues during classroom sessions.
* Ensure STEM equipment and kits are properly maintained and ready for use.

11\. Mentorship

* Inspire students to explore Robotics, AI, Coding, Electronics, and other STEM fields.
* Encourage critical thinking, creativity, problem\-solving, and independent learning.
* Help students develop confidence in building and experimenting with technology.

12\. Collaboration \& Coordination

* Work closely with school teachers, administrators, and internal academic teams.
* Coordinate schedules and ensure smooth execution of STEM sessions across multiple schools.
* Maintain effective communication with school staff regarding student activities and requirements.

13\. Professional Development

* Stay updated with developments in Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, Python, coding, 3D printing, and STEM education.
* Continuously explore new educational technologies, AI tools, project ideas, and teaching methodologies.
* Participate in internal training and upskilling programs.

Qualifications

**Education:** Diploma / BSc / BE / B.Ed / M.Sc / M.Tech in Electronics, Computer Science, Physics, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields.

Candidates from other technical or STEM backgrounds with relevant practical skills may also be considered.

Experience

* Freshers are welcome; structured training will be provided.
* 1–2 years of experience in Robotics, STEM education, coding, AI education, or related areas is preferred.
* Experience working with school students or conducting workshops is an advantage.

**Required Skills**

* Basic knowledge of **Robotics and Electronics**.
* Basic programming knowledge in **Arduino, Python, or Block\-based Coding**.
* Basic understanding of **Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI concepts**.
* Familiarity with **AI\-assisted coding / vibe coding** is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of **3D printing and digital fabrication** is an advantage.
* Strong communication and classroom\-management skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and engaging manner.
* Ability to engage and motivate students.
* Good organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Passion for STEM education, technology, and teaching.
* Willingness to travel to partner schools across Bangalore.

**Additional Benefits**

* Structured training and upskilling programs for freshers.
* Exposure to Robotics, AI, Python, 3D Printing, and emerging technologies.
* Opportunity to work with reputed schools across Bangalore.
* Hands\-on experience delivering technology education to school students.
* Opportunity to develop expertise across multiple areas of STEM education.
* Strong career growth opportunities in the **EdTech, Robotics, AI, and STEM education sectors**.

 Delta Exchange India is one of India's leading crypto derivatives platforms, offering INR\-settled futures and options on Bitcoin, Ethereum and other major cryptocurrencies on an FIU\-registered platform. **About the Role:** 




 We're looking for a
 **Community Manager – Algo Business** 
 to build one of the most trusted crypto algo trading communities.
 



 India's algo traders are scattered across Telegram groups, Discord servers and Twitter threads. We want Delta to be where that community actually lives — where a beginner deploys their first bot and an experienced quant compares notes on execution.
 



 This role is for someone who genuinely loves talking to algo traders. You'll spend your days in conversation with users — in Online forums, on calls, at meetups — and turn what you learn into content, events and product feedback. Success isn't measured in follower counts, but in how many traders are actively building and deploying on Delta.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Own our community across Online Community forums — structure, rituals, moderation, day\-to\-day engagement.
* Be the first responder: answer questions, unblock traders, escalate bugs, make sure no API question goes unanswered.
* Identify and nurture power users and strategy builders; run ambassador and early\-access programmes.
* Plan and execute offline meetups, hackathons and strategy competitions across Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR and other hubs — plus online AMAs, workshops and guest sessions.
* Create content that lowers the barrier to algo trading: getting\-started guides, API tutorials, strategy walkthroughs, backtesting explainers.
* Keep documentation, sample code and cookbooks genuinely useful — you should be able to write and test a basic strategy yourself.
* Capture community pain points and translate them into structured, prioritised product feedback.
* Track what's brewing globally — agentic tooling, AI copilots, no\-code automation — and bring it back to our users and our roadmap.
* Define and track community metrics: active builders, deployed strategies, resolution time, new\-trader retention.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 1–3 years in community management, developer relations, growth, content or a trader\-facing role. Exceptional candidates with less formal experience but deep algo credibility will be considered.
* **A real understanding of algo trading** 
 — you know what a backtest is, why slippage matters, what a webhook does. You don't need to be a quant, but you can't be faking it in front of one.
* **You genuinely enjoy talking to traders.** 
 This role involves hundreds of conversations a month.
* Awareness of the algo landscape in India and globally — the tools, the communities, the interesting builders, where it's heading.
* Strong written communication: a clear tutorial, a crisp announcement, well\-structured product feedback.
* Comfort with technical material — API docs, sample code, explaining a strategy to a beginner.
* Self\-starter with strong ownership, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to travel for events.



  





**Good to Have:** 



* Hands\-on experience building, backtesting or running your own strategies or bots.

+ Secure Boot

+ Secure Firmware Loading
+ Secure Debug Access
+ Secure Key Provisioning
+ Anti\-Tamper Mechanisms

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
In today's world, where data spreads across various clouds and devices, traditional security measures aren't enough. Businesses need a dynamic approach to defend against constant cyber threats and ensure agile data security. Fortanix leads the way in data\-centric cybersecurity for hybrid multicloud environments, using advanced cryptography, encryption, and confidential AI solutions.
   

  

 As data breaches become more frequent and traditional defenses fall short, we focus on data exposure management to keep your information safe. Our unified data security platform addresses vulnerabilities in hybrid multicloud environments, defends against threats, and makes it easier to discover, assess, and fix data exposure risks. Whether implementing a Zero Trust model or preparing for the post\-quantum computing era, we help businesses worldwide protect their most sensitive data, wherever it is.
   

  

 Our commitment to solving the world's toughest data security challenges has earned Fortanix multiple Cybersecurity Excellence and Innovation Awards, as well as recognition from industry giants such as NVIDIA, Microsoft, Intel, ServiceNow, and Snowflake.
   

  

 Our team includes industry leaders and cryptography experts, creating a culture of trust, innovation and collaboration where every voice is valued. Recognized as a Great Place to Work, we're looking for passionate individuals to help us shape the future of data security and work towards a safer digital future.
   

  

 Fortanix helps enterprises protect their most sensitive data and AI models while they're in use, not just at rest or in transit. Our Confidential AI platform let customers run models and workloads inside hardware\-backed trusted execution environments, release keys only to attested workloads, and prove to auditors that nobody, including the cloud provider, could see their data.
   

  

 Enterprises and frontier model providers each bring their own architecture and security requirements, and fitting our platform to those needs is where the real engineering happens. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll close that gap. You'll embed with customers and partners, design and develop solutions and integrations, debug problems from firmware to Kubernetes, and bring what you learn back into the product and the open\-source community.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on engineering role. You'll design the architecture with the customer, then write the code, ship the fixes, and own the outcome.
   

  

 In this role, you will:
   

  

* Design and develop customer solutions. Understand each enterprise or frontier model provider's AI and security architecture, then design and build how Fortanix Confidential AI platform fit into it, from reference architecture through working integration.
* Build integrations. Develop the connectors and workload tooling that tie our platform into customers' existing stacks, and orchestration systems.
* Architect the trust model. Design attestation and key\-release flows for each customer's workloads, covering composite attestation, and how keys and models are protected end to end.
* Build proofs of concept that prove value. Scope and develop POCs with clear success criteria and propose designs that meets enterprise objectives.
* Shape the product. Turn what you learn in the field into RFCs, feature designs, and product requirements, and work with core product and engineering to land them.
* Contribute upstream. Participate in the open\-source community through code, reviews, and RFCs.
* Create reusable assets. Turn one\-off solutions into reference architectures, sample workloads, and design patterns that the next customer and the wider team can build on.


**Requirements**
* 4\-7 years of hands\-on experience in systems, infrastructure, platform, or security engineering, with meaningful time spent in customer\-facing roles.
* Strong Linux systems skills: kernel boot, systemd, storage and filesystems, networking, PCIe devices.
* Working experience with OpenShift, Kubernetes, Slurm is preferred.
* Proficiency in at least one of Rust, Go, or Python. You're comfortable reading an unfamiliar codebase and making a targeted change.
* Familiarity with cryptography and PKI: certificates, key formats, TLS, signing, and key management concepts.
* Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain attestation to a CISO in one meeting and debug a TDX quote failure with their platform team in the next.
* The ability to work independently, set expectations, and escalate early


 You'll work at the frontier where AI meets hardware security, on problems that very few engineers in the world have solved. Your work will directly decide whether the largest enterprises and AI providers can trust their most sensitive models and data to run anywhere.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Hybrid Work Model
* 12 Annual Leaves \& 12 Casual/Sick Leaves
* 8 Public Holidays \+ 2 Floating Holiday
* Comprehensive Medical and Dental Insurance Coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
* Group Life Insurance
* Personal Accident Insurance
* Internet Reimbursement
* Employee Stock Options
* Onsite Snacks, Lunches, and Dinners Provided
* Quarterly Beer Bashes \& Year\-End Celebrations

Our goal is to recruit the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other status. If you're interested in working in a fast\-growing, exciting working environment \- we encourage you to apply !*

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**Full Stack Developer** 





 📍 Kakkanad, Kochi \| Full\-time \| Onsite
 




**Experience: 0–3 years** 




  






 Samosa Interactive is looking for a
 
**Full Stack Developer** 

 to join our engineering team in Kochi.
 





 We are a young product and technology company building software across logistics, retail operations, food\-tech, gamification and interactive digital experiences.
 





 This is not a role where you will spend months working on one small module.
 





 You could be working on a fleet operations platform one week, improving a self\-ordering kiosk experience the next, or building features for a completely new product after that. We work on both our own products and real client deployments, so the things you build will actually be used by businesses and their customers.
 





 Candidates returning to work after a career break are also welcome to apply. If a startup environment excites you and you want to get back into a hands\-on, real\-world building environment, we’d be happy to hear from you.
 




  




**What you'll work on** 
   
 

 You will be involved across the product development cycle, including:
 





 • Building responsive web applications using React.js / Next.js
 





 • Developing backend services and APIs using Node.js / Express.js
 





 • Working with databases such as MySQL, and Postgres
 





 • Integrating frontend applications with APIs and third\-party services
 





 • Building authentication, role\-based access and business workflows
 





 • App development for Android, iOS, and Web using React Native with Expo
 





 • Frontend development using Tailwind CSS framework
 





 • Working with payment, notification and other external integrations when required
 





 • Debugging production issues and improving application performance
 





 • Collaborating closely with design, product and the rest of the engineering team
 





 • Taking features from requirement to development, testing and deployment
 





 • Contributing to technical discussions and suggesting better ways to build things
 




  




**What we're looking for** 
   
 

 We care more about your ability to
 
**build, learn and take ownership** 

 than the number of technologies listed on your resume.
 





 You should have:
 





 • Strong fundamentals in JavaScript / TypeScript
 





 • Good working knowledge of React.js
 





 • Experience with Next.js and Tailwind CSS are preferred
 





 • Working knowledge of Node.js and Express.js
 





 • Experience working with REST APIs
 





 • Understanding of databases, preferably Postgres
 





 • Good understanding of Git and collaborative development workflows like Merge, Rebase, Pull Requests, Merge conflict resolution etc.
 





 • Ability to understand an existing codebase and work independently on assigned features
 





 • A practical approach to debugging and problem\-solving
 





 • Willingness to learn technologies outside your current comfort zone
 




  




**Experience** 
   
 

 We are looking for candidates with
 
**0–3 years of experience** 

 .
 





 Freshers with strong fundamentals and solid personal, academic or freelance projects are welcome to apply.
 





 For us, what you have actually built matters more than simply having a certain number of years on your resume.
 




  




**We'd especially like to talk if** 
   
 

 • You have built and deployed projects beyond tutorials
 





 • You have handled both frontend and backend development
 





 • You enjoy figuring things out instead of waiting for detailed instructions for every step
 





 • You care about the actual user experience, not just whether the code works
 





 • You are comfortable working in a small team where your contribution is visible
 





 • You want exposure to building multiple real\-world products from the ground up
 




  




**What this role is not** 
   
 

 This is probably not the right role if you are looking for a highly structured environment where every requirement is already documented and every technical decision has already been made.
 





 We are still building Samosa Interactive, which means priorities can move, products evolve and engineers are expected to think along with us.
 





 At the same time, you will get the opportunity to work closely with the people making the product and business decisions, and see your work move from an idea to something being used in the real world.
 




  




**Location** 
   
 

 This is an
 
**onsite role from our Kakkanad, Kochi office** 

 .
 




  




**Interview process** 
   
 

 The process will include:
 



1. A conversational discussion to understand you, the work you have done and how you approach problems
2. A detailed technical discussion around your fundamentals, projects and development approach




 We are not interested in making candidates go through five rounds of interviews or solving random algorithm puzzles that have nothing to do with the job.
 




  




**Interested?** 
   
 

 Apply through LinkedIn with your resume and, if available, links to your
 
**GitHub, portfolio or projects you have actually built** 

 .
 





 If your resume only tells us the technologies you know, show us something you have built. That will always tell us more.
 




  





**Samosa Interactive Private Limited** 





 Kakkanad, Kochi

title: UAV Designer — Modelling, Simulation & Autopilot
description:
**Company Description** 
 SkyVector Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a fast\-growing company based in Hyderabad, India, specializing in Advanced Electronics, Aerospace, Defence, and Electronic Warfare systems. The organization delivers cutting\-edge solutions for defence and aerospace programs, combining deep engineering expertise with a strong culture of innovation. Teams at SkyVector work on indigenous product development across embedded systems, firmware, PCB design, and mission\-critical electronic systems. The company is driven by precision, quality, and a passion for solving complex engineering challenges, and is actively expanding its engineering workforce. Applicants will join a collaborative environment focused on building technology that has real\-world impact.
 



  





**Role Description:** 




**UAV Designer — Modelling, Simulation \& Autopilot** 




 Hyderabad, Telangana \| Fixed\-Wing UAV Program \| Full\-Time \| Defence, Aerospace \& EW Electronics
 



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work on real, mission\-critical hardware for defence and aerospace platforms — not simulations or academic exercises
* Direct exposure to founders on every major design call — this is not a siloed role several layers removed from decisions
* A genuine hand in a defence\-relevant program from an early stage, including the IP and documentation that comes out of it
* We're a fast\-growing company — compensation grows quickly with demonstrated performance, not just tenure



  





**Compensation** 




 As a startup, we're not able to match big\-company salaries right now — but we're growing fast, and early team members get real ownership over what they build, faster growth in responsibility, and compensation that scales quickly with performance rather than waiting on annual cycles.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on
 **flight\-dynamics and autopilot role** 
 , not a general software or coding role. You should be someone who has actually built
 **6\-DOF dynamics models** 
 and worked on
 **real autopilot/GNC logic** 




 — not just studied aerodynamics or written general\-purpose code.
 **If your background is in software development, computer science, or IT with no UAV, aircraft, or flight\-dynamics project work, please do not apply.** 
 This posting is exclusively for candidates with an Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering background and real UAV/aircraft\-relevant project experience.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We're after someone who can sit across modelling \& simulation, autopilot/GNC, and the aerodynamics\-and\-structures side of a fixed\-wing airframe — not necessarily expert in all three on day one, but able to move between them without needing a translator. You'll build and maintain the 6\-DOF dynamics model, help shape the autopilot logic that flies on it, and weigh in on airframe decisions (wing loading, control surface sizing, launch loads) that the model and the autopilot both depend on getting right.
 



  





**Minimum Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering or Mechanical Engineering — aerospace is the closer fit, but a mechanical background with real aircraft or UAV project work is welcome (CGPA 7\.5\+ or equivalent — applications below this will not be considered)
* 2–5 years working on UAV or aircraft flight dynamics, autopilot/GNC, or aerodynamics — industry, a research lab, or a genuinely serious student UAV/rocketry project all count



  





**What You'll Be Doing** 



* Building and maintaining 6\-DOF flight dynamics models and using them to drive hardware/software\-in\-the\-loop (HIL/SIL) testing before anything goes near a real airframe
* Working on autopilot and guidance logic — L1/NLGL\-style guidance, PID and lead\-compensator loops, EKF\-based state estimation — and tuning it against both simulation and flight\-test data
* Running aerodynamic analysis (stability derivatives, trim, control\-surface sizing) so the airframe can actually fly the mission it's meant to
* Sanity\-checking structural and launch\-load questions — canister\-launch acceleration, wing\-fold mechanisms, airframe weight budget
* Setting up sensor simulation (IMU, GNSS, baro, compass) for OBC\-in\-the\-loop testing of the flight controller
* Debugging the gap between "works in simulation" and "works on the bench"
* Writing up trajectory, launch\-angle, and performance analysis clearly for the team and future reviewers



  





**You Must Have Real Comfort With** 



* Flight dynamics modelling (MATLAB/Simulink, Python, or equivalent) — able to build a 6\-DOF model from equations of motion, not just run someone else's
* Autopilot fundamentals: guidance laws, PID/compensator tuning, and at least a conceptual grip on state estimation (EKF or similar)
* Aerodynamics background sufficient to reason about stability, trim, and control\-surface authority
* Basic structural/load reasoning and airframe structural design fundamentals — load paths, material selection, basic sizing



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Hands\-on HIL/SIL experience, canister\- or rail\-launched airframe experience, familiarity with ArduPilot/PX4/custom FCS at code level, actuator control exposure, or a fly\-off/competition track record (SAE Aero, DBF, or similar)



  





**To Apply** 




 Send your resume to
 **career@skyvector.in** 
 with subject line
 **"Application for – UAV Designer"** 
 . In your email body, mention your full name, Total years of experience, Current CTC, Expected CTC, along with one flight\-dynamics, autopilot, or aerodynamics project you've personally worked on end\-to\-end and what platform it was for.

title: Robotics Instructor
description:
**Company Description** 




 NASCA is a STEAM\-focused education organization that uses innovative instructional practices to nurture critical thinking and creativity in school students. All training modules follow “Whole Brain Teaching,” aligning learning with how the brain naturally processes information. NASCA promotes practical, activity\-based learning and “Learning by Doing,” integrating Science, Technology, Engineering, Art, and Math with real\-world applications. The program emphasizes hands\-on lab work, collaborative experimentation, and a strong maker culture to develop problem\-solving skills and higher\-order thinking. NASCA’s mission is to make school education more holistic, impactful, and future\-ready, equipping learners with skills for emerging market realities and opportunities.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The Robotics Instructor is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai. This position involves designing and delivering engaging robotics and STEM lessons aligned with NASCA’s activity\-based and “Learning by Doing” pedagogy. The instructor will guide students through hands\-on projects, programming tasks, and lab\-based experimentation using robotics kits and related tools. Daily responsibilities include preparing lesson plans, managing classroom and lab activities, assessing student learning, and providing individualized support to help learners build problem\-solving and creative thinking skills. The Robotics Instructor will also collaborate with school staff to integrate robotics into the broader curriculum, maintain equipment, and contribute to continuous improvement of teaching materials and methodologies.
 



  




* Place of Deputation : Mumbai(South Mumbai)
* Employment : Full time (On Site)



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Engineering Degree / B.Tech / M. Tech in Electronics
* Must Know HTML, JAVA, SQL, Programming Languages
* Proficiency in Python / ARDUINO IDE / SAS /Matlab



  






 Experience
 



* Candidates must have minimum 2 \- 3 years of teaching experience.
* Previous experience working in EdTech companies / schools with similar assignment
* B. Tech/ M. Tech / B.E. – Electronics / Robotics / Mechatronics from top tier institutes.
* Must have excellent academic credentials

* Effective Communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and engage diverse learners.

* Demonstrated ability to facilitate activity\-based, learner\-centered instruction and manage classroom dynamics.



  




* Interest in STEAM education, maker culture, and fostering creativity, innovation, and problem\-solving among students.



  




* Ability to work collaboratively with educators, administrators, and other stakeholders to align programs with school curricula.

description:
**About the Role:**

We are looking for a motivated and energetic Field Sales Executive to promote and sell our packaging products to businesses across Hyderabad and surrounding areas. The ideal candidate should be willing to travel, meet customers, generate new business opportunities, and maintain strong client relationships.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Visit retail stores, wholesalers, distributors, supermarkets, manufacturers, restaurants, hospitals, and other businesses to generate sales.
* Identify and approach new customers in assigned territories.
* Promote the company's range of compostable, biodegradable, and conventional plastic packaging products.
* Explain product features, pricing, and benefits to customers.
* Generate enquiries, quotations, and follow up until orders are confirmed.
* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with customers.
* Meet daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
* Collect market feedback, competitor information, and customer requirements.

* Graduate or Intermediate (Any discipline).

* Self\-motivated with a positive attitude.
* Willingness to travel extensively for customer visits.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office and smartphone applications.
* Must possess a valid two\-wheeler driving licence and own a bike.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in B2B sales.
* Ability to build customer relationships.
* Strong presentation and convincing skills.
* Ability to work independently and achieve sales targets.

**Important Requirement Location \& Travel:**

* The candidate must be willing to report to our Medchal office/factory as required.

**Salary \& Benefits:**

* Competitive Salary
* Travel Allowance (TA)
* Performance Incentives
* Mobile Allowance (if applicable)
* Career Growth Opportunities
* Training on Products and Sales Techniques

**Products You'll Sell:**

* Compostable Carry Bags

* Conventional Plastic Packaging Products

About J.K. Subsea Engineering Pvt. Ltd.

J.K. Subsea Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is an engineering company serving industrial, offshore, subsea, oil \& gas and other specialized engineering sectors.

We are looking for a **Mechanical Design Engineer** who can work on practical engineering design activities involving mechanical components, assemblies, piping\-related products, fittings, equipment and customized engineering requirements.

The position is suitable for a Mechanical Engineer who enjoys **actual engineering and design work** and is comfortable working with drawings, dimensions, materials, specifications and manufacturing requirements.

Job Responsibilities

* Prepare 2D and 3D mechanical drawings for components, assemblies and engineering products.
* Develop and modify mechanical designs based on customer requirements and technical specifications.
* Prepare detailed manufacturing drawings with dimensions, tolerances, material specifications and other relevant details.
* Understand customer drawings, specifications, BOMs and technical requirements.
* Prepare and maintain **BOMs (Bill of Materials)**.
* Assist in selection of suitable materials, components and manufacturing processes.
* Coordinate with production, purchase, suppliers and vendors regarding design and manufacturing requirements.
* Review drawings received from customers and identify technical requirements or discrepancies.
* Make design modifications based on customer feedback and manufacturing requirements.
* Prepare design calculations wherever required.
* Support the engineering team in development of customized products and assemblies.
* Assist in preparation of technical documentation, datasheets and product drawings.
* Ensure drawings are properly revised, controlled and maintained.
* Coordinate with suppliers/manufacturers for technical clarifications.
* Support the Sales and Engineering teams in understanding technical requirements during quotation and order execution.
* Carry out basic engineering calculations related to dimensions, loads, pressure, material selection and mechanical components as applicable to the product.
* Participate in product improvement and value\-engineering activities.

Required Technical Skills

The candidate should have working knowledge of:

* Mechanical engineering drawing and drafting
* 2D CAD software – **AutoCAD preferred**
* 3D CAD software such as **SolidWorks / Solid Edge / Inventor / Creo** or equivalent
* GD\&T basics
* Engineering tolerances and fits
* Material specifications
* Manufacturing processes
* Machining and fabrication basics
* BOM preparation
* Reading engineering drawings
* Basic mechanical design calculations
* MS Excel and MS Office

Knowledge of **pressure\-rated components, piping, fittings, valves, hydraulic systems, instrumentation or offshore equipment** will be an advantage.

Educational Qualification

**Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering/Instrumentation Engineering/ Production Engineering/** 

Candidates with a Diploma in Mechanical Engineering and relevant practical design experience may also be considered.

Experience

**2–5 years of relevant mechanical design experience preferred.**

Candidates with experience in any of the following industries/products may apply:

* Industrial equipment
* Mechanical components
* Pressure equipment
* Valves and fittings
* Hydraulic equipment
* Piping systems
* Oil \& Gas
* Offshore / Marine
* Subsea equipment
* Engineering fabrication
* Machined components
* Industrial machinery

We are looking for a **practical Design Engineer**, not someone who is only familiar with CAD software.

The candidate should be able to:

* Understand what is being designed and why.
* Convert an engineering requirement into a workable drawing.
* Think about how a component will actually be manufactured.
* Understand dimensions, tolerances and materials.
* Communicate with production and vendors regarding drawings.
* Make corrections and revisions independently.
* Take ownership of assigned design work.
* Learn new products and engineering applications.

Freshers with strong practical knowledge of CAD and mechanical design may also be considered for a junior position.

Key Performance Areas (KRA)

The Design Engineer will be responsible for:

* Timely completion of drawings and design assignments.
* Accuracy of 2D and 3D drawings.
* Correct dimensions, tolerances and material specifications.
* Proper preparation and maintenance of BOMs.
* Minimizing drawing errors and revisions.
* Coordination with production, purchase and suppliers.
* Timely completion of customer drawing modifications.
* Supporting development of customized engineering products.
* Maintaining proper revision and document control.
* Providing practical and manufacturable design solutions.

Preferred Candidate Profile

A candidate with **2–5 years of practical mechanical design experience** will be preferred.

Experience in an engineering manufacturing, fabrication, industrial equipment, hydraulic, piping, oil \& gas, offshore or similar environment will be an advantage.

The candidate should be comfortable working in a **small/medium\-sized engineering organization**, where the role may involve both design and coordination rather than being restricted to only CAD drafting.

Important

**Practical knowledge and ability to execute design work will be given more importance than qualification alone.**

Candidates should be willing to work closely with other departments and take responsibility for their assigned engineering work.

Salary

**₹25,000 – ₹40,000 per month**, depending on experience, technical skills and suitability for the role.

This is a hands\-on role requiring the candidate to actively coordinate between production, suppliers, outlets, drivers and other team members to ensure smooth day\-to\-day operations.

Key Responsibilities

Quality \& Production Control

Ensure the quality, consistency and safety of all products manufactured by the company.

Monitor production processes and ensure products meet the company's required standards.

Check daily production output against requirements and identify shortages or production issues.

Maintain proper hygiene, cleanliness and food\-safety standards throughout the production premises.

Monitor proper handling and storage of raw materials and finished products.

Help reduce wastage and improve production efficiency.

Inventory \& Stock Management

Monitor inventory of raw materials, packaging materials and finished products.

Ensure sufficient stock of the company's manufactured and retail products is maintained.

Regularly check stock requirements of all company outlets.

Coordinate replenishment and stock transfers to prevent products from going out of stock.

Identify fast\-moving and low\-stock products and plan requirements accordingly.

Purchase \& Supplier Coordination

Coordinate with suppliers and place orders for required raw materials and other products.

Follow up with suppliers to ensure materials are received on time.

Coordinate with the company driver regarding collection and delivery of materials and products.

Ensure all outlets receive their required raw materials, retail products and manufactured products on time.

Bulk Orders \& Client Coordination

Receive and coordinate bulk orders from external clients.

Plan production and product requirements according to the order quantity and delivery deadline.

Coordinate with production staff, packing staff, drivers and other team members to ensure orders are prepared correctly.

Ensure bulk orders are completed, packed and dispatched within the committed time.

Candidate We Are Looking For

Freshers are welcome to apply.

Energetic, proactive and willing to take responsibility.

Organised and capable of handling multiple tasks simultaneously.

Comfortable working with production teams, suppliers, drivers and outlet staff.

Able to identify problems and take timely action rather than waiting for instructions.

Willing to adapt to changing operational conditions and company requirements.

Comfortable with a role that involves both technical food\-quality responsibilities and practical day\-to\-day operations.

What We Expect

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the work. The Food Technologist will play an important role in ensuring that the right products are produced at the right quality and quantity, sufficient stock reaches every outlet, raw materials arrive on time, and customer/bulk orders are completed without delays.

The role offers an opportunity to learn and grow alongside an expanding food manufacturing and retail business.

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Our platforms optimize operations across marine and rail terminals, yard management, transportation management, and fleet maintenance, enabling greater efficiency, safety, and visibility.
   

  

 Our Yard Management System (YMS) helps companies manage the movement of trailers, containers, drivers, and other assets within their facilities. By connecting yard operations, transportation processes, automation, and real\-time visibility, Kaleris enables customers to improve yard efficiency, reduce manual work, and make better operational decisions.

 **Product Manager Intern**

 Required

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

title: Product Manager
description:
**The Role, in One Sentence**
 You own the bridge between Customer Success and Engineering — making sure engineering builds what customers can actually use, and making sure customers understand, adopt, and champion what gets built.
   

  

**The Three Metrics You Will Be Measured On**
**Product usage — are customers actually using the modules they pay for**
**Product champions — are there named people inside our accounts who advocate for us**
**Recurring revenue — retention and expansion, as an outcome of the first two**
 Everything below serves these three. If an activity doesn't move one of them, it isn't the job.
   

  

**What This Job Actually Is**
 Read this section carefully. It is the most important part of this posting.
   

  

 What It Means Day to Day
   

  

 \~40% Product
   

  

 Owning the roadmap for existing modules. Prioritisation. Writing specs. Relentlessly simplifying — fewer clicks, less jargon, usable by a 55\-year\-old warden and a 19\-year\-old student alike. Deciding what does not get built.
   

  

 \~30% Engineering \& Delivery
   

  

 Sprint planning, grooming, scope management, release coordination, UAT, post\-release verification. Working daily with our Tech Lead and engineering team.
   

  

 \~30% Customer\-Facing Product Work
   

  

 Product demos. Feature training. Webinars. Roadmap sessions that get customers excited about what's coming. Gathering requirements first\-hand rather than second\-hand.
   

  

 Travel is occasional, not routine. Most customer work is remote. Expect on\-site visits some months and none in others.
   

  

**What This Job Is Not**
* Not account management. We have a Customer Success team. They own accounts, escalations, support tickets, and day\-to\-day service. You do not.
* Not a growth role. There is no funnel to optimise, no experimentation programme, no PLG motion. If your last three years were Mixpanel dashboards and A/B tests, this will make you unhappy within six months.
* Not pure product, not pure engineering. You will not sit in Figma all day, and you will not be writing code. You will spend your time translating in both directions — and the translation is the value.


**What You Will Own**
 Product
   

  

* Roadmap for existing modules — user management, leave and attendance, tickets and assets, mess, amenities, checklists, visitor management, finance, notifications
* Prioritisation across competing asks from Customer Success, Sales, and Engineering
* Simplification as a discipline. Our users are not software people. When engineering ships something in six clicks, your job is to ask why it isn't three. When a screen uses internal terminology, your job is to catch it before a customer does.
* Saying no — to customers, to Sales, and to engineering — with a reason that holds
* Protecting the roadmap from one\-off customisations that fork the product


 Delivery
   

  

* Sprint planning, grooming, and release coordination with the Tech Lead and engineering team
* Turning requirements into specs engineering can act on, with the "why" intact
* UAT and post\-release verification — confirming it works for the customer, not just in staging
* Never committing a date engineering hasn't agreed to


 Customer\-Facing Product Work
   

  

* Product demos that make non\-technical institutional buyers want the product
* Training existing customers on new features so they actually get adopted
* Webinars and roadmap sessions across the customer base
* Building product champions inside accounts — the people who will renew and expand us
* First\-hand requirement gathering, so we aren't building from a game of telephone


 Systems, Not Heroics
   

  

* Every commitment logged. No verbal promises that live only in your head.
* Building the process so it runs without founder involvement.


**Must\-Haves**
* 3\+ years of full\-time product management, post\-graduation, with real ownership specs, prioritisation, sprints, releases.

title: Performance Video Editor
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Performance Video Editor**

**Role**

Performance Video Editor

**Work Mode**

Remote / Work From Home

**Experience**

Fresher or 1 year of relevant experience

**Salary / Budget**

₹10,000 – ₹20,000 per month

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a creative and performance\-focused Video Editor who can transform scripts, hooks, raw footage, and concepts into highly engaging video creatives designed for social media and performance marketing.

The ideal candidate should not only know how to edit videos but also understand why a video works — including hooks, pacing, captions, music, cuts, visual storytelling, and current market trends.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Create High\-Performing Video Creatives**

* Produce 3–5 highly engaging video creatives per day, depending on project requirements.
* Create videos designed to capture attention quickly and maintain viewer retention.
* Experiment with different editing styles, pacing, transitions, visual patterns, and storytelling techniques.

**2\. Understand the Script**

* Read and understand the complete script before starting the edit.
* Identify the key message, emotions, important moments, and intended audience.
* Translate the script into strong visual storytelling.

**3\. Understand Hooks \& Caption Position**

* Understand the importance of the first 1–3 seconds of a video.
* Position hooks and captions strategically for maximum visibility and attention.
* Ensure text is readable, correctly timed, and visually aligned with the content.

**4\. Background Music \& Audio**

* Select appropriate background music based on the emotion and objective of the video.
* Understand music volume, timing, beats, and transitions.
* Keep dialogue/voice\-over clear and properly balanced with background music.
* Use sound effects where they improve engagement.

**5\. Engaging Cuts \& Pacing**

* Create dynamic and purposeful cuts based on the script and audio.
* Remove unnecessary pauses and dead moments.
* Use B\-roll, zooms, motion, transitions, text animations, and visual changes where appropriate.
* Maintain strong pacing throughout the video.

**6\. Stay Updated With Market Trends**

* Research trending video formats, editing styles, hooks, caption patterns, transitions, and creative trends.
* Understand what is currently working across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube Shorts, and Reels.
* Bring new editing ideas and references to the team.
* Continuously experiment with new approaches.

**7\. Editing Tools \& Technical Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of CapCut.
* Strong working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro.
* After Effects — added advantage.
* Other relevant editing tools.
* Knowledge of video cutting and sequencing, text animation, captions/subtitles, transitions, B\-roll, sound effects, background music, basic motion graphics, and social\-media formats and aspect ratios.

**8\. Colour Correction \& Visual Quality**

* Perform basic colour correction and colour grading.
* Maintain consistent skin tones, exposure, contrast, and overall visual quality.
* Ensure the final video looks clean, professional, and platform\-ready.

**9\. Deadline \& Task Discipline**

* Complete assigned tasks within the given deadline.
* Maintain consistent output without compromising quality.
* Inform the manager before the deadline if there is any genuine blocker or delay.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks from brief to final delivery.

**10\. Communication \& Problem Solving**

* If there is any issue with the script, footage, brief, editing direction, or deadline, communicate with the manager without delay.
* Ask questions when requirements are unclear.
* Be proactive in identifying problems and suggesting solutions.

**11\. Support Bulk Creative Production**

* Work efficiently in a high\-volume creative production environment.
* Help the team produce creatives at scale while maintaining quality and consistency.
* Follow the team's creative workflow and production SOP.
* Handle multiple creative variations efficiently.
* Maintain proper file organization and naming conventions.

**What We Expect**

* Strong attention to detail
* Creative thinking
* Good understanding of social\-media content
* Fast execution with quality
* Strong sense of pacing and storytelling
* Willingness to experiment
* Ability to take feedback positively
* Ownership of deadlines
* Clear and proactive communication
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment

**Preferred Candidate**

* Fresher with strong editing skills OR 1 year of relevant experience
* Portfolio demonstrating short\-form video editing skills
* Experience with Instagram Reels, Meta Ads, YouTube Shorts, or similar content is an advantage.
* Performance marketing creative experience is an added advantage.

**Performance Standard**

A successful Video Editor should be able to:

**Understand → Edit → Review → Improve → Deliver**

The goal is not simply to make a video.

**The goal is to create a video that is:**

**Attention\-Grabbing \+ Engaging \+ Visually Strong \+ On\-Brand \+ Performance\-Focused**

**Core Mindset**

***“Don't just edit what you're given. Understand the objective behind the creative and make the edit better.”***

***How to apply :***  
***Send your resume to : roshani@inspireglobalventure.com***

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

title: Officer - Group operations
description:
The Officer – Group Operations supports the Vetting Desk in two areas: vessel vetting (RightShip, Q88 and related questionnaires) and ship security (ISPS Code). The role tracks inspections, keeps vetting and security records up to date, follows up on findings until closed, supports Ship Security Plan work, security intelligence and guidance for vessels in high\-risk areas, and reports compliance status to management. The role works to set procedures under the guidance of the Operations Manager.




**ROLES ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

**Vetting**

* Upload inspection reports, findings, RCAs and CAPs to the RightShip portal and internal databases accurately and on time.
* Follow up with ship staff and business units on corrective actions until all findings are closed.
* Prepare, update and submit Q88, Baltic Questionnaire and other vetting questionnaires, and keep vessel certificate records current.

**Ship Security**

* Assist in preparing and amending Ship Security Plans (SSPs), including collecting vessel data and updating GA Plans after flag or class changes.
* Send standard security guidance to vessels entering high\-risk areas; track vessel reporting deadlines and send reminders.
* Draft and send CSO messages and security circulars; keep the PMSC list up to date.
* Support vessels preparing for ISPS audits, RightShip inspections and dry docks with documents and follow\-up.
* Collect and map maritime security intelligence from threat feeds, advisories and incident reports; brief the desk on risks to fleet vessels and trading routes.
* Manage day\-to\-day contact with ship staff, business units, CSOs, security providers and external authorities on security matters.

**Reporting and Administration**

* Prepare regular reports and dashboards on inspection status, findings trends, Safety Score and security compliance.
* Maintain files, databases and SOPs; track invoices for desk services; take part in process improvement and training.
* Take on additional roles or desk processes, or move internally within Group Operations, as business needs require.

 **Requirements**  

**KEY SKILLS AND CAPABILITIES:**

**Technical skills**

* Working knowledge of the ISM and ISPS Codes, ship security plans and guidance for high\-risk areas.
* Understanding of RightShip inspections, Q88 and vetting questionnaires, and the RCA and CAP process.
* Maritime security intelligence mapping: tracking threats and incidents and relating them to fleet routes.
* Use of AI tools and a sound understanding of data; MS Office 365 and Power BI or similar.

**Professional skills**

* Project management and project support: planning, tracking actions and reporting progress.
* Good written and spoken English; clear, confident dealings with internal and external stakeholders.
* Well organised and accurate; handles confidential documents securely and manages several deadlines at once.

**PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:**

* Master's degree in International Business or International Relations.
* Bachelor's degree in Maritime Studies, Political Science or Business Administration.
* 1–2 years in ship management support, vetting, maritime security or compliance. Freshers keen to learn may be considered.
* Knowledge of RightShip procedures, Q88 or the ISPS Code preferred.

  

**Benefits** **About Anglo\-Eastern**


Anglo\-Eastern is a global leader in independent ship management services. The Group manages over 700 vessels under full technical management, supports around 500 additional ships under crew management, and has overseen more than 1,000 newbuildings and conversions through its newbuilding supervision and project management divisions.


Headquartered in Hong Kong, Anglo\-Eastern operates through a network of 30 offices across Asia, Europe, and the Americas, including wholly owned maritime training facilities. Our strength lies in our people: over 39,000 seafarers and 2,350 shore\-based employees who work together to support clients across ship types while building trust, driving performance, and shaping a better maritime future.

 **Why join Anglo\-Eastern?**

* Join a globally respected company with a strong maritime heritage of over 50 years
* Work in an environment anchored in integrity, trust, and long\-term relationships
* Access continuous learning and structured career development across a truly global network
* Be part of a team committed to delivering excellence and shaping a better maritime future

  

Join us today!

title: Social Media Motion Designer
description:
**About MaximusLabs**
 MaximusLabs is an AI\-first growth and visibility agency. We help B2B SaaS and AI startups get found and recommended on AI search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews, alongside classic Google search.
   

  

 Our work is measured in inbound leads, pipeline and revenue, not vanity metrics. We work closely with founders and growth teams at early and growth stage companies.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a Motion Designer who lives on social media and has real taste for reels. Motion design is the heart of this role. You will turn our ideas about AI search into short videos, reels and animated visuals that make people stop scrolling. You will also run the posting calendar that gets them out every week.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, full\-time role. You will animate, edit, design and publish, working directly with the founder.
   

  

**Fresher friendly: your work matters, not your years**
 Experience is a plus, not a requirement. Once you apply, we will send you an assignment. Do it well and send it back. If we love your assignment, we will hire you, even with zero years of experience. The quality of your work is the only thing we judge.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Create motion graphics and animated explainers: kinetic typography, animated charts, product and screen walkthroughs
* Edit short form videos (reels, shorts, LinkedIn videos) from raw footage, screen recordings and talking head clips
* Design static visuals for social media: carousels, post graphics, thumbnails and cover images
* Manage our social media calendar and keep a steady publishing cadence across our channels
* Track what performs (views, watch time, saves, shares) and use it to sharpen the next round
* Keep every piece on brand, and build reusable templates so we can ship faster
* Spot new formats and trends early, and adapt them to our voice


**What We Are Looking For**
* Motion design skills: you can make type, shapes and footage move with intent
* Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro, or equivalents like DaVinci Resolve or CapCut
* A sharp eye for typography, pacing, colour and composition
* An instinct for hooks: you know what makes the first two seconds of a reel work
* A feel for what performs on each social platform
* Clear written and spoken English, and comfort with fast feedback loops
* The ability to own a piece from brief to published post


**Good to have**
* 1 to 3 years of experience in motion design, video editing or social media (freshers are welcome)
* A portfolio or social account that shows your work (personal projects count)
* Figma or Canva for static design
* Experience with AI image and video tools
* Interest in B2B SaaS, AI or marketing
* Sound design and caption styling


**What You Will Get**
* Direct work with the founder, and a real say in how MaximusLabs shows up online
* Room to experiment with new formats and AI video tools
* Room to grow into a content or creative lead role as our content engine scales


**How We Hire**
* Apply with your resume, plus a link to any work you have made if you have one.
* We send you an assignment.
* You send it back. If the work is great, we talk next.


**Location**
 This is a full\-time, in\-office role. We are hiring in Bengaluru and Coimbatore, India, and this posting is for the city shown above.
   

  

 Skills: motion graphics,graphic design,video editing,motion design,social media management,after effects,premiere pro

title: Intern - Technical Writer
description:
**About Technical Writing** 




 A Technical Writer explains complex topics in a simple and clear language that end users can
 



 understand and apply effectively. Technical writers are primarily involved in creating User
 



 Guides for a product (hardware or software).
 



  





**Content Writing vs Technical Writing:** 
 Technical writing focuses on explaining complex
 



 processes, products, or instructions clearly, while content writing is aimed at engaging and
 



 informing readers through blogs, articles, or marketing material
 



 Technical writing is utilised across multiple industries including engineering, healthcare, science,
 



 and technology.
 



  





**Types of User guides** 
 \- Hardware Manuals, Software Manuals, API docs, SDK docs,
 



 Integration guides,
 



  





 Some user guide examples:
 



 https://developer.salesforce.com/docs\#browse
 



 docs.capillarytech.com
 



  





**Career Path:** 




 The demand for technical writers is closely linked to advancements in technology and the need
 



 for clear communication.
 



 The demand for technical writers is expected to remain strong, with projections indicating a
 



 growth rate of about 4% \- 7 % from 2023 to 2033\.
 



  





**Ideal for:** 
 Candidates who like to explore complicated applications and then explain it using
 



 simple English.
 



  





**Career Progress:** 
 Associate Technical Writer \> Senior Technical Writer \> Lead Technical Writer
 



 \> Manager \> Director of Technical Documentation
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 ● Understand products and services deeply to simplify complex technical concepts to
 



 create user\-friendly documentation.
 



 ● Attend demos, review Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and technical materials,
 



 and write clear explanations of features.
 



 ● Test APIs, document their functionality and explain the API parameters in a standard
 



 format.
 



 ● Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, developers, and
 



 engineers.
 



 ● Collaborate with Product Managers and assist in research and development
 



  





**Expertise and Qualifications** 




**Education:** 




 ● Bachelor’s degree in Technology or Arts.
 



  





**Skills:** 




 ● Ability to quickly learn and explain technical concepts like APIs, SDKs, and integrations.
 



 ● Excellent written and verbal communication skills with attention to detail.
 



 ● Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
 



 ● Interest in researching various topics and gathering information to create high\-quality
 



 documentation.

title: Associate Demo Engineer
description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API\-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose\-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com.
   

  

 Yext is looking for a curious, technology\-minded individual to join the Demo Engineering team as an
 **Associate Demo Engineer** 
 .
   

  

 This is a brilliant entry\-level opportunity for someone who is enthusiastic about technology, excited to learn, and keen to build a career at the intersection of AI, digital search, and sales enablement.The Demo Engineering team supports a wide range of internal partners — including Revenue (Sales and Solutions Engineering), Client Services, Marketing, and Product — by creating everything from polished standard demo environments to visionary "art of the possible" solutions that showcase what the Yext platform can do.
   

  

 As an Associate, you'll learn the craft of demo engineering from the ground up, working alongside experienced engineers and solutions professionals in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.
   

  

 This role is based in India and is designed to give you real, hands\-on experience from day one — with clear development pathways into a full Demo Engineer role.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Supporting Demo Asset Creation, Development \& Deliverables**
* Support Senior Demo Engineers with delivering Demo Engineering requests. This will include assisting in building and maintaining standard demo environments using the Yext platform.
* Help customise demo accounts to reflect prospect\-specific use cases and industry contexts, guided by senior team members.
* Support updates to Knowledge Graph data, basic connector and crawler configurations, and front\-end elements.
* Help keep demo environments current with the latest Yext product features and configurations.


**Continuous Platform Learning \& Assistance of Deliverables**
* Continuously learn the Yext platform including Hearsay. Build a strong foundational understanding of the Yext platform, covering Listings, Search, Pages, and Knowledge Graph.
* Shadow Senior Demo Engineers and Solutions Engineers to learn how demos are scoped, built, and used throughout the sales cycle.
* Complete recommended certifications and participate in product enablement programmes.
* Learn SEO best practices and assist in assessing prospects' digital presence using these best practices, beginning to identify areas for improvement.
* Learn to understand the common data structures required to successfully support the generation of Yext Scout Reports.
* Learn to interpret Yext Analytics including Yext Scout.
* Learn to understand Yext Knowledge Scans; to evaluate a prospect's presence across digital Listings, user Reviews, and optimised web Pages.
* With guidance from Senior Demo Engineers, learn to prepare and support reports and materials to enable pre\-sales discussions led by Yext Global Solutions Engineers.
* Begin developing basic skills in HTML, CSS, and using AI tools (such as LLMs) to assist with front\-end customisation tasks.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Support the deal cycle by managing and responding to inbound requests from Solutions Engineers and Account Executives via Jira.
* Participate in scoping calls and team stand\-ups to develop an understanding of how work is prioritised.
* Stay close to product updates — including pre\-GA features — through internal channels and product communications.
* Share learnings and observations with the team via Slack and team meetings.
* Contribute to the SE Confluence knowledge hub by documenting what you've learnt, edge case handling, and useful guides for others.


**Operational Excellence**
* Keep your assigned Jira Tickets Demo up to date.
* Maintain and take responsibility for your allocated areas of the Demo Library.
* Follow team administration hygiene and ticketing standards so requests are tracked, prioritised, and delivered consistently.
* Be curious: ask questions proactively and surface blockers early — no one is expected to figure everything out alone.


**What You Have**
* A desire to develop a career in a technical, digital, or SaaS\-related role — relevant internships, placements, or academic projects are very welcome.
* A degree or equivalent practical experience in Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field.
* A basic awareness of HTML and CSS, or a genuine eagerness to learn.
* Clear, confident communication skills — you can explain ideas simply and work well with others.
* Genuine curiosity about technology, AI, and digital experiences.
* A coachable attitude and the motivation to grow quickly in a high\-performance environment
* The ability to manage multiple tasks and collaborate across teams effectively.
* Curiosity; the default mindset to want to understand why technical aspects work, behave, evolve and the value it brings to Yext clients.


**Bonus Points**
* Previous experience in a technical, digital, or SaaS\-related role.
* Any exposure to SaaS platforms, CMS tools, Analytics platforms or digital marketing and SEO concepts.
* A passing familiarity with JavaScript or basic front\-end development.
* Some experience or interest in data, structured content, or database concepts.
* An interest in how technology supports pre\-sales and revenue teams.


**Why You’ll Love It Here**
* You'll work at the forefront of AI and digital search technology, gaining practical experience in one of the fastest\-evolving spaces in tech.
* You'll build real demo assets that directly support enterprise sales cycles — your work will matter from the start.
* You'll receive structured mentorship and development to help you grow into a full Demo Engineer role.

 Node.js, TypeScript, React, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS.
 



**What you'd actually do** 



* Work across the full surface — product research, design, database architecture, back\-end, front\-end, QA, deployment, and SRE — not just one layer of it
* Take a spec, break it into workstreams an agent can execute in parallel, and run them
* Verify output — know what to trust, what to check by hand, what to throw away
* Escalate when the agent is confidently wrong
 *(this is the skill we care most about)*
* Ship. Own the thing after it ships.



**Who this is for** 



* 1–3 years building real software (product company, startup, or services — we don't care which)
* You already use Claude Code, Cursor, or similar — not as a toy, as how you work
* You've thrown away code you wrote and didn't mourn it
* You're currently somewhere that restricts, discourages, or ridicules this way of working, and you're tired of it



 Strong CS fundamentals matter. Where you studied doesn't. If you're from an IIT/NIT and this describes you, great — but the filter is practice, not pedigree.
 



**Who this is not for** 



* People who want to be told exactly what to build
* People who need to write every line to feel ownership
* People who list "AI" as a skill but have never shipped with an agent



**Process** 




 Four steps, roughly ten days start to offer:
 


* Conversation with the CPTO (45 min). You show me how you work, I show you how I work. This filters harder than anything else.
* Spec\-to\-handoff exercise. We give you a real spec. You decompose it and run it.
* Debug\-with\-agent. Something's broken. Find it, with your agent, while we watch.
* Offer.



 No leetcode. No DSA rounds. No take\-home that takes a weekend.
 



**Working here** 




 This is an in\-office role, based out of our Jaipur office. We're not hiring remote for this one — you'll be working alongside the team, in person, day to day.
 



 You'd report to and work directly alongside the CPTO, who runs parallel agent streams on this codebase daily. You will not be the only person here who works this way, and you will not have to justify the workflow to anyone.
 



 The company is 15\+ years old and profitable, with a client base that renews. That's stability most places offering "AI\-native engineering" don't have.
 



**How to apply** 




 Send us something you built with an agent. A repo, a CLAUDE.md, a thread, a Loom — anything that shows how you actually work. A résumé alone tells us nothing we need to know.

Mumbai is our core technology office (established in 2011\) and we have 600\+ employees and growing very fast. Please visit our careers site https://www.issgovernance.com/join\-the\-iss\-team/

description:

 and HR operations for our workforce across Canada and the US.

 month internship with a path to a full\-time HRIS Analyst role for interns who meet the performance
   

  

 criteria.
   

  

 INTERNSHIP DETAILS
   

  

* Location: Chennai, working from the office, with a short evening stretch from home.
* Working hours: 12 PM – 7 PM IST in the office, plus 1–2 hours from home in the evening, wrapping

* Duration: 3 months.
* Stipend: ₹15,000 per month.
* Openings: 2\.


**What You'll Do**
* Support HR operations for Canada and the US, including maintaining employee records in


 BambooHR, onboarding and offboarding workflows, and routine HR queries within defined
   

  

 turnaround times.
   

  

* Build and automate HR reports and dashboards on headcount, turnover, onboarding, and


 certification tracking.

* Track compliance items, such as certification expiry dates, and flag upcoming renewals.
* Use AI tools to process complex data, speed up reporting, and improve the quality of your work.
